<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ja" class="gm" data-mode="light">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>やるやん！Todo</title>
  <link rel="icon" type="image/svg+xml" href="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 64 64'%3E%3Crect width='64' height='64' rx='14' fill='%235f6a85'/%3E%3Ctext x='32' y='39' text-anchor='middle' font-size='30' font-family='sans-serif' font-weight='800' fill='white'%3E0%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E">

  <style id="app-styles">
    @layer reset, base, component, utility, theme;
    @layer reset {
      *,
      ::before,
      ::after {
        box-sizing: border-box;
      }

      html,
      body {
        margin: 0;
        padding: 0;
      }
    }

    @layer base {
      :root {
        interpolate-size: allow-keywords;
        --primary: light-dark(oklch(62% 0.11 205), oklch(74% 0.085 205));
        --primary-bg-faint: light-dark(oklch(96.5% 0.017 205), oklch(34% 0.043 205));
        --primary-border-strong: light-dark(oklch(65% 0.088 205), oklch(73% 0.084 205));
        --primary-text-ink: light-dark(oklch(43% 0.075 205), oklch(87% 0.065 205));
        --danger-border-soft: light-dark(oklch(77% 0.07 27), oklch(63% 0.075 27));
        --danger-border: light-dark(oklch(68% 0.095 27), oklch(69% 0.09 27));
        --focus-surface-start: light-dark(oklch(99.2% 0.005 245), oklch(27% 0.01 252));
        --focus-surface-end: light-dark(oklch(96.2% 0.012 245), oklch(24% 0.01 252));
        --success-border: light-dark(oklch(74% 0.06 156), oklch(62% 0.06 156));
        --success-glow: light-dark(oklch(61% 0.09 156 / 0.18), oklch(74% 0.07 156 / 0.2));
        --pause-border: light-dark(oklch(81% 0.06 92), oklch(70% 0.06 92));
        --pause-glow: light-dark(oklch(72% 0.08 92 / 0.2), oklch(78% 0.06 92 / 0.2));
        --radius-full: 999px;
        accent-color: var(--primary);
        --line-soft: light-dark(oklch(84.5% 0.006 248), oklch(47% 0.009 252));
        --shadow-strong: light-dark(oklch(22% 0.011 252 / 0.095), oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.38));
        --sidebar-w: 13.714286rem;
        --sidebar-collapsed-w: 4rem;
        --ease-smooth: cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1);
        --focus-halo-1: light-dark(oklch(64% 0.08 205 / 0.12), oklch(72% 0.07 205 / 0.12));
        --task-tree-indent: 2.65rem;
        --task-tree-node-indent: 0.86rem;
        --theme-dot-ring: light-dark(oklch(99.5% 0.003 248 / 0.96), oklch(23% 0.01 252 / 0.96));
        --theme-dot-outline: light-dark(oklch(52% 0.012 248 / 0.22), oklch(3% 0 0 / 0.4));
        --toggle-knob: light-dark(oklch(99.5% 0.003 248), oklch(23% 0.01 252));
        --mode-switch-track: light-dark(oklch(32% 0.02 252), oklch(33% 0.02 252));
        --mode-switch-track-active: light-dark(oklch(74% 0.11 233), oklch(46% 0.07 233));
        --mode-switch-moon: light-dark(oklch(99% 0.003 248), oklch(95% 0.01 252));
        --mode-switch-sun: light-dark(oklch(88% 0.14 90), oklch(86% 0.12 90));
        --mode-switch-star: light-dark(oklch(97% 0.01 248), oklch(96% 0.01 252));
        --mode-switch-cloud: light-dark(oklch(99% 0.003 248), oklch(99% 0.003 252));

        &[data-theme="theme-2"] {
          --primary: light-dark(oklch(63% 0.11 206), oklch(74% 0.085 206));
          --primary-bg-faint: light-dark(oklch(96.5% 0.017 206), oklch(34% 0.043 206));
          --primary-border-strong: light-dark(oklch(65% 0.088 206), oklch(73% 0.084 206));
          --primary-text-ink: light-dark(oklch(43% 0.075 206), oklch(87% 0.065 206));
        }

        &[data-theme="theme-1"] {
          --primary: light-dark(oklch(64% 0.095 157.2), oklch(75% 0.075 157.2));
          --primary-bg-faint: light-dark(oklch(96.5% 0.015 157.2), oklch(34% 0.035 157.2));
          --primary-border-strong: light-dark(oklch(65% 0.078 157.2), oklch(73% 0.072 157.2));
          --primary-text-ink: light-dark(oklch(44% 0.07 157.2), oklch(88% 0.058 157.2));
        }

        &[data-theme="theme-3"] {
          --primary: light-dark(oklch(67% 0.108 84.8), oklch(77% 0.085 84.8));
          --primary-bg-faint: light-dark(oklch(96.8% 0.02 84.8), oklch(35% 0.04 84.8));
          --primary-border-strong: light-dark(oklch(66% 0.086 84.8), oklch(74% 0.078 84.8));
          --primary-text-ink: light-dark(oklch(45% 0.078 84.8), oklch(88% 0.064 84.8));
        }

        &[data-theme="theme-4"] {
          --primary: light-dark(oklch(64% 0.1 18.5), oklch(75% 0.078 18.5));
          --primary-bg-faint: light-dark(oklch(96.6% 0.016 18.5), oklch(34% 0.036 18.5));
          --primary-border-strong: light-dark(oklch(65% 0.08 18.5), oklch(73% 0.074 18.5));
          --primary-text-ink: light-dark(oklch(44% 0.072 18.5), oklch(87% 0.06 18.5));
        }

        &[data-theme="theme-5"] {
          --primary: light-dark(oklch(60% 0.118 12.4), oklch(73% 0.094 12.4));
          --primary-bg-faint: light-dark(oklch(96.6% 0.019 12.4), oklch(33% 0.042 12.4));
          --primary-border-strong: light-dark(oklch(65% 0.09 12.4), oklch(72% 0.082 12.4));
          --primary-text-ink: light-dark(oklch(42% 0.082 12.4), oklch(86% 0.066 12.4));
        }

        &[data-theme="theme-6"] {
          --primary: light-dark(oklch(62% 0.07 283.9), oklch(74% 0.056 283.9));
          --primary-bg-faint: light-dark(oklch(96.6% 0.012 283.9), oklch(33% 0.03 283.9));
          --primary-border-strong: light-dark(oklch(65% 0.062 283.9), oklch(72% 0.06 283.9));
          --primary-text-ink: light-dark(oklch(43% 0.058 283.9), oklch(87% 0.05 283.9));
        }

        &[data-theme="theme-7"] {
          --primary: light-dark(oklch(63% 0.098 194.1), oklch(74% 0.076 194.1));
          --primary-bg-faint: light-dark(oklch(96.6% 0.016 194.1), oklch(34% 0.039 194.1));
          --primary-border-strong: light-dark(oklch(65% 0.082 194.1), oklch(73% 0.076 194.1));
          --primary-text-ink: light-dark(oklch(43% 0.073 194.1), oklch(87% 0.061 194.1));
        }

        &[data-theme="theme-8"] {
          --primary: light-dark(oklch(58% 0.038 251.9), oklch(70% 0.032 251.9));
          --primary-bg-faint: light-dark(oklch(96.7% 0.007 251.9), oklch(33% 0.016 251.9));
          --primary-border-strong: light-dark(oklch(66% 0.034 251.9), oklch(72% 0.033 251.9));
          --primary-text-ink: light-dark(oklch(42% 0.03 251.9), oklch(86% 0.026 251.9));
        }
      }
    }

    @layer component {
      body {
        -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
        text-rendering: optimizelegibility;
        min-height: 100vh;
        overflow-x: hidden;

        &.sidebar-collapsed .shell {
          grid-template-columns: var(--sidebar-collapsed-w) 1fr;
        }

        &.focus-open {
          overflow: hidden;
        }

        &.sidebar-collapsed {
          & .brand {
            display: none;
          }

          & .nav-label {
            opacity: 0;
            pointer-events: none;
            max-width: 0;
            transform: translate(-0.285714rem);
          }

          & .brand-title {
            opacity: 0;
            pointer-events: none;
            width: 0;
            max-width: 0;
            transform: translate(-0.428571rem);
          }

          & .nav-btn {
            margin-inline: auto;
          }

          & .nav {
            justify-items: center;
          }

          & .sidebar-top {
            flex-direction: row;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0;
          }

          & .sidebar-collapse-btn {
            margin: 0 auto;
          }
        }
      }

      .icon-sprite-defs {
        pointer-events: none;
        width: 0;
        height: 0;
        position: absolute;
        overflow: hidden;
      }

      .material-symbols-outlined {
        vertical-align: middle;
        user-select: none;
        pointer-events: none;
        color: currentColor;
        justify-content: center;
        align-items: center;
        width: 1em;
        height: 1em;
        font-size: 1.285714rem;
        line-height: 1;
        display: inline-flex;

        & > svg {
          stroke: none;
          fill: currentColor;
          width: 100%;
          height: 100%;
          display: block;
        }
      }

      .shell {
        grid-template-columns: var(--sidebar-w) 1fr;
        min-height: 100vh;
        transition: grid-template-columns 0.18s var(--ease-smooth);
        display: grid;
      }

      .sidebar {
        height: 100vh;
        transition: padding 0.18s var(--ease-smooth);
        grid-template-rows: auto auto 1fr;
        display: grid;
        position: sticky;
        top: 0;

        @media (width <= 56.25em) {
          border-block-end: none;
          height: auto;
          position: static;
        }
      }

      .sidebar-top {
        justify-content: space-between;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 0.6rem;
        display: flex;
      }

      .brand {
        align-items: center;
        gap: 0.2rem;
        min-width: 0;
        display: flex;
      }

      .brand-title {
        transition:
          opacity 0.16s var(--ease-smooth),
          transform 0.16s var(--ease-smooth);
        white-space: nowrap;
        line-height: 1.35;
      }

      .sidebar-collapse-btn {
        flex-shrink: 0;
      }

      .nav {
        display: grid;

        @media (width <= 56.25em) {
          grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
        }
      }

      .nav-btn {
        appearance: none;
        width: 100%;
        overflow: hidden;
      }

      .nav-icon {
        flex-shrink: 0;
        justify-content: center;
        align-items: center;
        width: 1.15rem;
        display: inline-flex;
      }

      .nav-label {
        max-width: 10rem;
        transition:
          opacity 0.16s var(--ease-smooth),
          max-width 0.16s var(--ease-smooth),
          transform 0.16s var(--ease-smooth);
        white-space: nowrap;
        display: inline-block;
        overflow: hidden;
      }

      .main {
        place-items: start center;
        display: grid;
      }

      .page-wrap {
        display: grid;
      }

      .page {
        animation: pageIn 0.18s var(--ease-smooth);
        display: none;

        &.active {
          display: grid;
        }
      }

      @keyframes pageIn {
        0% {
          opacity: 0;
          transform: translateY(0.428571rem);
        }

        to {
          opacity: 1;
          transform: translateY(0);
        }
      }

      .card {
        & h2 {
          font-weight: 800;
        }
      }

      .row {
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        display: flex;
      }

      .text-input {
        transition:
          border-color 0.16s var(--ease-smooth),
          box-shadow 0.16s var(--ease-smooth),
          background 0.16s var(--ease-smooth);
        outline: none;
        flex: 1;
      }

      .icon-btn,
      .mini-btn,
      .message-chip-btn,
      .focus-btn {
        appearance: none;
        transition:
          transform 0.16s var(--ease-smooth),
          filter 0.16s var(--ease-smooth),
          background 0.16s var(--ease-smooth),
          color 0.16s var(--ease-smooth),
          border-color 0.16s var(--ease-smooth),
          box-shadow 0.16s var(--ease-smooth);
        white-space: nowrap;
      }

      .task-list {
        margin: 0;
        padding: 0;
        list-style: none;
        display: grid;
      }

      .task-item {
        content-visibility: auto;
        contain-intrinsic-block-size: auto var(--task-estimated-size, 4rem);

        &:focus-within { content-visibility: visible; }
        gap: 0.7rem;
        display: grid;
        position: relative;

        &.done .task-title {
          color: var(--completed-text);
          text-decoration: line-through 0.142857rem;
        }
      }

      .task-main {
        grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 0.7rem;
        display: grid;
      }

      .task-meta {
        align-items: center;
        gap: 0.8rem;
        min-width: 0;
        display: flex;
      }

      .task-title {
        word-break: break-word;
        min-width: 0;
      }

      .achievement-time {
        border: 1px solid var(--line);
        border-radius: var(--radius-full);
        letter-spacing: 0.01em;
        align-items: center;
        width: fit-content;
        font-weight: 650;
        line-height: 1.25;
        display: inline-flex;

        & .material-symbols-outlined {
          color: var(--primary);
        }
      }

      .task-achievement {
        flex-shrink: 0;
      }

      .task-focus-wrap {
        align-items: center;
        gap: 0.34rem;
        min-width: 0;
        display: inline-flex;
      }

      .task-tools {
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        justify-content: flex-end;
        display: flex;

        @media (width <= 42.5em) {
          grid-column: 3;
          justify-self: end;
        }
      }

      .subtask-wrap {
        display: grid;
      }

      .subtask-list {
        min-height: 0.714286rem;
        margin: 0;
        padding: 0;
        list-style: none;
        display: grid;
      }

      .subtask-item {
        transition:
          background 0.16s var(--ease-smooth),
          border-color 0.16s var(--ease-smooth),
          opacity 0.16s var(--ease-smooth);
        align-items: center;
        gap: 0.55rem;
        display: grid;
        position: relative;

        & .text {
          word-break: break-word;
          min-width: 0;
        }

        &.done .text {
          color: var(--completed-text);
          text-decoration: line-through 0.142857rem;
        }
      }

      .subtask-text-wrap {
        align-items: center;
        gap: 0.8rem;
        min-width: 0;
        display: flex;
      }

      .subtask-achievement {
        flex-shrink: 0;
      }

      .subtask-actions {
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        justify-content: flex-end;
        display: flex;
      }

      .empty {
        text-align: center;
        color: var(--muted);
        place-items: center;
        line-height: 1.7;
        display: grid;
      }

      .empty-title {
        color: var(--text);
      }

      .setting-list {
        display: grid;
      }

      .setting-item {
        justify-content: space-between;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 0.9rem;
        display: flex;
      }

      .setting-meta {
        gap: 0.22rem;
        display: grid;
      }

      .setting-title {
        font-weight: 800;
      }

      .pomodoro-rhythm-card {
        gap: 0.72rem;
        display: grid;

        &.is-disabled {
          opacity: 0.72;
        }
      }

      .pomodoro-rhythm-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
        gap: 0.7rem;
        display: grid;
      }

      .pomodoro-field {
        display: grid;
      }

      .pomodoro-field-label {
        color: var(--muted);
      }

      .pomodoro-number-input {
        font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
      }

      .pomodoro-help {
        line-height: 1.5;
      }

      .theme-grid {
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        gap: 0.55rem;
        display: flex;
      }

      .theme-btn {
        appearance: none;
        aspect-ratio: 1;
        transition:
          border-color 0.16s var(--ease-smooth),
          box-shadow 0.16s var(--ease-smooth),
          transform 0.16s var(--ease-smooth),
          background 0.16s var(--ease-smooth);
        flex: none;
        place-items: center;
      }

      .theme-dot {
        border: 0.142857rem solid var(--theme-dot-ring);
        box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--theme-dot-outline);
        border-radius: 50%;
      }

      .toggle {
        appearance: none;
        background: var(--line-strong);
        cursor: pointer;
        width: 3.2rem;
        height: 1.85rem;
        transition: background 0.16s var(--ease-smooth);
        border: none;
        border-radius: 999px;
        flex-shrink: 0;
        position: relative;

        &::after {
          content: "";
          background: var(--toggle-knob);
          width: 1.45rem;
          height: 1.45rem;
          transition: transform 0.16s var(--ease-smooth);
          border-radius: 50%;
          position: absolute;
          top: 0.2rem;
          left: 0.2rem;
          box-shadow: 0 0.142857rem 0.571429rem #00000026;
        }

        &:checked {
          background: var(--primary);

          &::after {
            transform: translate(1.35rem);
          }
        }
      }

      .switch {
        border-radius: 2.142857rem;
        flex-shrink: 0;
        width: 4em;
        height: 2.2em;
        font-size: 1.214286rem;
        display: inline-block;
        position: relative;

        & input {
          opacity: 0;
          width: 0;
          height: 0;

          &:checked + .slider {
            background-color: var(--mode-switch-track-active);

            &::before {
              box-shadow: inset 1.071429rem -0.285714rem 0 1.071429rem var(--mode-switch-sun);
              transform: translate(1.8em);
            }

            & .star {
              opacity: 0;
            }

            & .cloud {
              opacity: 1;
            }
          }

          &:focus-visible + .slider {
            outline: 1px solid var(--primary);
          }
        }
      }

      .slider {
        cursor: pointer;
        background-color: var(--mode-switch-track);
        border-radius: 2.142857rem;
        transition: background-color 0.4s;
        position: absolute;
        inset: 0;
        overflow: hidden;

        &::before {
          content: "";
          width: 1.2em;
          height: 1.2em;
          box-shadow: inset 0.571429rem -0.285714rem 0 0 var(--mode-switch-moon);
          border-radius: 1.428571rem;
          transition:
            box-shadow 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.81, -0.04, 0.38, 1.5),
            transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.81, -0.04, 0.38, 1.5);
          position: absolute;
          bottom: 0.5em;
          left: 0.5em;
        }
      }

      .star {
        background-color: var(--mode-switch-star);
        border-radius: 50%;
        width: 0.357143rem;
        height: 0.357143rem;
        transition: opacity 0.4s;
        position: absolute;
      }

      .star_1 {
        top: 0.5em;
        left: 2.5em;
      }

      .star_2 {
        top: 1.2em;
        left: 2.2em;
      }

      .star_3 {
        top: 0.9em;
        left: 3em;
      }

      .cloud {
        opacity: 0;
        width: 3.5em;
        transition: opacity 0.4s;
        position: absolute;
        bottom: -1.4em;
        left: -1.1em;

        & path {
          fill: var(--mode-switch-cloud);
        }
      }

      .message-manager {
        display: grid;
      }

      .message-row {
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        display: flex;
      }

      .message-list {
        gap: 0.45rem;
        display: grid;
      }

      .message-item {
        justify-content: space-between;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 0.65rem;
        display: flex;
      }

      .message-text {
        word-break: break-word;
        font-weight: 700;
        line-height: 1.4;
      }

      .message-edit-input {
        flex: 1;
      }

      .message-actions {
        flex-shrink: 0;
        gap: 0.35rem;
        display: flex;
      }

      .modal-overlay {
        z-index: 3000;
        justify-content: center;
        align-items: center;
        padding: 1.15rem;
        display: none;
        position: fixed;
        inset: 0;

        &.show {
          display: flex;
        }

        &.over-focus {
          z-index: 4100;

          & .modal-confirm {
            width: min(100%, 28rem);
            max-height: min(90vh, 34rem);
          }
        }
      }

      .modal {
        grid-template-rows: auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
        width: min(100%, 35.714286rem);
        max-height: min(88vh, 54.285714rem);
        display: grid;
        position: relative;
        overflow: hidden;

        &.modal-compact {
          width: min(100%, 31.428571rem);
        }

        &.modal-confirm {
          width: min(100%, 27.857143rem);
        }
      }

      .modal-header {
        justify-content: space-between;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 0.8rem;
        padding: 0.95rem 1.05rem;
        display: flex;
      }

      .modal-title-wrap {
        align-items: center;
        gap: 0.55rem;
        min-width: 0;
        display: flex;
      }

      .modal-title {
        letter-spacing: -0.01em;
        font-weight: 800;
        line-height: 1.3;
      }

      .modal-body {
        gap: 0.95rem;
        min-height: 0;

  <script>
    (async () => {
      'use strict';
      /* ============================================
         保存キー
      ============================================ */
      const TASKS_KEY = 'yatta-spa-tasks-v8';
      const SETTINGS_KEY = 'yatta-spa-settings-v8';
      const SIDEBAR_KEY = 'yatta-spa-sidebar-collapsed-v3';
      const ORGANIZE_MEMO_KEY = 'yatta-spa-organize-memo-v1';
      const TASK_VIEW_KEY = 'yatta-spa-task-view-v1';
      const STATE_META_KEY = 'yatta-spa-state-meta-v1';
      const INDEXED_DB_NAME = 'yatta-spa-state-v1';
      const INDEXED_DB_STORE_NAME = 'state';
      const INDEXED_DB_VERSION = 1;
      const PERSISTED_DATA_KEYS = [TASKS_KEY, SETTINGS_KEY, SIDEBAR_KEY, ORGANIZE_MEMO_KEY, TASK_VIEW_KEY];
      const PERSISTED_STATE_KEYS = [...PERSISTED_DATA_KEYS, STATE_META_KEY];
      const BACKUP_APP_ID = 'yaruyan-todo';
      const BACKUP_SCHEMA_VERSION = 1;
      const STORAGE_WARNING_MESSAGE = 'ブラウザ保存に失敗したため、この端末では変更内容が保持されない場合があります。';
      const BASE_PAGE_TITLE = document.title || 'やるやん！Todo';
      const MAX_TASK_TEXT_LENGTH = 120;
      const MAX_SUBTASK_TEXT_LENGTH = 120;
      const MAX_PARENT_TASK_COUNT = 200;
      const MAX_SUBTASK_COUNT_PER_PARENT = 50;
      const MAX_MESSAGE_TEXT_LENGTH = 80;
      const MAX_MESSAGE_COUNT = 30;
      const MAX_ORGANIZE_MEMO_LENGTH = 10000;
      const ORGANIZE_MEMO_WARNING_THRESHOLD = 0.9;
      const MAX_BACKUP_FILE_BYTES = 8 * 1024 * 1024;
      const CORRUPT_STORAGE_BACKUP_SUFFIX = '__corrupt';
      const MAX_CORRUPT_STORAGE_BACKUP_CHARS = 64 * 1024;
      const SAFE_ENTITY_ID_PATTERN = /^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,127}$/;
      const MIN_POMODORO_MINUTES = 1;
      const MAX_POMODORO_FOCUS_MINUTES = 180;
      const MAX_POMODORO_BREAK_MINUTES = 120;
      const DEFAULT_POMODORO_FOCUS_MINUTES = 25;
      const DEFAULT_POMODORO_BREAK_MINUTES = 5;
      const ORGANIZE_MEMO_SAVE_DEBOUNCE_MS = 420;
      const FOCUS_CHECKPOINT_INTERVAL_MS = 2000;
      const STORAGE_OPERATION_TIMEOUT_MS = 4000;
      const FAVICON_SIZE = 64;
      const MAX_FAVICON_BADGE_COUNT = 99;
      // ボタンの読み上げ名を共用し、titleや別属性に文言を重複させない。
      const TOOLTIP_SELECTOR = 'button[aria-label]:not(.theme-btn)';
      const TOOLTIP_OFFSET_PX = 5;
      const TOOLTIP_VIEWPORT_PADDING_PX = 8;
      const DELETE_UNDO_WINDOW_MS = 5000;
      const MODAL_FOCUSABLE_SELECTOR = `
        button:not([disabled]),
        [href],
        input:not([type="hidden"]):not([disabled]),
        select:not([disabled]),
        textarea:not([disabled]),
        [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])
      `;

      let _storageWarningEl = null;
      let _storageWarningReason = '';
      let _indexedDbPromise = null;
      let _indexedDbWriteQueue = Promise.resolve();
      let _storedStateSaveQueue = Promise.resolve();
      let _lastIndexedDbWriteError = null;
      const LOCAL_STORAGE = (() => {
        try {
          return globalThis.localStorage || null;
        } catch (error) {
          _reportStorageError('local-unavailable', 'all', error);
          return null;
        }
      })();
      const STORAGE_TAB_ID = _createStorageWriteId();

      /* 保存ヘルパー開始 */
      function _safeStorageGet(storage, key, onError = null) {
        try {
          return storage.getItem(key);
        } catch (error) {
          onError?.('read', error, { key });
          return null;
        }
      }

      function _safeStorageSet(storage, key, value, onError = null) {
        try {
          storage.setItem(key, value);
          return true;
        } catch (error) {
          onError?.('write', error, { key, value });
          return false;
        }
      }

      function _safeStorageRemove(storage, key, onError = null) {
        try {
          storage.removeItem(key);
          return true;
        } catch (error) {
          onError?.('remove', error, { key });
          return false;
        }
      }

      function _createCorruptStorageBackupValue(raw) {
        if (raw.length <= MAX_CORRUPT_STORAGE_BACKUP_CHARS) return raw;
        const marker = `\n[truncated corrupt storage value; original chars: ${raw.length}]`;
        const safeLength = Math.max(0, MAX_CORRUPT_STORAGE_BACKUP_CHARS - marker.length);
        return `${raw.slice(0, safeLength)}${marker}`;
      }

      function _backupCorruptStorageValue({
        storage,
        key,
        raw,
        onError = null
      }) {
        const backupKey = `${key}${CORRUPT_STORAGE_BACKUP_SUFFIX}`;
        const backupValue = _createCorruptStorageBackupValue(raw);
        const existingBackup = _safeStorageGet(storage, backupKey, onError);
        const hasBackup = existingBackup === backupValue
          || (existingBackup == null && _safeStorageSet(storage, backupKey, backupValue, onError));
        // 文字数を制限したプレビューでは、元データを完全には復元できない。
        if (hasBackup && backupValue === raw && _safeStorageGet(storage, key, onError) === raw) {
          _safeStorageRemove(storage, key, onError);
        }
      }

      function _snapshotStorageEntry(storage, key, onError = null) {
        try {
          return {
            ok: true,
            value: storage.getItem(key)
          };
        } catch (error) {
          onError?.('read', error, { key });
          return {
            ok: false,
            value: null
          };
        }
      }

      function _restoreStorageEntry(storage, key, value, onError = null) {
        try {
          if (value == null) {
            storage.removeItem(key);
          } else {
            storage.setItem(key, value);
          }
          return true;
        } catch (error) {
          onError?.('rollback', error, { key, value });
          return false;
        }
      }

      function _rollbackStorageWrites(storage, snapshots, writtenKeys, onError = null) {
        let rollbackOk = true;
        const restoredKeys = new Set();
        for (let index = writtenKeys.length - 1; index >= 0; index -= 1) {
          const key = writtenKeys[index];
          if (restoredKeys.has(key)) continue;
          restoredKeys.add(key);
          if (!_restoreStorageEntry(storage, key, snapshots.get(key), onError)) {
            rollbackOk = false;
          }
        }
        return rollbackOk;
      }

      function _readJsonFromStorage({
        storage,
        key,
        fallback,
        validate = null,
        onError = null
      }) {
        const raw = _safeStorageGet(storage, key, onError);
        if (raw == null || raw === '') return fallback;

        try {
          const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
          if (validate && !validate(parsed)) {
            onError?.('validate', new Error(`Validation failed for key: ${key}`), { key, raw });
            return fallback;
          }
          return parsed;
        } catch (error) {
          onError?.('parse', error, { key, raw });
          _backupCorruptStorageValue({ storage, key, raw, onError });
          return fallback;
        }
      }

      function _readBooleanFromStorage({
        storage,
        key,
        fallback = false,
        onError = null
      }) {
        const raw = _safeStorageGet(storage, key, onError);
        if (raw == null) return fallback;
        if (raw === 'true') return true;
        if (raw === 'false') return false;
        return fallback;
      }

      function _writeManyToStorage({
        storage,
        entries,
        onError = null
      }) {
        const writeEntries = Array.isArray(entries) ? entries : [];
        const snapshots = new Map();
        for (const [key] of writeEntries) {
          if (snapshots.has(key)) continue;
          const snapshot = _snapshotStorageEntry(storage, key, onError);
          if (!snapshot.ok) {
            return false;
          }
          snapshots.set(key, snapshot.value);
        }

        const writtenKeys = [];
        const currentValues = new Map(snapshots);
        for (const [key, value] of writeEntries) {
          if (currentValues.get(key) === value) continue;
          if (!_safeStorageSet(storage, key, value, onError)) {
            writtenKeys.push(key);
            _rollbackStorageWrites(storage, snapshots, writtenKeys, onError);
            return false;
          }
          writtenKeys.push(key);
          currentValues.set(key, value);
        }
        return true;
      }

      function _createStorageWriteId() {
        return globalThis.crypto?.randomUUID?.()
          || `${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(16).slice(2)}`;
      }

      function _requestIndexedDbOpen() {
        if (!globalThis.indexedDB) {
          return Promise.resolve(null);
        }
        if (_indexedDbPromise) {
          return _indexedDbPromise;
        }

        _indexedDbPromise = new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
          const request = indexedDB.open(INDEXED_DB_NAME, INDEXED_DB_VERSION);
          let settled = false;
          const timeoutId = window.setTimeout(() => {
            finish(new Error('indexedDB open timed out'));
          }, STORAGE_OPERATION_TIMEOUT_MS);
          function finish(error = null, db = null) {
            if (settled) {
              db?.close();
              return;
            }
            settled = true;
            clearTimeout(timeoutId);
            if (error) reject(error);
            else {
              const openedPromise = _indexedDbPromise;
              const invalidateConnection = () => {
                if (_indexedDbPromise === openedPromise) _indexedDbPromise = null;
              };
              db.onversionchange = () => {
                db.close();
                invalidateConnection();
              };
              db.onclose = invalidateConnection;
              resolve(db);
            }
          }
          request.onupgradeneeded = () => {
            const db = request.result;
            if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains(INDEXED_DB_STORE_NAME)) {
              db.createObjectStore(INDEXED_DB_STORE_NAME);
            }
          };
          request.onsuccess = () => finish(null, request.result);
          request.onerror = () => finish(request.error || new Error('indexedDB open failed'));
          request.onblocked = () => finish(new Error('indexedDB open blocked'));
        });

        _indexedDbPromise.catch(() => {
          _indexedDbPromise = null;
        });

        return _indexedDbPromise;
      }

      function _waitForIndexedDbRequest(request) {
        return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
          request.onsuccess = () => resolve(request.result);
          request.onerror = () => reject(request.error || new Error('indexedDB request failed'));
        });
      }

      function _waitForIndexedDbTransaction(tx) {
        return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
          let settled = false;
          const timeoutId = window.setTimeout(() => {
            finish(new Error('indexedDB transaction timed out'));
            try { tx.abort(); } catch { /* トランザクションはすでに終了している場合がある。 */ }
          }, STORAGE_OPERATION_TIMEOUT_MS);
          function finish(error = null) {
            if (settled) return;
            settled = true;
            clearTimeout(timeoutId);
            if (error) reject(error);
            else resolve(true);
          }
          tx.oncomplete = () => finish();
          tx.onabort = () => finish(tx.error || new Error('indexedDB transaction aborted'));
          tx.onerror = () => finish(tx.error || new Error('indexedDB transaction failed'));
        });
      }

      async function _readManyFromIndexedDb(keys) {
        const db = await _requestIndexedDbOpen();
        if (!db) {
          return {};
        }
        const tx = db.transaction(INDEXED_DB_STORE_NAME, 'readonly');
        const txDone = _waitForIndexedDbTransaction(tx);
        try {
          const store = tx.objectStore(INDEXED_DB_STORE_NAME);
          // トランザクションが有効な間に全リクエストを登録し、コミット完了を待つ。
          const reads = keys.map(async (key) => {
            const value = await _waitForIndexedDbRequest(store.get(key));
            return [key, value == null ? null : String(value)];
          });
          const [entries] = await Promise.all([Promise.all(reads), txDone]);
          return Object.fromEntries(entries);
        } catch (error) {
          try { tx.abort(); } catch { /* トランザクションはすでに終了している場合がある。 */ }
          await txDone.catch(() => false);
          throw error;
        }
      }

      async function _writeManyToIndexedDb(entries, options = {}) {
        const db = await _requestIndexedDbOpen();
        if (!db) {
          return false;
        }
        const writeMeta = _getStorageMetaFromEntries(entries);
        const preventNewerOverwrite = options?.preventNewerOverwrite !== false;
        const allowNewerMetaSkip = options?.allowNewerMetaSkip === true;
        const tx = db.transaction(INDEXED_DB_STORE_NAME, 'readwrite');
        const txDone = _waitForIndexedDbTransaction(tx);
        try {
          const store = tx.objectStore(INDEXED_DB_STORE_NAME);
          if (preventNewerOverwrite && writeMeta) {
            const currentRawMeta = await Promise.race([
              _waitForIndexedDbRequest(store.get(STATE_META_KEY)),
              txDone
            ]);
            const currentMeta = _normalizeStorageMeta(currentRawMeta);
            const hasTargetConflict = _hasStorageMetaConflictSince(currentMeta, writeMeta);
            const hasBaselineConflict = options?.preventBaselineOverwrite !== false
              && writeMeta.base
              && _hasStorageMetaConflictSince(currentMeta, writeMeta.base);
            if (hasTargetConflict || (hasBaselineConflict
              && !_isVerifiedCheckpointAncestor(currentMeta, options?.checkpointMeta))) {
              await txDone;
              if (allowNewerMetaSkip) return true;
              _lastIndexedDbWriteError = new Error('indexedDB has newer state; skipped stale write');
              _lastIndexedDbWriteError.code = 'storage-conflict';
              return false;
            }
          }

          for (const [key, value] of entries) {
            store.put(String(value), key);
          }
          await txDone;
          return true;
        } catch (error) {
          // 同期的なリクエストエラーでは、登録済みの書き込みは自動的に中止されない。
          try { tx.abort(); } catch { /* トランザクションはすでに終了している場合がある。 */ }
          await txDone.catch(() => false);
          throw error;
        }
      }
      /* 保存ヘルパー終了 */

      function _reportStorageError(mode, key, error) {
        _storageWarningReason = error?.message || String(error || 'unknown error');
        console.warn(`[storage:${mode}] key=${key}`, error);
      }

      function _getStorageWarningEl() {
        _storageWarningEl ??= document.getElementById('storageWarning');
        return _storageWarningEl;
      }

      function _setStorageWarning(visible) {
        const warningEl = _getStorageWarningEl();
        if (!warningEl) return;
        if (!visible) {
          warningEl.hidden = true;
          warningEl.textContent = '';
          _storageWarningReason = '';
          return;
        }

        const suffix = _storageWarningReason ? ` (${_storageWarningReason})` : '';
        warningEl.textContent = `${STORAGE_WARNING_MESSAGE}${suffix}`;
        warningEl.hidden = false;
      }

      function _handlePersistentStorageError(mode, key, error) {
        _reportStorageError(mode, key, error);
        _setStorageWarning(true);
      }

      function _readStoredJson(key, fallback, validate = null) {
        return _readJsonFromStorage({
          storage: LOCAL_STORAGE,
          key,
          fallback,
          validate,
          onError: (mode, error, meta) => {
            _reportStorageError(`local-${mode}`, meta?.key || key, error);
          }
        });
      }

      function _readStoredBoolean(key, fallback = false) {
        return _readBooleanFromStorage({
          storage: LOCAL_STORAGE,
          key,
          fallback,
          onError: (mode, error, meta) => {
            _reportStorageError(`local-${mode}`, meta?.key || key, error);
          }
        });
      }

      function _readStoredText(key, fallback = '') {
        const raw = _safeStorageGet(LOCAL_STORAGE, key, (mode, error, meta) => {
          _reportStorageError(`local-${mode}`, meta?.key || key, error);
        });
        if (raw == null) return fallback;
        return String(raw);
      }

      function _normalizeStorageMeta(raw) {
        if (raw == null || raw === '') return null;
        try {
          const parsed = typeof raw === 'string' ? JSON.parse(raw) : raw;
          return _normalizeStorageMetaRecord(parsed);
        } catch (error) {
          _reportStorageError('state-meta-parse', STATE_META_KEY, error);
          return null;
        }
      }

      function _normalizeStorageMetaRecord(source) {
        // 基準情報には識別情報のみを保持し、信頼できない祖先情報を再帰的にたどらない。
        function readIdentity(value) {
          if (!value || typeof value !== 'object' || Array.isArray(value)) return null;
          const readNumber = (number) => {
            if (typeof number !== 'number' && typeof number !== 'string') return NaN;
            if (typeof number === 'string' && !number.trim()) return NaN;
            return Number(number);
          };
          const revision = readNumber(value.revision);
          const updatedAt = readNumber(value.updatedAt);
          const writeId = typeof value.writeId === 'string' ? value.writeId.trim() : '';
          if (!Number.isFinite(revision) && !Number.isFinite(updatedAt) && !writeId) return null;
          return {
            revision: Number.isFinite(revision) ? Math.max(0, revision) : 0,
            updatedAt: Number.isFinite(updatedAt) ? Math.max(0, updatedAt) : 0,
            writeId
          };
        }
        const identity = readIdentity(source);
        if (!identity) return null;
        return {
          ...identity,
          writerId: typeof source.writerId === 'string' ? source.writerId.trim() : '',
          base: readIdentity(source.base),
          ...(source.unloadBase ? {
            unloadBase: readIdentity(source.unloadBase) || { revision: 0, updatedAt: 0, writeId: '' }
          } : {})
        };
      }

      function _createStorageMetaIdentity(meta) {
        const normalized = _normalizeStorageMetaRecord(meta);
        return {
          revision: normalized?.revision || 0,
          updatedAt: normalized?.updatedAt || 0,
          writeId: normalized?.writeId || ''
        };
      }

      function _compareStorageMeta(a, b) {
        if (!a && !b) return 0;
        if (a && !b) return 1;
        if (!a && b) return -1;
        if (a.revision !== b.revision) return a.revision - b.revision;
        if (a.updatedAt !== b.updatedAt) return a.updatedAt - b.updatedAt;
        return String(a.writeId || '').localeCompare(String(b.writeId || ''));
      }

      function _isEmptyStorageMeta(meta) {
        const normalized = _normalizeStorageMetaRecord(meta);
        return !normalized
          || (
            normalized.revision === 0
            && normalized.updatedAt === 0
            && !normalized.writeId
          );
      }

      function _isSameStorageMeta(a, b) {
        if (_isEmptyStorageMeta(a) && _isEmptyStorageMeta(b)) return true;
        const left = _normalizeStorageMetaRecord(a);
        const right = _normalizeStorageMetaRecord(b);
        if (!left || !right) return false;
        return left.revision === right.revision
          && left.updatedAt === right.updatedAt
          && (left.writeId || '') === (right.writeId || '');
      }

      function _hasStorageMetaConflictSince(currentMeta, baselineMeta) {
        if (_isSameStorageMeta(currentMeta, baselineMeta)) return false;
        const current = _normalizeStorageMetaRecord(currentMeta);
        const baseline = _normalizeStorageMetaRecord(baselineMeta);
        if (!current || _isEmptyStorageMeta(current)) return false;
        if (!baseline || _isEmptyStorageMeta(baseline)) return true;
        if (current.revision < baseline.revision) return false;
        return true;
      }

      function _isVerifiedCheckpointAncestor(indexedMeta, checkpointMeta) {
        if (!checkpointMeta?.unloadBase || !indexedMeta || indexedMeta.unloadBase) return false;
        if (_isSameStorageMeta(indexedMeta, checkpointMeta)) return true;
        // 同じタブ内の書き込みは順番に実行する。進行中のトランザクションに続いて離脱する場合も、
        // その後に作られた下書きをコミットで失わないようにする。
        return !!checkpointMeta.writerId
          && indexedMeta.writerId === checkpointMeta.writerId
          && indexedMeta.revision > checkpointMeta.unloadBase.revision
          && indexedMeta.revision < checkpointMeta.revision;
      }

      function _getCurrentStorageMeta() {
        return {
          revision: _persistedStateRevision,
          updatedAt: _persistedStateUpdatedAt,
          writeId: _persistedStateWriteId,
          writerId: _persistedStateWriterId,
          ...(_persistedStateUnloadBase ? { unloadBase: _persistedStateUnloadBase } : {})
        };
      }

      function _getStorageMetaFromEntries(entries) {
        if (!Array.isArray(entries)) return null;
        const metaEntry = entries.find(([key]) => key === STATE_META_KEY);
        return _normalizeStorageMeta(metaEntry?.[1]);
      }

      function _hasCurrentStorageMetaChangedSince(meta) {
        return !_isSameStorageMeta(_getCurrentStorageMeta(), meta);
      }

      function _hasAnySnapshotData(values) {
        return PERSISTED_DATA_KEYS.some((key) => {
          const raw = values[key];
          return raw != null && raw !== '';
        });
      }

      function _readLocalStateSnapshot() {
        const values = Object.fromEntries(PERSISTED_STATE_KEYS.map((key) => [
          key,
          _safeStorageGet(LOCAL_STORAGE, key, (mode, error, meta) => {
            _reportStorageError(`local-${mode}`, meta?.key ?? key, error);
          })
        ]));
        return _validatePersistentStateSnapshot({
          source: 'local',
          values,
          meta: _normalizeStorageMeta(values[STATE_META_KEY]),
          hasAnyData: _hasAnySnapshotData(values)
        });
      }

      function _createIndexedStateSnapshot(values) {
        return _validatePersistentStateSnapshot({
          source: 'indexeddb',
          values,
          meta: _normalizeStorageMeta(values[STATE_META_KEY]),
          hasAnyData: _hasAnySnapshotData(values)
        });
      }

      function _validatePersistentStateSnapshot(snapshot) {
        const values = snapshot?.values || {};
        const invalidKeys = [];
        if (!snapshot?.hasAnyData) {
          return { ...snapshot, isValid: true, invalidKeys };
        }

        // 世代付きスナップショットは、欠落のない一つの状態として一括で保存する。
        if (snapshot.meta) {
          PERSISTED_DATA_KEYS.forEach((key) => {
            if (values[key] == null) invalidKeys.push(key);
          });
        }

        const jsonValidators = [
          [TASKS_KEY, Array.isArray],
          [SETTINGS_KEY, (value) => !!value && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value)],
          [TASK_VIEW_KEY, (value) => !!value && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value)]
        ];
        jsonValidators.forEach(([key, validate]) => {
          const raw = values[key];
          if (raw == null) return;
          try {
            if (!validate(JSON.parse(raw))) invalidKeys.push(key);
          } catch {
            invalidKeys.push(key);
          }
        });
        if (values[SIDEBAR_KEY] != null && !['true', 'false'].includes(values[SIDEBAR_KEY])) {
          invalidKeys.push(SIDEBAR_KEY);
        }

        const uniqueInvalidKeys = [...new Set(invalidKeys)];
        return {
          ...snapshot,
          isValid: uniqueInvalidKeys.length === 0,
          invalidKeys: uniqueInvalidKeys
        };
      }

      function _shouldUseIndexedState(localSnapshot, indexedSnapshot) {
        if (!indexedSnapshot.hasAnyData || !indexedSnapshot.isValid) return false;
        if (!localSnapshot.hasAnyData || !localSnapshot.isValid) return true;

        // 離脱時の同期チェックポイントはIndexedDBを未確認のため、時刻や世代番号だけで、
        // 確認済みの基準以降に行われた書き込みより新しいとは判定しない。
        if (
          localSnapshot.meta?.unloadBase
          && !_isVerifiedCheckpointAncestor(indexedSnapshot.meta, localSnapshot.meta)
          && _hasStorageMetaConflictSince(indexedSnapshot.meta, localSnapshot.meta.unloadBase)
        ) return true;

        // localStorageを先に保存していた旧版で分離した、同一世代の保存内容を復元する。
        // 両方がコミット済みを示す場合は、トランザクションを持つIndexedDBを正とする。
        if (!localSnapshot.meta?.unloadBase && indexedSnapshot.meta && localSnapshot.meta
          && indexedSnapshot.meta.revision === localSnapshot.meta.revision
          && !_isSameStorageMeta(indexedSnapshot.meta, localSnapshot.meta)) return true;

        const metaComparison = _compareStorageMeta(indexedSnapshot.meta, localSnapshot.meta);
        if (metaComparison !== 0) return metaComparison > 0;

        return false;
      }

      function _adoptStorageMeta(meta) {
        const normalized = _normalizeStorageMetaRecord(meta);
        if (!normalized) return;
        if (_compareStorageMeta(normalized, _getCurrentStorageMeta()) > 0) {
          _setCurrentStorageMeta(normalized);
        }
      }

      function _createStorageMetaRecord(meta) {
        const normalized = _normalizeStorageMetaRecord(meta);
        const record = {
          version: 1,
          revision: Math.max(0, Number(normalized?.revision) || 0),
          updatedAt: Math.max(0, Number(normalized?.updatedAt) || 0),
          writeId: normalized?.writeId || _createStorageWriteId(),
          writerId: normalized?.writerId || STORAGE_TAB_ID
        };
        if (normalized?.base) {
          record.base = _createStorageMetaIdentity(normalized.base);
        }
        if (normalized?.unloadBase) record.unloadBase = normalized.unloadBase;
        return record;
      }

      function _setCurrentStorageMeta(meta) {
        const normalized = _normalizeStorageMetaRecord(meta);
        _persistedStateRevision = Math.max(0, Number(normalized?.revision) || 0);
        _persistedStateUpdatedAt = Math.max(0, Number(normalized?.updatedAt) || 0);
        _persistedStateWriteId = normalized?.writeId || '';
        _persistedStateWriterId = normalized?.writerId || '';
        _persistedStateUnloadBase = normalized?.unloadBase || null;
      }

      function _createNextStorageMeta(baseMeta = _getCurrentStorageMeta(), options = {}) {
        const normalizedBase = _normalizeStorageMetaRecord(baseMeta) || {
          revision: 0,
          updatedAt: 0,
          writeId: ''
        };
        const now = Date.now();
        const storageMeta = {
          version: 1,
          revision: Math.max(0, normalizedBase.revision) + 1,
          updatedAt: now,
          writeId: _createStorageWriteId(),
          writerId: STORAGE_TAB_ID,
          base: _createStorageMetaIdentity(normalizedBase.unloadBase || normalizedBase)
        };
        if (options.unverified) storageMeta.unloadBase = storageMeta.base;
        _setCurrentStorageMeta(storageMeta);
        return storageMeta;
      }

      function _restoreStorageMeta(meta) {
        _setCurrentStorageMeta(meta);
      }

      function _getDataEntries(entries) {
        if (!Array.isArray(entries)) return [];
        return entries.filter(([key]) => PERSISTED_DATA_KEYS.includes(key));
      }

      function _hasPersistedDataChanges(entries) {
        const dataEntries = _getDataEntries(entries);
        if (dataEntries.length === 0) return false;
        if (!_persistedDataValuesReady) return true;
        return dataEntries.some(([key, value]) => _persistedDataValues.get(key) !== value);
      }

      function _rememberPersistedDataEntries(entries) {
        for (const [key, value] of _getDataEntries(entries)) {
          _persistedDataValues.set(key, value);
        }
        _persistedDataValuesReady = true;
      }

      function _readLocalStorageMeta() {
        if (!LOCAL_STORAGE) return null;
        return _normalizeStorageMeta(_safeStorageGet(LOCAL_STORAGE, STATE_META_KEY, (mode, error, meta) => {
          _reportStorageError(`local-${mode}`, meta?.key || STATE_META_KEY, error);
        }));
      }

      function _isNewerThanPersistedMeta(currentMeta) {
        if (!currentMeta) return false;
        return _compareStorageMeta(currentMeta, _getCurrentStorageMeta()) > 0;
      }

      async function _readIndexedDbStorageMeta() {
        if (!globalThis.indexedDB) return null;
        try {
          const indexedValues = await _readManyFromIndexedDb([STATE_META_KEY]);
          return _normalizeStorageMeta(indexedValues[STATE_META_KEY]);
        } catch (error) {
          _handlePersistentStorageError('indexeddb-read', STATE_META_KEY, error);
          return undefined;
        }
      }

      async function _hasNewerPersistedStorageState(options = {}) {
        // nullは検証失敗を表す。呼び出し元は読み込み警告を維持し、保存を中止する。
        const currentMeta = _getCurrentStorageMeta();
        const indexedConflictBaselineMeta = currentMeta.unloadBase || options?.indexedConflictBaselineMeta || null;
        if (indexedConflictBaselineMeta) {
          const localMeta = _readLocalStorageMeta();
          if (_isNewerThanPersistedMeta(localMeta)) return true;
          // 読み込み結果の欠落や失敗から、未検証チェックポイントの安全性は判断できない。
          if (currentMeta.unloadBase && !globalThis.indexedDB) return true;
          const indexedMeta = await _readIndexedDbStorageMeta();
          if (indexedMeta === undefined) return null;
          if (_isVerifiedCheckpointAncestor(indexedMeta, currentMeta)) return false;
          return _isNewerThanPersistedMeta(indexedMeta)
            || (!_isSameStorageMeta(indexedMeta, currentMeta)
              && _hasStorageMetaConflictSince(indexedMeta, indexedConflictBaselineMeta));
        }
        // 異なる書き込み元の同一世代は、実時刻の前後にかかわらず競合とする。
        // 最新の保存先だけを比較すると、IndexedDBだけに残る同時保存を見落とす。
        if (_hasStorageMetaConflictSince(_readLocalStorageMeta(), currentMeta)) return true;
        const indexedMeta = await _readIndexedDbStorageMeta();
        return indexedMeta === undefined ? null : _hasStorageMetaConflictSince(indexedMeta, currentMeta);
      }

      async function _saveLocalStorageCheckpoint(entries) {
        // メモのチェックポイントも通常保存と同じ一括コミットを使う。最初の入力時ではなく、
        // 非同期の事前確認が終わった後に最新の入力を取得する。
        return _saveStoredState(entries);
      }

      async function _saveStoredState(entries, options = {}) {
        const readDataEntries = () => _getDataEntries(typeof entries === 'function' ? entries() : entries);
        let dataEntries = readDataEntries();
        const firstKey = dataEntries[0]?.[0] || STATE_META_KEY;
        const reportConflict = () => {
          options.onStorageConflict?.();
          _handlePersistentStorageError('storage-conflict', firstKey,
            new Error('別のタブで新しい保存内容が見つかったため、このタブの上書きを止めました。再読み込みしてから続けてください。'));
        };
        if (!_hasPersistedDataChanges(dataEntries) && !_getCurrentStorageMeta().unloadBase) return true;

        const previousMeta = _getCurrentStorageMeta();
        const hasNewerState = await _hasNewerPersistedStorageState(options);
        if (hasNewerState === null) return false;
        if (hasNewerState) {
          reportConflict();
          return false;
        }
        // 離脱時の同期チェックポイントが保存待ちの内容を更新しているため、成功扱いにする前に
        // 最新の下書きを検証する。ローカルの印だけではコミット済みとは見なさない。
        if (_hasCurrentStorageMetaChangedSince(previousMeta)) {
          return _saveStoredState(() => _getPersistedStateEntries(), options);
        }
        if (_hasStorageMetaConflictSince(_readLocalStorageMeta(), previousMeta)) {
          reportConflict();
          return false;
        }
        dataEntries = readDataEntries();
        const useIndexedDb = !!globalThis.indexedDB;
        const pendingMeta = _createNextStorageMeta(previousMeta, { unverified: useIndexedDb });
        const storageMeta = { ...pendingMeta };
        delete storageMeta.unloadBase;
        const entriesWithMeta = [...dataEntries, [STATE_META_KEY, JSON.stringify(storageMeta)]];

        if (useIndexedDb) {
          // この読み書きトランザクションで基準を確認し、全キーを一括で書き込む。
          // 競合や省略により書き込めなかった場合は保存成功としない。
          let indexedOk = false;
          try {
            indexedOk = await _enqueueIndexedDbWrite(entriesWithMeta, { checkpointMeta: previousMeta });
          } catch (error) {
            _lastIndexedDbWriteError = error;
          }
          if (!indexedOk) {
            if (_isSameStorageMeta(_getCurrentStorageMeta(), pendingMeta)) _restoreStorageMeta(previousMeta);
            const error = _lastIndexedDbWriteError || new Error('indexedDB write failed');
            if (error.code === 'storage-conflict') options.onStorageConflict?.();
            _handlePersistentStorageError('storage-write', firstKey, error);
            return false;
          }
        }

        if (_hasCurrentStorageMetaChangedSince(pendingMeta)) {
          // localStorageには離脱時の新しい同期下書きがあるため、検証用の印を保持し、
          // この古いコミット内容で置き換えない。
          _rememberPersistedDataEntries(dataEntries);
          return true;
        }
        if (_hasStorageMetaConflictSince(_readLocalStorageMeta(), previousMeta)) {
          // コミット中に別タブが保存した場合、こちらのIndexedDBへの書き込みは確定していても、
          // localStorageへの複製で別タブの状態を上書きしない。
          _setCurrentStorageMeta(storageMeta);
          _rememberPersistedDataEntries(dataEntries);
          reportConflict();
          return useIndexedDb;
        }
        const localOk = _writeManyToStorage({
          storage: LOCAL_STORAGE,
          entries: entriesWithMeta,
          onError: (mode, error, meta) => _reportStorageError(`local-${mode}`, meta?.key || 'unknown', error)
        });
        if (!localOk && !useIndexedDb) {
          _restoreStorageMeta(previousMeta);
          return false;
        }
        _setCurrentStorageMeta(storageMeta);
        _rememberPersistedDataEntries(dataEntries);
        _setStorageWarning(false);
        return true;
      }

      function _enqueueStoredStateSave(createEntries, options = {}) {
        const readEntries = typeof createEntries === 'function' ? createEntries : () => createEntries;
        const isLocalCheckpoint = options?.localCheckpoint === true;
        const runSave = async () => {
          try {
            if (isLocalCheckpoint) {
              return await _saveLocalStorageCheckpoint(readEntries);
            }
            const entries = readEntries();
            return await _saveStoredState(entries, options);
          } catch (error) {
            _handlePersistentStorageError('storage-write', STATE_META_KEY, error);
            return false;
          }
        };
        _storedStateSaveQueue = _storedStateSaveQueue
          .catch(() => true)
          .then(runSave);
        return _storedStateSaveQueue;
      }

      function _saveLocalStorageForUnload(entries) {
        const dataEntries = _getDataEntries(entries);
        const firstKey = dataEntries[0]?.[0] || STATE_META_KEY;

        if (!_hasPersistedDataChanges(dataEntries)) {
          return {
            ok: true,
            wrote: false,
            indexedConflictBaselineMeta: null
          };
        }

        const previousMeta = _getCurrentStorageMeta();
        const currentLocalMeta = _readLocalStorageMeta();
        if (_hasStorageMetaConflictSince(currentLocalMeta, previousMeta)) {
          _handlePersistentStorageError(
            'storage-conflict',
            firstKey,
            new Error('別のタブで新しい保存内容が見つかったため、このタブの上書きを止めました。再読み込みしてから続けてください。')
          );
          return {
            ok: false,
            wrote: false,
            indexedConflictBaselineMeta: null
          };
        }

        const storageMeta = _createNextStorageMeta(previousMeta, {
          unverified: !!globalThis.indexedDB || !!previousMeta.unloadBase
        });
        const entriesWithMeta = [
          ...dataEntries,
          [STATE_META_KEY, JSON.stringify(storageMeta)]
        ];
        const localSnapshots = new Map();
        for (const [key] of entriesWithMeta) {
          if (localSnapshots.has(key)) continue;
          const snapshot = _snapshotStorageEntry(LOCAL_STORAGE, key, (mode, error, meta) => {
            _reportStorageError(`local-${mode}`, meta?.key || 'unknown', error);
          });
          if (!snapshot.ok) {
            _restoreStorageMeta(previousMeta);
            return {
              ok: false,
              wrote: false,
              indexedConflictBaselineMeta: null
            };
          }
          localSnapshots.set(key, snapshot.value);
        }
        const localOk = _writeManyToStorage({
          storage: LOCAL_STORAGE,
          entries: entriesWithMeta,
          onError: (mode, error, meta) => {
            _reportStorageError(`local-${mode}`, meta?.key || 'unknown', error);
          }
        });

        if (!localOk) {
          _restoreStorageMeta(previousMeta);
          return {
            ok: false,
            wrote: false,
            indexedConflictBaselineMeta: null
          };
        }

        _setStorageWarning(false);
        return {
          ok: true,
          wrote: true,
          indexedConflictBaselineMeta: storageMeta.unloadBase || previousMeta,
          rollbackLocalStorageWrite() {
            // IndexedDBの競合確認中に、後続の保存が完了している場合がある。
            // 今回の仮書き込みだけを取り消し、別タブの新しいデータは戻さない。
            if (
              !_isSameStorageMeta(_readLocalStorageMeta(), storageMeta)
              || !_isSameStorageMeta(_getCurrentStorageMeta(), storageMeta)
            ) {
              return true;
            }
            const rollbackOk = _rollbackStorageWrites(
              LOCAL_STORAGE,
              localSnapshots,
              entriesWithMeta.map(([key]) => key),
              (mode, error, meta) => {
                _reportStorageError(`local-${mode}`, meta?.key || 'unknown', error);
              }
            );
            if (rollbackOk) {
              _restoreStorageMeta(previousMeta);
            }
            return rollbackOk;
          }
        };
      }

      function _mirrorPersistentStorageState(entries, meta, targets = {}) {
        if (!meta) return;
        const entriesWithMeta = [
          ...(Array.isArray(entries) ? entries.filter(([key]) => key !== STATE_META_KEY) : []),
          [STATE_META_KEY, JSON.stringify(_createStorageMetaRecord(meta))]
        ];
        const firstKey = entriesWithMeta[0]?.[0] || STATE_META_KEY;
        const writeMeta = _getStorageMetaFromEntries(entriesWithMeta);

        if (targets.local) {
          const currentLocalMeta = _readLocalStorageMeta();
          if (!_hasStorageMetaConflictSince(currentLocalMeta, writeMeta)) {
            const localOk = _writeManyToStorage({
              storage: LOCAL_STORAGE,
              entries: entriesWithMeta,
              onError: (mode, error, writeMeta) => {
                _reportStorageError(`local-${mode}`, writeMeta?.key || 'unknown', error);
              }

        const retained = new Set(rows);
        for (const row of [...container.children]) {
          if (!retained.has(row)) row.remove();
        }
        let next = container.firstElementChild;
        for (const row of rows) {
          if (row === next) next = next.nextElementSibling;

        $svg.setAttribute('viewBox', '0 0 24 24');

        const ref = `#icon-${resolved}`;

        focusState.pomodoroPhase = snapshot.pomodoroPhase === 'break' ? 'break' : 'focus';
        focusState.pomodoroPhaseEndsAt = typeof snapshot.pomodoroPhaseEndsAt === 'number' ? snapshot.pomodoroPhaseEndsAt : null;
        focusState.pomodoroPhaseRemainingMs = Number(snapshot.pomodoroPhaseRemainingMs) || 0;
        focusState.pomodoroFocusMs = Number(snapshot.pomodoroFocusMs) || 0;
        focusState.pomodoroBreakMs = Number(snapshot.pomodoroBreakMs) || 0;
        syncFocusPauseButton();
        updateFocusTimer();
      }

      function _restoreFocusStateAfterFailedSave(
        appSnapshot,
        focusSnapshot,
        message = '保存できなかったため変更を取り消しました',
        options = {}
      ) {
        const expectedVersion = Number.isInteger(options?.expectedVersion) ? options.expectedVersion : null;
        if (!_canRestoreFailedSaveSnapshot(expectedVersion)) {
          _showSkippedRollbackToast();
          return false;
        }
        _applyAppStateSnapshot(appSnapshot, { preserveRunningFocus: true });
        _applyFocusRuntimeSnapshot(focusSnapshot);
        _markAppStateChanged();
        render();
        showErrorToast(message);
        return true;
      }

      async function _commitFocusStateSave(
        previousState,
        previousFocusState,
        message = '保存できなかったため変更を取り消しました'
      ) {
        setStateSaveOperationPending(true);
        try {
          const restoreVersion = _markAppStateChanged();
          if (await save()) return true;
          _restoreFocusStateAfterFailedSave(previousState, previousFocusState, message, {
            expectedVersion: restoreVersion
          });
          return false;
        } finally {
          setStateSaveOperationPending(false);
        }
      }

      function _isValidDeleteUndoPayload(payload) {
        if (!payload || typeof payload !== 'object') return false;
        const removedParents = Array.isArray(payload.removedParents) ? payload.removedParents : [];
        const removedSubtasks = Array.isArray(payload.removedSubtasks) ? payload.removedSubtasks : [];
        return removedParents.length > 0 || removedSubtasks.length > 0;
      }

      function _createDeleteUndoRestorePlan(payload) {
        if (!_isValidDeleteUndoPayload(payload)) return null;

        const existingParentIds = new Set(tasks.map(task => task.id));
        const plannedParentIds = new Set();
        const plannedParentsById = new Map();
        const restoreParents = [];
        const sortedParents = Array.isArray(payload.removedParents)
          ? payload.removedParents.toSorted((a, b) => (a?.index ?? 0) - (b?.index ?? 0))
          : [];

        for (const entry of sortedParents) {
          const parentId = entry?.task?.id;
          if (!parentId) continue;
          if (existingParentIds.has(parentId) || plannedParentIds.has(parentId)) continue;
          const task = _copyTaskSnapshot(entry.task);
          if (!Array.isArray(task.subtasks)) task.subtasks = [];
          if (task.subtasks.length > MAX_SUBTASK_COUNT_PER_PARENT) {
            return { ok: false, reason: 'subtask-limit' };
          }
          plannedParentIds.add(parentId);
          plannedParentsById.set(parentId, task);
          restoreParents.push({ entry, task });
        }

        if (tasks.length + restoreParents.length > MAX_PARENT_TASK_COUNT) {
          return { ok: false, reason: 'parent-limit' };
        }

        const subtaskCounts = new Map();
        const subtaskIdsByParentId = new Map();
        const ensureSubtaskTracking = (parentId, parent) => {
          if (subtaskIdsByParentId.has(parentId)) return;
          const subtasks = Array.isArray(parent?.subtasks) ? parent.subtasks : [];
          subtaskCounts.set(parentId, subtasks.length);
          subtaskIdsByParentId.set(parentId, new Set(subtasks.map(sub => sub?.id).filter(Boolean)));
        };

        tasks.forEach((task) => ensureSubtaskTracking(task.id, task));
        restoreParents.forEach(({ task }) => ensureSubtaskTracking(task.id, task));

        const restoreSubtasks = [];
        const sortedSubtasks = Array.isArray(payload.removedSubtasks)
          ? payload.removedSubtasks.toSorted((a, b) => (a?.index ?? 0) - (b?.index ?? 0))
          : [];

        for (const entry of sortedSubtasks) {
          const parentId = entry?.parentId;
          const subtaskId = entry?.subtask?.id;
          if (!parentId || !subtaskId) continue;
          const parent = getTask(parentId) || plannedParentsById.get(parentId);
          if (!parent) continue;
          ensureSubtaskTracking(parentId, parent);
          const subtaskIds = subtaskIdsByParentId.get(parentId);
          if (subtaskIds.has(subtaskId)) continue;
          // 子を持たないタスクは、現在の集中セッションが終わるまで実行可能な状態を保つ。
          if (parent.subtasks.length === 0 && parent === getActiveFocusTarget()) {
            return { ok: false, reason: 'active-focus' };
          }
          const nextCount = (subtaskCounts.get(parentId) ?? 0) + 1;
          if (nextCount > MAX_SUBTASK_COUNT_PER_PARENT) {
            return { ok: false, reason: 'subtask-limit' };
          }
          subtaskIds.add(subtaskId);
          subtaskCounts.set(parentId, nextCount);
          restoreSubtasks.push({
            entry,
            parentId,
            subtask: _copyTaskSnapshot(entry.subtask)
          });
        }

        return {
          ok: true,
          restoreParents,
          restoreSubtasks
        };
      }

      function _applyDeleteUndoPayload(payload) {
        const restorePlan = _createDeleteUndoRestorePlan(payload);
        if (!restorePlan) return false;
        if (!restorePlan.ok) {
          if (restorePlan.reason === 'active-focus') return false;
          if (restorePlan.reason === 'parent-limit') {
            showErrorToast(`親タスクは最大${MAX_PARENT_TASK_COUNT}件までです。空きを作ってから元に戻してください`);
          } else {
            showErrorToast(`子タスクは親タスクごとに最大${MAX_SUBTASK_COUNT_PER_PARENT}件までです。空きを作ってから元に戻してください`);
          }
          return false;
        }
        let changed = false;
        const touchedParentIds = new Set();

        restorePlan.restoreParents.forEach(({ entry, task }) => {
          const insertIndex = Number.isInteger(entry.index)
            ? Math.max(0, Math.min(entry.index, tasks.length))
            : tasks.length;
          tasks.splice(insertIndex, 0, task);
          changed = true;
        });

        restorePlan.restoreSubtasks.forEach(({ entry, parentId, subtask }) => {
          const parent = getTask(parentId);
          if (!parent) return;
          if (!Array.isArray(parent.subtasks)) parent.subtasks = [];
          if (parent.subtasks.length === 0) parent.focus = createFocusMeta();
          const insertIndex = Number.isInteger(entry.index)
            ? Math.max(0, Math.min(entry.index, parent.subtasks.length))
            : parent.subtasks.length;
          parent.subtasks.splice(insertIndex, 0, subtask);
          touchedParentIds.add(parentId);
          changed = true;
        });

        touchedParentIds.forEach((parentId) => {
          const parent = getTask(parentId);
          if (parent) syncParentStatus(parent);
        });

        return changed;
      }

      function _runToastDismissHandler() {
        if (typeof _toastDismissHandler !== 'function') {

        const toast = qs('.toast', toastLayer);

            actionPending = true;

        toastHideTimerId = window.setTimeout(() => {
          if (toastSessionId !== _toastSessionId) return;
          toastHideTimerId = null;

        }, durationMs);
      }

      function _hideDeleteUndoToastBySession(sessionId) {

      function _showDeleteUndoToast(message, undoVersion) {

          _deleteUndoToastHideTimerId = null;

        undoBtn?.addEventListener('click', async (event) => {

          if (undoVersion !== _deleteUndoState.version) return;
          const previousState = _createAppStateSnapshot();
          if (!_applyDeleteUndoPayload(_deleteUndoState.payload)) return;
          if (!(await _commitStateSave(previousState, '保存できなかったため元に戻せませんでした'))) return;
          _deleteUndoState.payload = null;
          if (_deleteUndoToastHideTimerId) {
            clearTimeout(_deleteUndoToastHideTimerId);
            _deleteUndoToastHideTimerId = null;
          }

        });
        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
          if (toastSessionId !== _deleteUndoToastSessionId) return;
          toast.classList.add('show');
        });
        _deleteUndoToastHideTimerId = window.setTimeout(() => {
          if (toastSessionId !== _deleteUndoToastSessionId) return;
          _deleteUndoToastHideTimerId = null;
          if (undoVersion === _deleteUndoState.version) {
            _deleteUndoState.payload = null;
          }
          _hideDeleteUndoToastBySession(toastSessionId);

        return true;
      }

      function _registerDeleteUndoToast(message, payload) {
        if (!_isValidDeleteUndoPayload(payload)) return;
        _deleteUndoState.payload = _copyTaskSnapshot(payload);
        _deleteUndoState.version += 1;
        const undoVersion = _deleteUndoState.version;
        if (_showDeleteUndoToast(message, undoVersion)) return;
        showToast(message, {
          type: 'success',
          icon: 'delete',
          durationMs: DELETE_UNDO_WINDOW_MS,
          actionLabel: '元に戻す',
          onAction: async () => {
            if (isStateSaveOperationPending()) return;
            if (undoVersion !== _deleteUndoState.version) return;
            const previousState = _createAppStateSnapshot();
            if (!_applyDeleteUndoPayload(_deleteUndoState.payload)) return;
            if (!(await _commitStateSave(previousState, '保存できなかったため元に戻せませんでした'))) return;
            _deleteUndoState.payload = null;
            render();
            showToast('削除を元に戻しました', { type: 'success', icon: 'undo' });
          },
          onDismiss: () => {

          }
        });
      }

      function _invalidateDeleteUndo() {
        _deleteUndoState.payload = null;
        _deleteUndoState.version += 1;
        _deleteUndoToastSessionId += 1;
        if (_deleteUndoToastHideTimerId) {
          clearTimeout(_deleteUndoToastHideTimerId);
          _deleteUndoToastHideTimerId = null;

      function _isFocusableElement($el) {
        if (!($el instanceof HTMLElement)) return false;
        if ($el.hasAttribute('disabled') || $el.closest('[inert]')) return false;
        if ($el.getAttribute('aria-hidden') === 'true') return false;
        if ($el.getAttribute('tabindex') === '-1') return false;
        return $el.getClientRects().length > 0;
      }

      function _getModalFocusableElements($overlay) {
        if (!$overlay) return [];
        return qsa(MODAL_FOCUSABLE_SELECTOR, $overlay).filter(_isFocusableElement);
      }

      function _getActiveModalOverlay() {
        for (let i = _modalFocusStack.length - 1; i >= 0; i -= 1) {
          const entry = _modalFocusStack[i];
          if (entry?.overlay?.classList.contains('show')) return entry.overlay;
        }
        return null;
      }

      function _focusWithinOverlay($overlay, $preferred = null) {
        if (!$overlay || !$overlay.classList.contains('show')) return;
        if (_getActiveModalOverlay() !== $overlay) return;
        if ($preferred && $overlay.contains($preferred) && _isFocusableElement($preferred)) {
          $preferred.focus();
          return;
        }

        const focusable = _getModalFocusableElements($overlay);
        if (focusable.length > 0) {
          focusable[0].focus();
          return;
        }

        const $dialog = qs('[role="dialog"]', $overlay) || $overlay;
        $dialog.setAttribute('tabindex', '-1');
        $dialog.focus();
      }

      function _captureModalReturnFocus($element) {
        if (!($element instanceof HTMLElement)) return null;
        const rowSelector = ['.modal-subtask-row', '.subtask-item', '.task-item', '.message-item']
          .find((selector) => $element.closest(selector));
        if (!rowSelector) return { elementId: $element.id || null };

        const $row = $element.closest(rowSelector);
        const $scope = rowSelector === '.message-item' ? messageList
          : rowSelector === '.modal-subtask-row' ? modalSubtaskList : taskList;
        return {
          elementId: $element.id || null,
          rowSelector,
          scope: $scope,
          parentId: $row.dataset.parentId || null,
          rowId: $row.dataset.subId || $row.dataset.id,
          rowIndex: qsa(rowSelector, $scope).indexOf($row),
          buttonIndex: qsa('button', $row).indexOf($element.closest('button'))
        };
      }

      function _resolveModalReturnFocus(entry, $activeOverlay = null) {
        const canFocus = ($element) => !!$element?.isConnected
          && _isFocusableElement($element)
          && (!$activeOverlay || $activeOverlay.contains($element));
        if (canFocus(entry?.returnFocusEl)) return entry.returnFocusEl;

        const target = entry?.returnFocusTarget;
        if (target?.elementId) {
          const $element = document.getElementById(target.elementId);
          if (canFocus($element)) return $element;
        }
        if (!target?.rowSelector) return null;

        const rows = qsa(target.rowSelector, target.scope);
        const $row = (target.rowId && rows.find((row) => (
          (row.dataset.subId || row.dataset.id) === target.rowId
          && (row.dataset.parentId || null) === target.parentId
        ))) || rows[Math.min(Math.max(0, target.rowIndex), rows.length - 1)];
        if (!$row) return null;

        const buttons = qsa('button', $row);
        const $sameControl = buttons[target.buttonIndex];
        if (canFocus($sameControl)) return $sameControl;
        return buttons.find(canFocus) || null;
      }

      function _restoreFocusAfterPending(entry) {
        if (isStateSaveOperationPending()) return;
        const $activeElement = document.activeElement;
        // 保存待ちの間にユーザーが別の操作先を選んだ場合は、その選択を保つ。
        if ($activeElement && $activeElement !== document.body && $activeElement !== entry.returnFocusEl) return;
        const $target = _resolveModalReturnFocus(entry, _getActiveModalOverlay());
        $target?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
      }

      function syncModalInteractivity() {
        const pending = isStateSaveOperationPending();
        const activeOverlay = _getActiveModalOverlay();
        appShell.toggleAttribute('inert', pending || !!activeOverlay);
        qsa('.modal-overlay, .focus-overlay').forEach(overlay => {
          overlay.toggleAttribute('inert', pending || (!!activeOverlay && overlay !== activeOverlay));
        });
      }

      function _openModalOverlay($overlay, $preferredFocus = null, $returnFocusEl = document.activeElement) {
        if (!$overlay || $overlay.classList.contains('show')) return;

        _modalFocusStack.push({
          overlay: $overlay,
          returnFocusEl: $returnFocusEl instanceof HTMLElement ? $returnFocusEl : null,
          returnFocusTarget: _captureModalReturnFocus($returnFocusEl)
        });

        $overlay.classList.add('show');
        $overlay.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
        syncModalInteractivity();
        requestAnimationFrame(() => _focusWithinOverlay($overlay, $preferredFocus));
      }

      function _closeModalOverlay($overlay) {

        for (let i = _modalFocusStack.length - 1; i >= 0; i -= 1) {
          if (_modalFocusStack[i]?.overlay === $overlay) {
            [modalEntry] = _modalFocusStack.splice(i, 1);
            break;
          }
        }

        $overlay.classList.remove('show');
        $overlay.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
        syncModalInteractivity();

        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
          if (!modalEntry || $overlay.classList.contains('show')) return;
          const $activeOverlay = _getActiveModalOverlay();
          const $returnFocusEl = _resolveModalReturnFocus(modalEntry, $activeOverlay);
          if ($returnFocusEl) {
            $returnFocusEl.focus();
            return;
          }

          if ($activeOverlay) {
            _focusWithinOverlay($activeOverlay);
          } else if (modalEntry && _isFocusableElement(taskInput)) {
            taskInput.focus();
          }
        });
      }

      function _trapFocusInOverlay(event, $overlay) {
        if (!$overlay || event.key !== 'Tab') return;
        const focusable = _getModalFocusableElements($overlay);
        if (focusable.length === 0) {
          event.preventDefault();
          return;
        }

        const first = focusable[0];
        const last = focusable[focusable.length - 1];
        const activeElement = document.activeElement;
        const isInsideOverlay = activeElement instanceof HTMLElement && $overlay.contains(activeElement);

        if (event.shiftKey) {
          if (!isInsideOverlay || activeElement === first) {
            event.preventDefault();
            last.focus();
          }
          return;
        }

        if (!isInsideOverlay || activeElement === last) {
          event.preventDefault();
          first.focus();
        }
      }

      function _resolveTooltipTarget(node) {

      function _isIconOnlyButton($el) {
        if (!($el instanceof HTMLButtonElement)) return false;

        const ICON_DECORATION_SELECTOR = '.material-symbols-outlined, svg, .theme-dot';
        const walker = document.createTreeWalker($el, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT);
        for (let node = walker.nextNode(); node; node = walker.nextNode()) {

      function _hideQuickTooltip() {

      function _isTooltipAnchorActive($anchor) {

      function _positionQuickTooltip() {

        const $anchor = _tooltipState.anchorEl;
        if (!_isTooltipAnchorActive($anchor) || !_isIconOnlyButton($anchor)) {
          _hideQuickTooltip();
          return;
        }
        if ($quickTooltip.hidden) return;

        const message = _extractTooltipText($anchor);
        if (!message) {
          _hideQuickTooltip();

        const anchorRect = $anchor.getBoundingClientRect();
        if (anchorRect.width <= 0 && anchorRect.height <= 0) {

        const tooltipRect = $quickTooltip.getBoundingClientRect();
        const clamp = (value, min, max) => {

        };
        let placement = 'top';
        let top = anchorRect.top - tooltipRect.height - TOOLTIP_OFFSET_PX;

        }
        top = clamp(
          top,
          TOOLTIP_VIEWPORT_PADDING_PX,
          window.innerHeight - tooltipRect.height - TOOLTIP_VIEWPORT_PADDING_PX
        );

        let left = anchorRect.left + (anchorRect.width / 2) - (tooltipRect.width / 2);
        left = clamp(
          left,
          TOOLTIP_VIEWPORT_PADDING_PX,
          window.innerWidth - tooltipRect.width - TOOLTIP_VIEWPORT_PADDING_PX
        );

        $quickTooltip.style.top = `${Math.round(top)}px`;
        $quickTooltip.dataset.placement = placement;

      function _queueQuickTooltipPosition() {

      function _showQuickTooltip($target) {
        if (!$quickTooltip || !_isIconOnlyButton($target)) return;
