      }

      function renderTaskCountFavicon(taskCount) {
        if (!_faviconCtx || !_faviconLink) return;
        const count = Number.isFinite(taskCount) ? Math.max(0, Math.floor(taskCount)) : 0;
        if (_lastFaviconBadgeCount === count) return;
        _lastFaviconBadgeCount = count;

        const size = FAVICON_SIZE;
        const ctx = _faviconCtx;
        ctx.clearRect(0, 0, size, size);

        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.roundRect(3, 3, size - 6, size - 6, 15);
        ctx.fillStyle = count > 0 ? '#e5484d' : '#5f6a85';
        ctx.fill();

        const displayText = count > MAX_FAVICON_BADGE_COUNT ? `${MAX_FAVICON_BADGE_COUNT}+` : String(count);
        const fontSize = displayText.length >= 3 ? 23 : displayText.length === 2 ? 30 : 40;
        ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
        ctx.font = `800 ${fontSize}px "Noto Sans JP", sans-serif`;
        ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
        ctx.fillText(displayText, size / 2, size / 2 + 1);

        _faviconLink.type = 'image/png';
        _faviconLink.href = _faviconCanvas.toDataURL('image/png');

      function normalizeInputText(value, maxLength) {
        if (typeof value !== 'string' && !(typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value))) return '';
        const raw = String(value ?? '').trim();
        if (!raw) return '';
        if (!Number.isFinite(maxLength) || maxLength <= 0) return raw;
        return raw.slice(0, maxLength).replace(/[\uD800-\uDBFF]$/, '');
      }

      function normalizeNonNegativeNumber(value, fallback = 0) {
        if (typeof value !== 'number' && typeof value !== 'string') return fallback;
        if (typeof value === 'string' && !value.trim()) return fallback;
        const numeric = Number(value);
        if (!Number.isFinite(numeric) || numeric < 0) return fallback;
        return numeric;
      }

      function normalizeEntityId(value, seenIds) {
        const raw = typeof value === 'string' || (typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value))
          ? String(value).trim()
          : '';
        if (SAFE_ENTITY_ID_PATTERN.test(raw) && !seenIds.has(raw)) {
          seenIds.add(raw);
          return raw;
        }
        let nextId = uid();
        while (seenIds.has(nextId)) {
          nextId = uid();
        }
        seenIds.add(nextId);
        return nextId;
      }

      function normalizeMessageList(list) {
        if (!Array.isArray(list)) return [];
        const messages = [];
        for (const value of list) {
          if (messages.length >= MAX_MESSAGE_COUNT) break;
          const message = normalizeInputText(value, MAX_MESSAGE_TEXT_LENGTH);
          if (message) messages.push(message);
        }
        return messages;
      }

      function normalizePomodoroMinutes(value, fallback, min, max) {
        if (typeof value !== 'number' && typeof value !== 'string') return fallback;
        if (typeof value === 'string' && !value.trim()) return fallback;
        const numeric = Number(value);
        if (!Number.isFinite(numeric)) return fallback;
        const rounded = Math.round(numeric);
        if (!Number.isFinite(rounded)) return fallback;
        return Math.min(max, Math.max(min, rounded));
      }

      function normalizePomodoroSettings(saved = {}) {
        const source = saved && typeof saved === 'object' && !Array.isArray(saved)
          ? saved
          : {};
        return {
          enabled: typeof source.enabled === 'boolean' ? source.enabled : false,
          focusMinutes: normalizePomodoroMinutes(
            source.focusMinutes,
            DEFAULT_POMODORO_FOCUS_MINUTES,
            MIN_POMODORO_MINUTES,
            MAX_POMODORO_FOCUS_MINUTES
          ),
          breakMinutes: normalizePomodoroMinutes(
            source.breakMinutes,
            DEFAULT_POMODORO_BREAK_MINUTES,
            MIN_POMODORO_MINUTES,
            MAX_POMODORO_BREAK_MINUTES

      }

      function createFocusMeta(meta = {}) {
        const source = meta && typeof meta === 'object' ? meta : {};
        const focusState = source.focusState === 'running'
          || source.focusState === 'paused'
          || source.focusState === 'idle'
          ? source.focusState
          : 'idle';
        const startedAt = source.startedAt === null || source.startedAt === undefined || source.startedAt === ''
          ? null
          : normalizeNonNegativeNumber(source.startedAt, null);
        return {
          focusState, // 未開始（idle）・実行中（running）・一時停止（paused）

          normalized.startedAt = null;

      }

      function normalizeSettings(saved = {}) {

          : {};

        const colorMode = source.colorMode === 'dark' ? 'dark' : 'light';
        const themeColor = typeof source.themeColor === 'string' && THEME_IDS.has(source.themeColor)
          ? source.themeColor
          : DEFAULT_THEME_COLOR;

          colorMode,
          themeColor,
          sound: typeof source.sound === 'boolean' ? source.sound : true,
          celebration: typeof source.celebration === 'boolean' ? source.celebration : true,

          pomodoro: normalizePomodoroSettings(source.pomodoro)

      function normalizeTaskViewState(saved = {}) {

      function loadTaskViewState() {

        } catch (error) {
          _handlePersistentStorageError(`${source}-parse`, key, error);

        }

            key: TASKS_KEY,
            raw: rawState[TASKS_KEY],
            fallback: tasks,
            validate: Array.isArray,
            source

        if (rawState[SETTINGS_KEY] != null && rawState[SETTINGS_KEY] !== '') {

            key: SETTINGS_KEY,
            raw: rawState[SETTINGS_KEY],
            fallback: settings,
            validate: (value) => typeof value === 'object' && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value),
            source

            key: TASK_VIEW_KEY,
            raw: rawState[TASK_VIEW_KEY],
            fallback: taskViewState,
            validate: (value) => typeof value === 'object' && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value),

          [ORGANIZE_MEMO_KEY, organizeMemo],

          .filter((snapshot) => snapshot.hasAnyData && !snapshot.isValid);
        invalidSnapshots.forEach((snapshot) => {
          _handlePersistentStorageError(

              entries: PERSISTED_STATE_KEYS.map((key) => [key, selectedSnapshot.values[key]]),

        const text = limitStatus ? `${label} ${limitStatus}` : label;

            task.focus.elapsedMs += Math.max(0, nowMs - task.focus.startedAt);
            task.focus.startedAt = nowMs;

          .catch((error) => {

              if (!rollbackOk) {

                  'storage-rollback',
                  entries[0]?.[0] || STATE_META_KEY,
                  new Error('localStorage rollback failed')

              }
            }
            _handlePersistentStorageError('storage-write', entries[0]?.[0] || STATE_META_KEY, error);

      async function checkpointActiveFocusElapsed(nowMs = Date.now()) {

          && nowMs - focusState.lastCheckpointAt < FOCUS_CHECKPOINT_INTERVAL_MS) {
          return false;

        focusState.lastCheckpointAt = nowMs;
        const previousState = _createAppStateSnapshot();
        const previousFocusState = _createFocusRuntimeSnapshot();
        const changed = syncRunningFocusElapsedForPersist(nowMs);

      function _isObjectRecord(value) {

      function createBackupPayload() {

          exportedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
          data: {

            settings,
            sidebarCollapsed: !!isSidebarCollapsed,
            organizeMemo,
            taskView: taskViewState

        };

      function normalizeBackupPayload(payload) {

        }

          throw new Error('このアプリのバックアップJSONではありません。');
        }
        if (!_isObjectRecord(payload.data)) {
          throw new Error('バックアップJSONに復元データがありません。');
        }

        const { data } = payload;
        if (!Array.isArray(data.tasks)) {
          throw new Error('バックアップJSONのタスク形式が正しくありません。');
        }
        if (!_isObjectRecord(data.settings)) {
          throw new Error('バックアップJSONの設定形式が正しくありません。');
        }
        if (typeof data.sidebarCollapsed !== 'boolean') {
          throw new Error('バックアップJSONのサイドバー状態が正しくありません。');
        }
        if (typeof data.organizeMemo !== 'string') {
          throw new Error('バックアップJSONの整理メモ形式が正しくありません。');
        }
        if (!_isObjectRecord(data.taskView)) {
          throw new Error('バックアップJSONの表示設定形式が正しくありません。');
        }

          settings: normalizeSettings(data.settings),
          sidebarCollapsed: data.sidebarCollapsed,
          organizeMemo: normalizeOrganizeMemo(data.organizeMemo),
          taskView: normalizeTaskViewState(data.taskView)

      function _applyNormalizedBackupPayload(normalized) {

        settings = normalized.settings;

        organizeMemo = normalized.organizeMemo;
        taskViewState.filter = normalized.taskView.filter;
        if (organizeMemoInput) organizeMemoInput.value = organizeMemo;
        applySidebarState();
        setMemoSaveStatus('saved');
      }

      function buildImportBackupConfirmMessage(normalized) {
        const currentCounts = formatBulkDeleteCountText(getTaskStructureCounts(tasks));
        const incomingCounts = formatBulkDeleteCountText(getTaskStructureCounts(normalized.tasks));
        return [
          `現在の${currentCounts}を、バックアップの${incomingCounts}に置き換えます。`,
          `整理メモ ${organizeMemo.length}文字 → ${normalized.organizeMemo.length}文字 / 完了メッセージ ${settings.messages.length}件 → ${normalized.settings.messages.length}件`,
          '読み込み前の状態は一時的に元に戻せます。読み込みますか？'
        ].join('\n');
      }

      function _registerImportUndoToast(snapshot) {
        _importUndoState.snapshot = _copyTaskSnapshot(snapshot);
        _importUndoState.version += 1;
        _importUndoState.appStateVersion = _appStateVersion;
        const undoVersion = _importUndoState.version;
        const undoAppStateVersion = _importUndoState.appStateVersion;
        showToast('バックアップを読み込みました', {
          type: 'success',
          icon: 'playlist_add',
          durationMs: DELETE_UNDO_WINDOW_MS,
          actionLabel: '元に戻す',
          onAction: async () => {
            if (isStateSaveOperationPending()) return;
            if (undoVersion !== _importUndoState.version) return;
            if (_appStateVersion !== undoAppStateVersion) {
              _importUndoState.snapshot = null;
              _importUndoState.appStateVersion = null;
              _importUndoState.version += 1;
              showErrorToast('読み込み後に変更があるため元に戻せません');
              return;
            }
            const undoSnapshot = _copyTaskSnapshot(_importUndoState.snapshot);
            const currentSnapshot = _createAppStateSnapshot();
            _applyAppStateSnapshot(undoSnapshot);
            if (!(await _commitStateSave(currentSnapshot, '保存できなかったため元に戻せませんでした'))) return;
            _importUndoState.snapshot = null;
            _importUndoState.appStateVersion = null;
            render();
            showToast('読み込み前の状態に戻しました', { type: 'success', icon: 'undo' });
          },
          onDismiss: () => {
            if (undoVersion !== _importUndoState.version) return;
            _importUndoState.snapshot = null;
            _importUndoState.appStateVersion = null;
          }
        });
      }

      async function performImportBackup(normalized) {
        if (!normalized || isStateSaveOperationPending()) return false;
        const previousState = _createAppStateSnapshot();
        _applyNormalizedBackupPayload(normalized);
        if (!(await _commitStateSave(previousState, '保存できなかったためバックアップを読み込めませんでした'))) return false;
        _invalidateDeleteUndo();
        messageEditorState.editIndex = null;
        messageEditorState.draft = null;
        render();
        _registerImportUndoToast(previousState);
        return true;
      }

      function exportBackup() {
        syncRunningFocusElapsedForPersist();
        const payload = createBackupPayload();
        const json = JSON.stringify(payload, null, 2);
        const blob = new Blob([json], { type: 'application/json' });
        const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        const link = document.createElement('a');
        const stamp = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
        link.href = url;
        link.download = `yaruyan-todo-backup-${stamp}.json`;
        document.body.append(link);
        link.click();
        link.remove();
        window.setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 0);

      }

      async function importBackupFile(file) {
        if (!file || isStateSaveOperationPending()) return false;
        const requestId = ++backupImportRequestId;
        try {
          if (Number.isFinite(file.size) && file.size > MAX_BACKUP_FILE_BYTES) {
            throw new Error(`バックアップJSONは${formatFileSize(MAX_BACKUP_FILE_BYTES)}以下のファイルを選択してください。`);
          }
          const text = await file.text();
          if (requestId !== backupImportRequestId || isStateSaveOperationPending()) return false;
          const parsed = JSON.parse(text);
          const normalized = normalizeBackupPayload(parsed);
          return openConfirmModal(buildImportBackupConfirmMessage(normalized), 'import-backup', { normalized });
        } catch (error) {
          if (requestId !== backupImportRequestId) return false;
          showErrorToast(error?.message || 'バックアップを読み込めませんでした');
          return false;

        if (organizeMemoSaveTimerId !== null) {

          organizeMemoInput.value = organizeMemo;
          return;
        }
        const nextMemo = normalizeOrganizeMemo(organizeMemoInput.value);
        if (!organizeMemoComposing && organizeMemoInput.value !== nextMemo) {
          organizeMemoInput.value = nextMemo;
        }
        if (organizeMemo !== nextMemo) {
          organizeMemo = nextMemo;
          _markAppStateChanged();
        }
        void persistOrganizeMemoLocalCheckpoint();
        scheduleOrganizeMemoSave();
      }

      function handleOrganizeMemoBlur() {
        if (!_persistentStorageInitialized) return;
        // ページや入力欄がフォーカスを失うと、compositionendが発火しないIMEがある。
        if (organizeMemoComposing) {
          organizeMemoComposing = false;
          if (activeCompositionTarget === organizeMemoInput) activeCompositionTarget = null;
          handleOrganizeMemoInput();

      function initializeOrganizeMemoInput() {
        if (!organizeMemoInput) return;
        organizeMemoInput.readOnly = true;

        organizeMemoInput.addEventListener('compositionend', () => {

          handleOrganizeMemoInput();
        });
        organizeMemoInput.addEventListener('input', handleOrganizeMemoInput);
        organizeMemoInput.addEventListener('blur', handleOrganizeMemoBlur);

      function finishPersistentStorageInitialization() {
        _persistentStorageInitialized = true;
        if (!organizeMemoInput) return;

      function normalizeTasks(list, options = {}) {
        if (!Array.isArray(list)) return [];
        const normalizeFocus = options?.preserveRunningFocus ? createFocusMeta : normalizeFocusMeta;
        const parentIds = new Set();
        const normalizedTasks = [];

        for (const task of list) {
          if (normalizedTasks.length >= MAX_PARENT_TASK_COUNT) break;
          if (!task || typeof task !== 'object' || Array.isArray(task)) continue;
          const text = normalizeInputText(task.text, MAX_TASK_TEXT_LENGTH);
          if (!text) continue;

          const subtaskIds = new Set();
          const subtasks = [];
          if (Array.isArray(task.subtasks)) {
            for (const sub of task.subtasks) {
              if (subtasks.length >= MAX_SUBTASK_COUNT_PER_PARENT) break;
              if (!sub || typeof sub !== 'object' || Array.isArray(sub)) continue;
              const subtaskText = normalizeInputText(sub.text, MAX_SUBTASK_TEXT_LENGTH);
              if (!subtaskText) continue;
              subtasks.push({
                id: normalizeEntityId(sub.id, subtaskIds),
                text: subtaskText,
                done: sub.done === true,
                focus: normalizeFocus(sub.focus)
              });
            }
          }
          const hasNormalizedSubtasks = subtasks.length > 0;

          normalizedTasks.push({
            id: normalizeEntityId(task.id, parentIds),
            text,
            done: hasNormalizedSubtasks ? subtasks.every(sub => sub.done) : task.done === true,
            focus: hasNormalizedSubtasks ? createFocusMeta() : normalizeFocus(task.focus),
            subtasks
          });
        }

        return normalizedTasks;
      }

      function hasSubtasks(task) {
        return Array.isArray(task.subtasks) && task.subtasks.length > 0;
      }

      function isLeafParent(task) {
        return !hasSubtasks(task);
      }

      function isRunnableParent(task) {
        return isLeafParent(task);
      }

      function syncParentStatus(task) {
        if (!hasSubtasks(task)) return task.done;
        task.done = task.subtasks.every(sub => sub.done);
        return task.done;
      }

      function syncAllParents() {
        tasks.forEach(syncParentStatus);
      }

      function getTask(id) {
        return tasks.find(t => t.id === id);
      }

      function getSubtask(parentId, subId) {
        return getTask(parentId)?.subtasks.find(({ id }) => id === subId) ?? null;
      }

      function getTarget(type, parentId, subtaskId = null) {
        if (type === 'parent') return getTask(parentId);
        if (type === 'subtask') return getSubtask(parentId, subtaskId);
        return null;
      }

      function getMessages() {
        return settings.messages.length > 0 ? settings.messages : defaultMessages;
      }

      function getElapsedMs(focusMeta, nowMs = Date.now()) {
        if (!focusMeta) return 0;
        if (focusMeta.focusState === 'running' && typeof focusMeta.startedAt === 'number') {
          return focusMeta.elapsedMs + Math.max(0, nowMs - focusMeta.startedAt);
        }
        return focusMeta.elapsedMs;
      }

      function formatElapsed(ms) {
        const totalSec = Math.max(0, Math.floor(ms / 1000));
        const h = Math.floor(totalSec / 3600).toString().padStart(2, '0');
        const m = Math.floor((totalSec % 3600) / 60).toString().padStart(2, '0');
        const s = (totalSec % 60).toString().padStart(2, '0');
        return `${h}:${m}:${s}`;
      }

      function formatAchievementElapsed(ms) {
        const normalizedMs = Number.isFinite(ms) ? Math.max(0, ms) : 0;
        const totalMinutes = normalizedMs === 0 ? 0 : Math.max(1, Math.ceil(normalizedMs / 60000));
        const h = Math.floor(totalMinutes / 60).toString().padStart(2, '0');
        const m = (totalMinutes % 60).toString().padStart(2, '0');
        return `${h}:${m}`;
      }

      function getProgressStats() {
        let total = 0;
        let completed = 0;

        for (const task of tasks) {
          const workItems = hasSubtasks(task) ? task.subtasks : [task];
          total += workItems.length;
          for (const { done } of workItems) {
            if (done) completed += 1;
          }
        }

        return {
          total,
          completed,
          pct: total > 0 ? Math.round((completed / total) * 100) : 0
        };
      }

      function getTaskStructureCounts(taskList = tasks) {
        const sourceTasks = Array.isArray(taskList) ? taskList : [];
        const parentCount = sourceTasks.length;
        const subtaskCount = sourceTasks.reduce(
          (count, task) => count + (hasSubtasks(task) ? task.subtasks.length : 0),
          0
        );
        return { parentCount, subtaskCount, totalCount: parentCount + subtaskCount };
      }

      function shouldClearCompletedItem(done, filterId = taskViewState.filter) {
        return !!done && matchesTaskFilter(done, filterId);
      }

      function getClearCompletedDeleteCounts(filterId = taskViewState.filter) {
        let parentCount = 0;
        let subtaskCount = 0;
        for (const task of tasks) {
          if (hasSubtasks(task)) {
            let completedCount = 0;
            for (const sub of task.subtasks) {
              if (shouldClearCompletedItem(sub.done, filterId)) completedCount += 1;
            }
            subtaskCount += completedCount;
            if (completedCount === task.subtasks.length) parentCount += 1;
          } else if (shouldClearCompletedItem(task.done, filterId)) {
            parentCount += 1;
          }
        }
        return { parentCount, subtaskCount, totalCount: parentCount + subtaskCount };
      }

      function formatBulkDeleteCountText(counts) {
        const parentCount = Math.max(0, Number(counts?.parentCount) || 0);
        const subtaskCount = Math.max(0, Number(counts?.subtaskCount) || 0);
        const totalCount = Math.max(0, Number(counts?.totalCount) || parentCount + subtaskCount);
        if (parentCount > 0 && subtaskCount > 0) {
          return `親タスク${parentCount}件・子タスク${subtaskCount}件（合計${totalCount}件）`;
        }
        if (parentCount > 0) return `親タスク${parentCount}件`;
        if (subtaskCount > 0) return `子タスク${subtaskCount}件`;
        return '0件';
      }

      function matchesTaskFilter(done, filterId = taskViewState.filter) {
        if (filterId === 'pending') return !done;
        if (filterId === 'completed') return !!done;
        return true;
      }

      function normalizeTaskSearchText(value) {
        return String(value ?? '').normalize('NFKC').toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
      }

      function matchesTaskSearch(text, query = taskSearchQuery) {
        if (query === '') return true;
        return normalizeTaskSearchText(text).includes(normalizeTaskSearchText(query));
      }

      function isTaskSearchActive() {
        return normalizeTaskSearchText(taskSearchQuery).length > 0;
      }

      function resetTaskSearch() {
        taskSearchQuery = '';
        taskSearchInput.value = '';
      }

      function handleTaskSearchInput(event) {
        if (event.isComposing || isStateSaveOperationPending()) return;
        const query = normalizeTaskSearchText(taskSearchInput.value);
        if (query === taskSearchQuery) return;
        taskSearchQuery = query;
        render();
      }

      function getFilteredSubtasks(task, filterId = taskViewState.filter, query = taskSearchQuery) {
        if (!hasSubtasks(task)) return [];
        const normalizedQuery = normalizeTaskSearchText(query);
        const parentMatches = normalizedQuery === ''
          || normalizeTaskSearchText(task.text).includes(normalizedQuery);
        return task.subtasks.filter((sub) => matchesTaskFilter(sub.done, filterId)
          && (parentMatches || normalizeTaskSearchText(sub.text).includes(normalizedQuery)));
      }

      function isTaskVisible(task, filterId = taskViewState.filter, query = taskSearchQuery) {
        return hasSubtasks(task)
          ? getFilteredSubtasks(task, filterId, query).length > 0
          : matchesTaskFilter(task.done, filterId) && matchesTaskSearch(task.text, query);
      }

      function getVisibleParentTaskIds(filterId = taskViewState.filter) {
        return tasks
          .filter((task) => isTaskVisible(task, filterId))
          .map((task) => task.id);
      }

      function getVisibleSubtaskIds(parent, filterId = taskViewState.filter) {
        return getFilteredSubtasks(parent, filterId).map((sub) => sub.id);
      }

      function getVisibleMoveTargetId(visibleIds, sourceId, offset) {
        if (!Array.isArray(visibleIds) || !Number.isInteger(offset) || offset === 0) return null;
        const sourceIndex = visibleIds.indexOf(sourceId);
        if (sourceIndex < 0) return null;
        const targetIndex = Math.max(0, Math.min(sourceIndex + offset, visibleIds.length - 1));
        if (targetIndex === sourceIndex) return null;
        return visibleIds[targetIndex] || null;
      }

      function syncTaskFilterButtons() {
        if (!taskFilterGroup) return;
        qsa('.task-filter-btn', taskFilterGroup).forEach((btn) => {
          const isActive = btn.dataset.taskFilter === taskViewState.filter;
          btn.classList.toggle('is-active', isActive);
          btn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(isActive));
        });
      }

      async function setTaskFilter(filterId) {
        if (isStateSaveOperationPending()) return false;
        const nextFilter = TASK_FILTER_IDS.has(filterId) ? filterId : 'all';
        if (taskViewState.filter === nextFilter) return;
        const previousState = _createAppStateSnapshot();
        taskViewState.filter = nextFilter;
        if (!(await _commitStateSave(previousState))) return;
        render();
      }

      function getPendingTaskCount() {
        const { total, completed } = getProgressStats();
        return Math.max(0, total - completed);
      }

      function updateDocumentTaskIndicators() {
        const pendingCount = getPendingTaskCount();
        document.title = pendingCount > 0 ? `${BASE_PAGE_TITLE} (${pendingCount})` : BASE_PAGE_TITLE;
        renderTaskCountFavicon(pendingCount);
      }

      function isAllDone() {
        const { total, completed } = getProgressStats();
        return total > 0 && total === completed;
      }

      function applyColorMode() {
        const nextColorMode = settings.colorMode === 'dark' ? 'dark' : 'light';
        settings.colorMode = nextColorMode;
        if (document.documentElement.dataset.mode !== nextColorMode) {
          document.documentElement.dataset.mode = nextColorMode;

      function applyThemeColor() {

        settings.themeColor = nextTheme;
        if (document.documentElement.dataset.theme !== nextTheme) {
          document.documentElement.dataset.theme = nextTheme;

      }

      function isCompactSidebarViewport() {
        return compactSidebarQuery.matches;

      function applySidebarState() {

      /* ============================================
         画面遷移（SPA・ハッシュ方式）
      ============================================ */
      const VALID_ROUTES = ['tasks', 'memo', 'settings'];

      function getRouteFromHash() {
        const hash = location.hash.replace(/^#\/?/, '');
        return VALID_ROUTES.includes(hash) ? hash : 'tasks';
      }

      function navigate(route) {
        const target = VALID_ROUTES.includes(route) ? route : 'tasks';
        if (location.hash !== `#/${target}`) {
          location.hash = `#/${target}`;
          return;
        }
        renderRoute(target);
      }

      function renderRoute(route) {
        if (route === 'tasks' && renderRoute.tasksDirty) {
          renderTasks();
          renderRoute.tasksDirty = false;
        }
        const routeChanged = renderRoute.currentRoute != null && renderRoute.currentRoute !== route;
        renderRoute.currentRoute = route;
        for (const page of qsa('.page')) {
          page.classList.toggle('active', page.id === `page-${route}`);
        }

        navButtons.forEach(btn => {

          if (btn.dataset.route === route) btn.setAttribute('aria-current', 'page');
          else btn.removeAttribute('aria-current');
        });

          renderSettings();

          closeBulkActions();

            const heading = qs(`#page-${route} h1`);
            heading.setAttribute('tabindex', '-1');
            heading.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            window.scrollTo({ top: 0, left: 0, behavior: 'instant' });
          }
        }
      }

      window.addEventListener('hashchange', () => {
        navigate(getRouteFromHash());
      });

      /* ============================================
         効果音
      ============================================ */
      function getAudioCtx() {
        if (!audioCtx || audioCtx.state === 'closed') {
          audioCtx = new window.AudioContext({ latencyHint: 'interactive' });
          _audioMasterGainNode = null;
          _audioPrimed = false;
        }
        return audioCtx;
      }

      function _getAudioOutputNode(ctx = getAudioCtx()) {
        if (!ctx) return null;
        if (!_audioMasterGainNode) {
          const masterGain = ctx.createGain();
          masterGain.gain.setValueAtTime(MASTER_SOUND_GAIN, ctx.currentTime);
          masterGain.connect(ctx.destination);
          _audioMasterGainNode = masterGain;
        }
        return _audioMasterGainNode;
      }

      function _withRunningAudio(onReady) {
        if (!settings.sound) return;
        try {
          const ctx = getAudioCtx();
          const run = () => {
            if (ctx.state !== 'running' || !settings.sound) return;
            try {
              onReady(ctx);
            } catch {}
          };

          if (ctx.state === 'running') {
            run();
            return;
          }

          ctx.resume().then(run).catch(() => {});
        } catch {}
      }

      function _primeAudioContext() {
        _withRunningAudio((ctx) => {
          if (_audioPrimed) return;
          const now = ctx.currentTime + 0.0005;
          try {
            const output = _getAudioOutputNode(ctx);
            if (!output) return;
            const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
            const gain = ctx.createGain();
            gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.00001, now);
            osc.connect(gain).connect(output);
            osc.start(now);
            osc.stop(now + 0.008);
            _audioPrimed = true;
          } catch {}
        });
      }

      function _clampAudioPan(value) {
        if (!Number.isFinite(value)) return 0;
        return Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, value));
      }

      function _connectToOutputWithPan({
        ctx = getAudioCtx(),
        source,
        output = _getAudioOutputNode(ctx),
        pan = 0,
        time = ctx?.currentTime || 0
      }) {
        if (!ctx || !source || !output) return;
        if (typeof ctx.createStereoPanner === 'function') {
          const panner = ctx.createStereoPanner();
          panner.pan.setValueAtTime(_clampAudioPan(pan), time);
          source.connect(panner).connect(output);
          return;
        }
        source.connect(output);
      }

      function playTone({
        ctx = getAudioCtx(),
        time,
        freq,
        dur = 0.18,
        gain = 0.08,
        type = 'triangle',
        filterFreq = 3200,
        q = 0.8,
        attack = 0.008,
        releaseTail = 0.02,
        detune = 0,
        pan = 0,
        filterType = 'lowpass',
        endFreq = null
      }) {
        if (!ctx || ctx.state !== 'running') return;
        const output = _getAudioOutputNode(ctx);
        if (!output) return;
        const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
        const g = ctx.createGain();
        const filter = ctx.createBiquadFilter();

        osc.type = type;
        osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, time);
        osc.detune.setValueAtTime(detune, time);
        if (Number.isFinite(endFreq) && endFreq > 0 && Math.abs(endFreq - freq) > 0.5) {
          osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(endFreq, time + dur);
        }

        filter.type = filterType;
        filter.frequency.setValueAtTime(filterFreq, time);
        filter.Q.setValueAtTime(q, time);

        const safeAttack = Math.min(Math.max(attack, 0.002), Math.max(0.01, dur * 0.5));
        const peakGain = Math.max(0.0002, gain);
        g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, time);
        g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(peakGain, time + safeAttack);
        g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, time + dur);

        osc.connect(filter).connect(g);
        _connectToOutputWithPan({
          ctx,
          source: g,
          output,
          pan,
          time
        });

        osc.start(time);
        osc.stop(time + dur + releaseTail);
      }

      function playSubtaskCompleteSound() {
        playParentCompleteSound();
      }

      function playParentCompleteSound() {
        if (!settings.sound) return;
        _withRunningAudio((ctx) => {
          const now = ctx.currentTime + 0.002;

          playTone({
            ctx,
            time: now,
            freq: 261.63,
            endFreq: 329.63,
            dur: 0.34,
            gain: 0.014,
            type: 'triangle',
            filterFreq: 1700,
            q: 0.85,
            attack: 0.014,
            pan: -0.16
          });

          const notes = [
            // ガチャSSR: C5 -> E5 -> G5 -> C6 -> E6
            { freq: 523.25, t: 0.00, dur: 0.13, gain: 0.031, pan: -0.12 },
            { freq: 659.25, t: 0.075, dur: 0.14, gain: 0.032, pan: 0.08 },
            { freq: 783.99, t: 0.155, dur: 0.15, gain: 0.034, pan: -0.07 },
            { freq: 1046.50, t: 0.24, dur: 0.19, gain: 0.036, pan: 0.10 },
            { freq: 1318.51, t: 0.335, dur: 0.25, gain: 0.038, pan: 0.00 }
          ];

          notes.forEach((note) => {
            const t = now + note.t;

            playTone({
              ctx,
              time: t,
              freq: note.freq * 0.99,
              endFreq: note.freq * 1.01,
              dur: note.dur,
              gain: note.gain,
              type: 'triangle',
              filterFreq: 3000,
              q: 0.85,
              attack: 0.01,
              pan: note.pan
            });

            playTone({
              ctx,
              time: t + 0.01,
              freq: note.freq,
              dur: note.dur * 0.72,
              gain: note.gain * 0.20,
              type: 'sine',

      function playDeleteSound() {
        if (!settings.sound) return;
        _withRunningAudio((ctx) => {
          const now = ctx.currentTime + 0.001;
          const output = _getAudioOutputNode(ctx);
          if (!output) return;

          const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
          const gain = ctx.createGain();
          const filter = ctx.createBiquadFilter();

          osc.type = 'triangle';
          osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(380, now);
          osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(180, now + 0.14);

          filter.type = 'lowpass';
          filter.frequency.setValueAtTime(1800, now);

          gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.08, now);
          gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + 0.14);

          osc.connect(filter).connect(gain).connect(output);
          osc.start(now);
          osc.stop(now + 0.14);
        });

      /* ============================================
         紙吹雪とお祝い演出
      ============================================ */
      const ctx2d = confettiCanvas?.getContext?.('2d') || null;
      const CAN_USE_CONFETTI = !!ctx2d;
      let confettiPieces = [];
      let confettiAnimating = false;

      function resizeCanvas() {
        if (!CAN_USE_CONFETTI) return;
        confettiCanvas.width = window.innerWidth;
        confettiCanvas.height = window.innerHeight;
      }

      if (!CAN_USE_CONFETTI) {
        confettiCanvas.hidden = true;

      function launchConfetti(x, y, count = 86) {
        if (!settings.celebration || !CAN_USE_CONFETTI
          || window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) return;

        const colors = ['#5f7fc7', '#7f9bd3', '#a8bcdd', '#c7d4e9', '#e8edf6'];

        for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
          const angle = (Math.PI * 2 * i) / count + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.75;
          const speed = 5.2 + Math.random() * 10.8;
          confettiPieces.push({
            x,
            y,
            vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed,
            vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed - 3.5,
            size: 5 + Math.random() * 8,
            color: colors[Math.floor(Math.random() * colors.length)],
            rotation: Math.random() * 360,
            rotSpeed: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 18,
            life: 1,
            decay: 0.015 + Math.random() * 0.012,
            shape: Math.random() > 0.5 ? 'rect' : 'circle'
          });
        }

        if (!confettiAnimating) {
          confettiAnimating = true;
          animateConfetti();
        }
      }

      function animateConfetti() {
        if (!CAN_USE_CONFETTI || !settings.celebration || document.hidden
          || window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) {
          ctx2d?.clearRect(0, 0, confettiCanvas.width, confettiCanvas.height);
          confettiPieces = [];
          confettiAnimating = false;
          return;
        }
        ctx2d.clearRect(0, 0, confettiCanvas.width, confettiCanvas.height);

        confettiPieces.forEach(p => {
          p.x += p.vx;
          p.y += p.vy;
          p.vy += 0.17;
          p.vx *= 0.992;
          p.rotation += p.rotSpeed;
          p.life -= p.decay;

          if (p.life > 0) {
            ctx2d.save();
            ctx2d.translate(p.x, p.y);
            ctx2d.rotate(p.rotation * Math.PI / 180);
            ctx2d.globalAlpha = p.life;
            ctx2d.fillStyle = p.color;

            if (p.shape === 'rect') {
              ctx2d.fillRect(-p.size / 2, -p.size / 4, p.size, p.size / 2);
            } else {
              ctx2d.beginPath();
              ctx2d.arc(0, 0, p.size / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
              ctx2d.fill();
            }
            ctx2d.restore();
          }
        });

        confettiPieces = confettiPieces.filter(p => p.life > 0);

        if (confettiPieces.length > 0) {
          requestAnimationFrame(animateConfetti);
        } else {
          confettiAnimating = false;
          ctx2d.clearRect(0, 0, confettiCanvas.width, confettiCanvas.height);
        }
      }

      async function executeConfirmedAction() {
        if (!confirmState.action || isStateSaveOperationPending()) return;

        const { action, payload } = confirmState;
        closeConfirmModal();

        switch (action) {
          case 'discard-parent-edit':
            closeParentModal({ force: true });
            break;
          case 'discard-subtask-edit':
            closeSubtaskModal({ force: true });
            break;
          case 'delete-parent':
            await performDeleteParent(payload?.parentId, payload?.buttonEl);
            break;
          case 'delete-subtask':
            await performDeleteSubtask(payload?.parentId, payload?.subId, payload?.buttonEl);
            break;
          case 'delete-subtask-modal':
            await performDeleteSubtask(payload?.parentId, payload?.subId);
            break;
          case 'undo-parent':
            await undoCompleted('parent', payload?.parentId);
            break;
          case 'undo-subtask':
            await undoCompleted('subtask', payload?.parentId, payload?.subId);
            break;
          case 'clear-completed':
            await performClearCompleted(payload?.filterId);
            break;
          case 'clear-all':
            await performClearAll();
            break;
          case 'import-backup':
            await performImportBackup(payload?.normalized);
            break;
          case 'abort-focus':
            await performAbortFocus(payload);
            break;

      /* ============================================
         完了メッセージ管理
      ============================================ */
      function renderMessages() {
        const messages = getMessages();
        const canDeleteMessage = messages.length > 1;
        const messagePending = isMessageOperationPending();
        const disabledAttrs = messagePending ? ' disabled aria-disabled="true"' : '';
        const deleteDisabledAttrs = canDeleteMessage && !messagePending ? '' : ' disabled aria-disabled="true"';
        const deleteTitle = messagePending
          ? '保存中'
          : canDeleteMessage
            ? 'メッセージ削除'
            : '1件以上残す必要があります';
        const previousEditor = qs('.message-edit-input', messageList);
        const restoreEditorFocus = previousEditor && document.activeElement === previousEditor
          && Number(previousEditor.dataset.index) === messageEditorState.editIndex;
        const selection = restoreEditorFocus
          ? [previousEditor.selectionStart, previousEditor.selectionEnd, previousEditor.selectionDirection] : null;
        const activeElement = document.activeElement;
        const focusEntry = messageList.contains(activeElement)
          ? { returnFocusEl: activeElement, returnFocusTarget: _captureModalReturnFocus(activeElement) } : null;
        const previousRows = [...messageList.children];
        const rows = [];

        messages.forEach((msg, index) => {
          const isEditing = messageEditorState.editIndex === index;
          const key = JSON.stringify([msg, index, isEditing, canDeleteMessage, messagePending]);
          const cached = previousRows[index];
          if (cached?._messageRenderKey === key) {
            rows.push(cached);
            return;
          }
          const item = document.createElement('div');
          item._messageRenderKey = key;
          item.className = `message-item${isEditing ? ' is-editing' : ''}`;
          if (isEditing) {
            item.innerHTML = `
              <input class="text-input message-edit-input gm-input" type="text" data-index="${index}" aria-label="完了メッセージを編集"${disabledAttrs}>
              <div class="message-actions">
                <button type="button" class="message-chip-btn action-btn save-message-edit-btn gm-btn" data-index="${index}" aria-label="メッセージ保存" aria-keyshortcuts="Enter"${disabledAttrs}>
                  <span aria-hidden="true" class="material-symbols-outlined">save</span>
                  <span>保存</span>
                </button>
                <button type="button" class="message-chip-btn danger action-btn delete-message-btn gm-btn" data-index="${index}" aria-label="${deleteTitle}"${deleteDisabledAttrs}>
                  <span aria-hidden="true" class="material-symbols-outlined">delete</span>
                  <span>削除</span>
                </button>
              </div>
            `;
            const $input = qs('.message-edit-input', item);
            if ($input) {
              $input.value = messageEditorState.draft ?? msg;
            }
          } else {
            item.innerHTML = `
              <div class="message-text">${escapeHtml(msg)}</div>
              <div class="message-actions">
                <button type="button" class="message-chip-btn action-btn edit-message-btn gm-btn" data-index="${index}" aria-label="メッセージ編集"${disabledAttrs}>
                  <span aria-hidden="true" class="material-symbols-outlined">edit</span>
                  <span>編集</span>
                </button>
                <button type="button" class="message-chip-btn danger action-btn delete-message-btn gm-btn" data-index="${index}" aria-label="${deleteTitle}"${deleteDisabledAttrs}>
                  <span aria-hidden="true" class="material-symbols-outlined">delete</span>
                  <span>削除</span>
                </button>
              </div>
            `;
          }
          rows.push(item);
        });

        reconcileChildren(messageList, rows);
        hydrateMaterialIcons(messageList);
        updateMessageListPendingState();
        if (restoreEditorFocus) {
          const editor = qs('.message-edit-input', messageList);
          if (editor !== previousEditor) {
            editor?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            if (selection) editor?.setSelectionRange(...selection);
          }
        } else if (focusEntry && document.activeElement === document.body) {
          _restoreFocusAfterPending(focusEntry);
        }
      }

      async function saveMessage() {
        if (isStateSaveOperationPending() || isAddOperationPending('message') || isMessageOperationPending()) return;
        if (messageInput.value.trim().length > MAX_MESSAGE_TEXT_LENGTH) {
          showErrorToast(`最大${MAX_MESSAGE_TEXT_LENGTH}文字までです。入力を短くしてください`);
          messageInput.focus();
          return;
        }
        const value = normalizeInputText(messageInput.value, MAX_MESSAGE_TEXT_LENGTH);
        if (!value) {
          showErrorToast('メッセージを入力してください');
          messageInput.focus();
          return;
        }

        settings.messages = normalizeMessageList(settings.messages);
        if (settings.messages.length >= MAX_MESSAGE_COUNT) {
          showErrorToast(`完了メッセージは最大${MAX_MESSAGE_COUNT}件までです`);
          messageInput.focus();
          return;
        }

        const previousState = _createAppStateSnapshot();
        let saveOk = false;
        setMessageOperationPending(true);
        setAddOperationPending('message', true);
        try {
          settings.messages.push(value);
          saveOk = await _commitStateSave(previousState);
        } finally {
          setAddOperationPending('message', false);
          setMessageOperationPending(false);
        }
        if (!saveOk) return;
        messageInput.value = '';
        messageInput.dispatchEvent?.(new Event('input'));
        renderMessages();
      }

      function editMessage(index) {
        if (isStateSaveOperationPending() || isMessageOperationPending()) return;
        const messages = getMessages();
        if (!Number.isInteger(index) || index < 0 || index >= messages.length) return;
        messageEditorState.editIndex = index;
        messageEditorState.draft = messages[index];
        renderMessages();
        const $input = qs(`.message-edit-input[data-index="${index}"]`, messageList);

          $input.focus();
          $input.select();

      async function saveEditedMessage(index) {
        if (isStateSaveOperationPending() || isMessageOperationPending()) return;
        const messages = getMessages();
        if (!Number.isInteger(index) || index < 0 || index >= messages.length) return;

        const $input = qs(`.message-edit-input[data-index="${index}"]`, messageList);
        if (($input?.value || '').trim().length > MAX_MESSAGE_TEXT_LENGTH) {
          showErrorToast(`最大${MAX_MESSAGE_TEXT_LENGTH}文字までです。入力を短くしてください`);
          $input?.focus();
          return;

        const value = normalizeInputText($input?.value, MAX_MESSAGE_TEXT_LENGTH);
        if (!value) {
          showErrorToast('メッセージを入力してください');
          $input?.focus();
          return;
        }

        const previousState = _createAppStateSnapshot();
        const previousEditIndex = messageEditorState.editIndex;
        if (settings.messages.length === 0) {
          settings.messages = [...messages];
        }
        let saveOk = false;
        setMessageOperationPending(true);
        try {
          settings.messages[index] = value;
          saveOk = await _commitStateSave(previousState);
        } finally {
          setMessageOperationPending(false);
        }
        if (!saveOk) {
          messageEditorState.editIndex = previousEditIndex;
          renderMessages();
          const $restoredInput = qs(`.message-edit-input[data-index="${index}"]`, messageList);
          if ($restoredInput) {
            $restoredInput.value = value;
            $restoredInput.focus();
            $restoredInput.select();
          }
          return;
        }
        messageEditorState.editIndex = null;
        messageEditorState.draft = null;
        renderMessages();
      }

      async function deleteMessage(index) {
        if (isStateSaveOperationPending() || isMessageOperationPending()) return;
        const messages = getMessages();
        if (!Number.isInteger(index) || index < 0 || index >= messages.length) return;
        const previousState = _createAppStateSnapshot();
        const previousEditIndex = messageEditorState.editIndex;
        const previousDraft = messageEditorState.draft;
        if (settings.messages.length === 0) {
          settings.messages = [...messages];
        }
        if (settings.messages.length <= 1) {
          showErrorToast('完了メッセージは1件以上残す必要があります');
          return;
        }
        settings.messages.splice(index, 1);
        if (messageEditorState.editIndex === index) {
          messageEditorState.editIndex = null;
          messageEditorState.draft = null;
        } else if (messageEditorState.editIndex !== null && messageEditorState.editIndex > index) {
          messageEditorState.editIndex -= 1;
        }
        let saveOk = false;
        setMessageOperationPending(true);
        try {
          saveOk = await _commitStateSave(previousState);
        } finally {
          setMessageOperationPending(false);
        }
        if (!saveOk) {
          messageEditorState.editIndex = previousEditIndex;
          messageEditorState.draft = previousDraft;
          renderMessages();
          return;
        }
        renderMessages();
      }
