      function renderParentModalSubtasks(parent) {
        const renderKey = JSON.stringify([parent?.id, (parent?.subtasks || []).map(sub => [sub.id, sub.text, sub.done])]);
        if (renderParentModalSubtasks.renderKey === renderKey) {
          updateParentModalPendingState();
          return;
        }
        const activeElement = document.activeElement;
        const focusEntry = modalSubtaskList.contains(activeElement)
          ? { returnFocusEl: activeElement, returnFocusTarget: _captureModalReturnFocus(activeElement) } : null;
        if (!parent || parent.subtasks.length === 0) {
          modalSubtaskList.className = 'modal-subtask-list is-empty';
          modalSubtaskList.replaceChildren();
          renderParentModalSubtasks.renderKey = renderKey;
          updateParentModalPendingState();
          if (focusEntry && !isStateSaveOperationPending()) modalSubtaskInput.focus({ preventScroll: true });
          return;
        }

        modalSubtaskList.className = 'modal-subtask-list';
        modalSubtaskList.innerHTML = parent.subtasks.map(sub => `
          <div class="modal-subtask-row" data-parent-id="${parent.id}" data-sub-id="${sub.id}">
            <div class="left">
              <button
                class="mini-btn drag-handle modal-subtask-drag-handle gm-btn"
                data-parent-id="${parent.id}"
                data-sub-id="${sub.id}"
                draggable="true"
                type="button"
                aria-label="子タスクをドラッグで並び替え"
              >
                <span aria-hidden="true" class="material-symbols-outlined">drag_indicator</span>
              </button>
              <span aria-hidden="true" class="material-symbols-outlined subtask-status-icon">
                ${sub.done ? 'task_alt' : 'radio_button_unchecked'}
              </span>
              <div class="name">${escapeHtml(sub.text)}</div>
            </div>

            <div class="modal-row-actions">
              <button
                class="mini-btn action-btn modal-edit-subtask-btn gm-btn"
                data-parent-id="${parent.id}"
                data-sub-id="${sub.id}"
                type="button"
                aria-label="編集"
              >
                <span aria-hidden="true" class="material-symbols-outlined">edit</span>
                <span>編集</span>
              </button>
              <button
                class="mini-btn danger action-btn modal-delete-subtask-btn gm-btn"
                data-parent-id="${parent.id}"
                data-sub-id="${sub.id}"
                type="button"
                aria-label="削除"
              >
                <span aria-hidden="true" class="material-symbols-outlined">delete</span>
                <span>削除</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        `).join('');
        hydrateMaterialIcons(modalSubtaskList);
        renderParentModalSubtasks.renderKey = renderKey;
        updateParentModalPendingState();
        if (focusEntry) _restoreFocusAfterPending(focusEntry);
      }

      async function saveParentEdit() {
        if (isStateSaveOperationPending() || isEditOperationPending('parent')) return;
        const parent = getTask(modalState.parentId);
        if (!parent) return;

        if (parentEditInput.value.trim().length > MAX_TASK_TEXT_LENGTH) {
          showErrorToast(`最大${MAX_TASK_TEXT_LENGTH}文字までです。入力を短くしてください`);
          parentEditInput.focus();
          return;
        }
        const value = normalizeInputText(parentEditInput.value, MAX_TASK_TEXT_LENGTH);
        if (!value) {
          showErrorToast('タスク名を入力してください');
          parentEditInput.focus();
          return;
        }

        const previousState = _createAppStateSnapshot();
        let saveOk = false;
        setEditOperationPending('parent', true);
        try {
          parent.text = value;
          saveOk = await _commitStateSave(previousState);
        } finally {
          setEditOperationPending('parent', false);
        }
        if (!saveOk) return;
        render();
        if (modalSubtaskInput.value.trim()) {
          showToast('タスク名を保存しました。入力中の子タスクは「追加」で保存できます', { type: 'success' });
        } else {
          closeParentModal({ force: true });
        }
      }

      async function addSubtaskFromModal() {
        if (isStateSaveOperationPending() || isAddOperationPending('subtask') || isEditOperationPending('parent')) return;
        const parent = getTask(modalState.parentId);
        if (!parent) return;

        if (modalSubtaskInput.value.trim().length > MAX_SUBTASK_TEXT_LENGTH) {
          showErrorToast(`最大${MAX_SUBTASK_TEXT_LENGTH}文字までです。入力を短くしてください`);
          modalSubtaskInput.focus();
          return;
        }
        const value = normalizeInputText(modalSubtaskInput.value, MAX_SUBTASK_TEXT_LENGTH);
        if (!value) {
          showErrorToast('子タスク名を入力してください');
          modalSubtaskInput.focus();
          return;
        }
        if (parent.subtasks.length >= MAX_SUBTASK_COUNT_PER_PARENT) {
          showErrorToast(`子タスクは親タスクごとに最大${MAX_SUBTASK_COUNT_PER_PARENT}件までです`);
          modalSubtaskInput.focus();
          return;
        }

        const previousState = _createAppStateSnapshot();
        const wasLeafParent = !hasSubtasks(parent);
        let saveOk = false;
        setAddOperationPending('subtask', true);
        try {
          if (taskViewState.filter === 'completed') taskViewState.filter = 'all';
          parent.subtasks.push({
            id: uid(),
            text: value,
            done: false,
            focus: createFocusMeta()
          });
          if (wasLeafParent) {
            parent.focus = createFocusMeta();
          }

          syncParentStatus(parent);
          saveOk = await _commitStateSave(previousState);
        } finally {
          setAddOperationPending('subtask', false);
        }
        if (!saveOk) return;
        modalSubtaskInput.value = '';
        modalSubtaskInput.dispatchEvent?.(new Event('input'));
        resetTaskSearch();
        playAddSound();
        renderParentModalSubtasks(parent);
        render();
        modalSubtaskInput.focus();
      }

      function openSubtaskModal(parentId, subId) {
        if (isStateSaveOperationPending()) return;
        if (focusOverlay.classList.contains('show')) return;
        if (isEditOperationPending('parent') || isEditOperationPending('subtask')) return;
        const sub = getSubtask(parentId, subId);
        if (!sub) return;

        modalState.subtaskParentId = parentId;
        modalState.subtaskId = subId;
        subtaskEditInput.value = sub.text;
        updateSubtaskModalPendingState();
        syncEditorReorderControls();
        _openModalOverlay(subtaskModalOverlay, subtaskEditInput);
      }

      function closeSubtaskModal(options = {}) {
        if (!options?.force && isStateSaveOperationPending()) return false;
        if (!options?.force && isEditOperationPending('subtask')) return false;
        const sub = getSubtask(modalState.subtaskParentId, modalState.subtaskId);
        if (!options?.force && sub && subtaskEditInput.value !== sub.text) {
          openConfirmModal('保存していない子タスク名を破棄して閉じますか？', 'discard-subtask-edit');
          return false;
        }
        modalState.subtaskParentId = null;
        modalState.subtaskId = null;
        _closeModalOverlay(subtaskModalOverlay);
        return true;
      }

      async function saveSubtaskEdit() {
        if (isStateSaveOperationPending() || isEditOperationPending('subtask')) return;
        const sub = getSubtask(modalState.subtaskParentId, modalState.subtaskId);
        if (!sub) return;

        if (subtaskEditInput.value.trim().length > MAX_SUBTASK_TEXT_LENGTH) {
          showErrorToast(`最大${MAX_SUBTASK_TEXT_LENGTH}文字までです。入力を短くしてください`);
          subtaskEditInput.focus();
          return;
        }
        const value = normalizeInputText(subtaskEditInput.value, MAX_SUBTASK_TEXT_LENGTH);
        if (!value) {
          showErrorToast('子タスク名を入力してください');
          subtaskEditInput.focus();
          return;
        }

        const previousState = _createAppStateSnapshot();
        let saveOk = false;
        setEditOperationPending('subtask', true);
        try {
          sub.text = value;
          saveOk = await _commitStateSave(previousState);
        } finally {
          setEditOperationPending('subtask', false);
        }
        if (!saveOk) return;
        render();
        if (modalState.parentId === modalState.subtaskParentId) {
          const parent = getTask(modalState.parentId);
          if (parent) renderParentModalSubtasks(parent);
        }
        closeSubtaskModal({ force: true });
      }

      /* ============================================
         集中モードのモーダルとタイマー
      ============================================ */
      function clearRunningAcrossAllTargets() {
        tasks.forEach(task => {
          if (task.focus.focusState === 'running') {
            task.focus.elapsedMs = getElapsedMs(task.focus);
            task.focus.focusState = 'paused';
            task.focus.startedAt = null;
          }
          task.subtasks.forEach(sub => {
            if (sub.focus.focusState === 'running') {
              sub.focus.elapsedMs = getElapsedMs(sub.focus);
              sub.focus.focusState = 'paused';
              sub.focus.startedAt = null;
            }
          });
        });
      }

      function resetFocusPomodoroState() {
        focusState.pomodoroEnabled = false;
        focusState.pomodoroPhase = 'focus';
        focusState.pomodoroPhaseEndsAt = null;
        focusState.pomodoroPhaseRemainingMs = 0;
        focusState.pomodoroFocusMs = 0;
        focusState.pomodoroBreakMs = 0;
      }

      function isPomodoroEnabledForSession() {
        return focusState.pomodoroEnabled && focusState.pomodoroFocusMs > 0 && focusState.pomodoroBreakMs > 0;
      }

      function getPomodoroPhaseDurationMs(phase = 'focus') {
        if (phase === 'break') return focusState.pomodoroBreakMs;
        return focusState.pomodoroFocusMs;
      }

      function getPomodoroPhaseRemainingMs(nowMs = Date.now()) {
        if (!isPomodoroEnabledForSession()) return 0;
        if (typeof focusState.pomodoroPhaseEndsAt === 'number') {
          return Math.max(0, focusState.pomodoroPhaseEndsAt - nowMs);
        }
        return Math.max(0, focusState.pomodoroPhaseRemainingMs);
      }

      function startFocusPomodoroSession(nowMs) {
        const normalizedPomodoro = normalizePomodoroSettings(settings.pomodoro);
        settings.pomodoro = normalizedPomodoro;
        if (!normalizedPomodoro.enabled) {
          resetFocusPomodoroState();
          return;
        }

        const focusMs = normalizedPomodoro.focusMinutes * 60 * 1000;
        const breakMs = normalizedPomodoro.breakMinutes * 60 * 1000;
        if (focusMs <= 0 || breakMs <= 0) {
          resetFocusPomodoroState();
          return;
        }

        focusState.pomodoroEnabled = true;
        focusState.pomodoroFocusMs = focusMs;
        focusState.pomodoroBreakMs = breakMs;
        focusState.pomodoroPhase = 'focus';
        focusState.pomodoroPhaseRemainingMs = focusMs;
        focusState.pomodoroPhaseEndsAt = nowMs + focusMs;
      }

      function syncPomodoroPhaseProgress(target, nowMs = Date.now()) {
        if (!target) return 0;
        if (target.focus.focusState !== 'running') return 0;
        if (!isPomodoroEnabledForSession()) return 0;
        if (typeof focusState.pomodoroPhaseEndsAt !== 'number') return 0;

        let transitions = 0;
        const cycleMs = focusState.pomodoroFocusMs + focusState.pomodoroBreakMs;
        const cycles = Math.floor((nowMs - focusState.pomodoroPhaseEndsAt) / cycleMs);
        if (cycles > 0) {
          // 離席中の時間を分単位で走査せず、完了した周期をまとめて飛ばす。
          target.focus.elapsedMs += cycles * focusState.pomodoroFocusMs;
          focusState.pomodoroPhaseEndsAt += cycles * cycleMs;
          if (typeof target.focus.startedAt === 'number') target.focus.startedAt += cycles * cycleMs;
          transitions = cycles * 2;
        }
        while (nowMs >= focusState.pomodoroPhaseEndsAt) {
          const phaseBaseEndsAt = focusState.pomodoroPhaseEndsAt;

          if (
            focusState.pomodoroPhase === 'focus'
            && typeof target.focus.startedAt === 'number'
          ) {
            target.focus.elapsedMs += Math.max(0, phaseBaseEndsAt - target.focus.startedAt);
            target.focus.startedAt = null;
          }

          focusState.pomodoroPhase = focusState.pomodoroPhase === 'focus' ? 'break' : 'focus';
          const nextDurationMs = getPomodoroPhaseDurationMs(focusState.pomodoroPhase);
          focusState.pomodoroPhaseRemainingMs = nextDurationMs;
          focusState.pomodoroPhaseEndsAt = phaseBaseEndsAt + nextDurationMs;

          if (focusState.pomodoroPhase === 'focus') {
            target.focus.startedAt = phaseBaseEndsAt;
          } else {
            target.focus.startedAt = null;
          }

          transitions += 1;
        }

        focusState.pomodoroPhaseRemainingMs = getPomodoroPhaseRemainingMs(nowMs);
        return transitions;
      }

      function syncActivePomodoroPhaseProgress(nowMs = Date.now()) {
        return syncPomodoroPhaseProgress(getActiveFocusTarget(), nowMs);
      }

      function notifyPomodoroPhaseTransition() {
        if (!isPomodoroEnabledForSession()) return;
        const isBreakPhase = focusState.pomodoroPhase === 'break';
        if (isBreakPhase) {
          showToast('ポモドーロ: 休憩に入りました', {
            type: 'success',
            icon: 'coffee',
            durationMs: 1800
          });
          playFocusShiftSound('pause');
          return;
        }

        showToast('ポモドーロ: 集中を再開します', {
          type: 'success',
          icon: 'play_circle',
          durationMs: 1800
        });
        playFocusShiftSound('resume');
      }

      function syncFocusPhaseVisualState(target) {
        if (!focusOverlay) return;
        const isBreakPhase = !!target
          && isPomodoroEnabledForSession()
          && focusState.pomodoroPhase === 'break';
        focusOverlay.classList.toggle('focus-break', isBreakPhase);
      }

      function canOpenFocusForParent(task) {
        return !!task && isRunnableParent(task);
      }

      function canOpenFocusForSubtask(sub) {
        return !!sub;
      }

      async function openFocusModal(type, parentId, subtaskId = null) {
        if (isStateSaveOperationPending() || isFocusOperationPending()) return;
        if (focusOverlay.classList.contains('show')) return;
        if (confirmModalOverlay.classList.contains('show')) return;
        if (parentModalOverlay.classList.contains('show')) return;
        if (subtaskModalOverlay.classList.contains('show')) return;

        const $returnFocusEl = document.activeElement;
        let target = null;
        let saveOk = false;
        let transitionPending = false;
        setFocusOperationPending(true);
        try {
          if (!(await commitPomodoroSettingsFromControls())) return;

          target = getTarget(type, parentId, subtaskId);
          if (!target) return;

          if (type === 'parent' && !canOpenFocusForParent(target)) return;
          if (type === 'subtask' && !canOpenFocusForSubtask(target)) return;
          if (target.done) return;

          const previousState = _createAppStateSnapshot();
          const previousFocusState = _createFocusRuntimeSnapshot();
          clearRunningAcrossAllTargets();

          focusState.type = type;
          focusState.parentId = parentId;
          focusState.subtaskId = subtaskId;

          const nowMs = Date.now();
          target.focus.elapsedMs = getElapsedMs(target.focus);
          target.focus.focusState = 'running';
          target.focus.startedAt = nowMs;
          focusState.lastCheckpointAt = nowMs;
          startFocusPomodoroSession(nowMs);

          // 集中画面の表示完了まで共有ロックを維持する。
          setStateSaveOperationPending(true);
          transitionPending = true;
          saveOk = await _commitFocusStateSave(previousState, previousFocusState);
        } finally {
          setFocusOperationPending(false);
          if (!saveOk && transitionPending) {
            setStateSaveOperationPending(false);
            transitionPending = false;
          }
        }
        if (!saveOk || !target) return;

        try {
          focusTaskTitle.textContent = target.text;
          syncFocusPauseButton();
          updateFocusTimer();

          _openModalOverlay(focusOverlay, focusPauseBtn, $returnFocusEl);
          document.body.classList.add('focus-open');

          if (focusState.tickerId) clearInterval(focusState.tickerId);
          focusState.tickerId = setInterval(updateFocusTimer, 200);

          playFocusStartSound();
          render();
        } finally {
          if (transitionPending) setStateSaveOperationPending(false);
        }
      }

      function closeFocusModal() {
        _closeModalOverlay(focusOverlay);
        document.body.classList.remove('focus-open');
        focusOverlay.classList.remove('focus-paused');
        focusOverlay.classList.remove('focus-break');
        focusPauseBtn.classList.remove('is-resume');
        if (focusTimerCaption) focusTimerCaption.textContent = '経過時間';
        if (focusState.tickerId) {
          clearInterval(focusState.tickerId);
          focusState.tickerId = null;
        }
        focusState.type = null;
        focusState.parentId = null;
        focusState.subtaskId = null;
        focusState.lastCheckpointAt = 0;
        resetFocusPomodoroState();
        syncFocusStatusChip();
      }

      function getActiveFocusTarget() {
        if (!focusState.type) return null;
        return getTarget(focusState.type, focusState.parentId, focusState.subtaskId);
      }

      function updateFocusTimer() {
        const target = getActiveFocusTarget();
        if (!target) return;

        const nowMs = Date.now();
        const transitions = syncPomodoroPhaseProgress(target, nowMs);
        if (transitions > 0) {
          notifyPomodoroPhaseTransition();
        }

        const onBreak = isPomodoroEnabledForSession() && focusState.pomodoroPhase === 'break';
        const pomodoro = isPomodoroEnabledForSession();
        const timerText = formatElapsed(pomodoro ? Math.ceil(getPomodoroPhaseRemainingMs(nowMs) / 1000) * 1000 : getElapsedMs(target.focus, nowMs));
        if (focusTimer.textContent !== timerText) focusTimer.textContent = timerText;
        const caption = pomodoro ? (onBreak ? '休憩の残り時間' : '集中の残り時間') : '経過時間';
        focusElapsedSummary.hidden = !pomodoro;
        if (pomodoro) {
          const summary = `実績時間 ${formatElapsed(getElapsedMs(target.focus, nowMs))}`;
          if (focusElapsedSummary.textContent !== summary) focusElapsedSummary.textContent = summary;
        }
        if (focusTimerCaption && focusTimerCaption.textContent !== caption) focusTimerCaption.textContent = caption;

        syncFocusPhaseVisualState(target);
        syncFocusStatusChip();
        void checkpointActiveFocusElapsed();
      }

      function syncFocusStatusChip() {
        if (!focusStatusChip || !focusStatusIcon || !focusStatusText) return;
        const target = getActiveFocusTarget();
        const paused = target?.focus.focusState === 'paused';
        const pomodoro = !!target && isPomodoroEnabledForSession();
        const onBreak = pomodoro && focusState.pomodoroPhase === 'break';
        const icon = paused ? 'pause_circle' : onBreak ? 'coffee' : 'play_circle';
        const text = paused ? '一時停止中' : onBreak ? '休憩中' : pomodoro ? '集中中' : '進行中';
        focusStatusChip.classList.toggle('is-paused', paused);
        setMaterialIcon(focusStatusIcon, icon);
        if (focusStatusText.textContent !== text) focusStatusText.textContent = text;
      }

      function syncFocusPauseButton() {
        const target = getActiveFocusTarget();
        if (!target) return;
        const elapsedCaption = isPomodoroEnabledForSession()
          ? (focusState.pomodoroPhase === 'break' ? '休憩の残り時間' : '集中の残り時間')
          : '経過時間';
        syncFocusPhaseVisualState(target);

        const paused = target.focus.focusState === 'paused';
        const label = paused ? '再開' : '一時停止';
        setMaterialIcon(focusPauseIcon, paused ? 'play_circle' : 'pause_circle');
        focusPauseBtn.setAttribute('aria-label', label);
        if (focusPauseLabel) focusPauseLabel.textContent = label;
        focusPauseBtn.classList.toggle('is-resume', paused);
        focusOverlay.classList.toggle('focus-paused', paused);
        if (focusTimerCaption) focusTimerCaption.textContent = elapsedCaption;
        syncFocusStatusChip();
      }

      async function pauseOrResumeFocus() {
        if (isStateSaveOperationPending() || isFocusOperationPending()) return;
        const target = getActiveFocusTarget();
        if (!target) return;
        const nowMs = Date.now();
        const previousState = _createAppStateSnapshot();
        const previousFocusState = _createFocusRuntimeSnapshot();
        let soundMode = null;
        let saveOk = false;

        setFocusOperationPending(true);
        try {
          if (target.focus.focusState === 'running') {
            syncPomodoroPhaseProgress(target, nowMs);
            target.focus.elapsedMs = getElapsedMs(target.focus, nowMs);
            target.focus.focusState = 'paused';
            target.focus.startedAt = null;
            if (isPomodoroEnabledForSession()) {
              focusState.pomodoroPhaseRemainingMs = getPomodoroPhaseRemainingMs(nowMs);
              focusState.pomodoroPhaseEndsAt = null;
            }
            soundMode = 'pause';
          } else if (target.focus.focusState === 'paused') {
            clearRunningAcrossAllTargets();
            target.focus.focusState = 'running';
            if (isPomodoroEnabledForSession()) {
              const remainingMs = Math.max(1, focusState.pomodoroPhaseRemainingMs || getPomodoroPhaseDurationMs(focusState.pomodoroPhase));
              focusState.pomodoroPhaseRemainingMs = remainingMs;
              focusState.pomodoroPhaseEndsAt = nowMs + remainingMs;
              target.focus.startedAt = focusState.pomodoroPhase === 'focus' ? nowMs : null;
            } else {
              target.focus.startedAt = nowMs;
            }
            focusState.lastCheckpointAt = nowMs;
            soundMode = 'resume';
          }

          saveOk = await _commitFocusStateSave(previousState, previousFocusState);
        } finally {
          setFocusOperationPending(false);
        }

        if (!saveOk) return;
        if (soundMode) playFocusShiftSound(soundMode);
        syncFocusPauseButton();
        updateFocusTimer();
        render();
      }

      async function performAbortFocus(payload = null) {
        if (isStateSaveOperationPending() || isFocusOperationPending()) return;
        const target = payload
          ? getTarget(payload.type, payload.parentId, payload.subtaskId)
          : getActiveFocusTarget();
        if (!target) return;

        if (
          payload
          && (
            payload.type !== focusState.type
            || payload.parentId !== focusState.parentId
            || payload.subtaskId !== focusState.subtaskId
          )
        ) {
          return;
        }

        const previousState = _createAppStateSnapshot();
        const previousFocusState = _createFocusRuntimeSnapshot();
        let saveOk = false;
        setFocusOperationPending(true);
        try {
          target.focus.focusState = 'idle';
          target.focus.elapsedMs = 0;
          target.focus.startedAt = null;

          saveOk = await _commitFocusStateSave(previousState, previousFocusState);
        } finally {
          setFocusOperationPending(false);
        }
        if (!saveOk) return;
        playFocusAbortSound();
        render();
        closeFocusModal();
      }

      function abortFocus() {
        if (isStateSaveOperationPending() || isFocusOperationPending()) return;
        const target = getActiveFocusTarget();
        if (!target) return;
        openConfirmModal(buildAbortFocusConfirmMessage(target), 'abort-focus', {
          type: focusState.type,
          parentId: focusState.parentId,
          subtaskId: focusState.subtaskId
        });
      }

      async function completeFocus() {
        if (isStateSaveOperationPending() || isFocusOperationPending()) return;
        const target = getActiveFocusTarget();
        if (!target) return;

        const previousState = _createAppStateSnapshot();
        const previousFocusState = _createFocusRuntimeSnapshot();
        const completedType = focusState.type;
        const completedParentId = focusState.parentId;
        const nowMs = Date.now();
        syncPomodoroPhaseProgress(target, nowMs);
        const elapsed = getElapsedMs(target.focus, nowMs);
        target.focus.elapsedMs = elapsed;
        target.focus.focusState = 'idle';
        target.focus.startedAt = null;
        target.done = true;
        let shouldCelebrateParent = false;
        let saveOk = false;

        setFocusOperationPending(true);
        try {
          if (completedType === 'subtask') {
            const parent = getTask(completedParentId);
            if (!parent) {
              saveOk = await _commitFocusStateSave(previousState, previousFocusState);
              if (!saveOk) return;
              render();
              celebrateElement(null, {
                soundType: 'subtask',
                centerBurst: true,
                burstCount: 170
              });
              closeFocusModal();
              return;
            }
            const wasParentDone = parent.done;
            syncParentStatus(parent);
            shouldCelebrateParent = !wasParentDone && parent.done;
          }

          saveOk = await _commitFocusStateSave(previousState, previousFocusState);
          if (!saveOk) return;
        } finally {
          setFocusOperationPending(false);
        }
        render();
        celebrateElement(null, {
          soundType: completedType === 'parent' ? 'parent' : 'subtask',
          centerBurst: true,
          burstCount: completedType === 'parent' ? 190 : 170
        });
        if (shouldCelebrateParent) {
          const parentEl = document.querySelector(`.task-item[data-id="${completedParentId}"]`);
          celebrateElement(parentEl, { soundType: 'parent', skipVisual: true });
        }
        closeFocusModal();
      }

      async function undoCompleted(type, parentId, subId = null) {
        if (isStateSaveOperationPending()) return false;
        if (type === 'parent') {
          const parent = getTask(parentId);
          if (!parent || hasSubtasks(parent)) return;
          const previousState = _createAppStateSnapshot();
          parent.done = false;
          parent.focus.focusState = 'idle';
          parent.focus.startedAt = null;
          if (!(await _commitStateSave(previousState))) return;
          render();
          return;
        }

        if (type === 'subtask') {
          const parent = getTask(parentId);
          const sub = getSubtask(parentId, subId);
          if (!parent || !sub) return;

          const previousState = _createAppStateSnapshot();
          sub.done = false;
          sub.focus.focusState = 'idle';
          sub.focus.startedAt = null;
          syncParentStatus(parent);
          if (!(await _commitStateSave(previousState))) return;
          render();
        }
      }

      function showDragInsertionPreview(root, intent) {
        const current = qs('.drag-insertion-slot', root);
        // 同じ位置へのdragoverではDOMを動かさず、スクロール位置を保つ。
        if (current && current._dropIntent?.targetEl === intent?.targetEl
          && current._dropIntent.placeAfter === intent.placeAfter) return;
        qsa('.drag-insertion-slot', root).forEach(slot => slot.remove());
        if (!intent?.targetEl) return;

        const target = intent.targetEl;
        const slot = document.createElement(target.tagName === 'LI' ? 'li' : 'div');
        slot.className = 'drag-insertion-slot';
        slot.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
        slot._dropIntent = intent;
        target.parentElement.insertBefore(slot, intent.placeAfter ? target.nextSibling : target);
      }

      function clearDragDropIndicators() {
        qsa('.drag-insertion-slot', taskList).forEach(slot => slot.remove());
      }

      function resetDragState() {
        dragState.type = null;
        dragState.parentId = null;
        dragState.subtaskId = null;
        dragState.intentTargetId = null;
        dragState.intentPlaceAfter = false;
        clearDragDropIndicators();
        qsa('.task-item.dragging, .subtask-item.dragging', taskList).forEach((el) => {
          el.classList.remove('dragging');
        });
      }

      function moveArrayItem(list, fromIndex, toIndex) {
        if (!Array.isArray(list) || list.length === 0) return false;
        if (fromIndex < 0 || fromIndex >= list.length) return false;

        const normalizedTo = Math.max(0, Math.min(toIndex, list.length - 1));
        if (fromIndex === normalizedTo) return false;

        const [moved] = list.splice(fromIndex, 1);
        list.splice(normalizedTo, 0, moved);
        return true;
      }

      async function reorderParentTasks(sourceParentId, targetParentId = null, placeAfter = false) {
        if (isStateSaveOperationPending()) return false;
        const sourceIndex = tasks.findIndex(task => task.id === sourceParentId);
        if (sourceIndex < 0) return false;

        let toIndex = tasks.length - 1;
        if (targetParentId != null) {
          const targetIndex = tasks.findIndex(task => task.id === targetParentId);
          if (targetIndex < 0) return false;
          toIndex = targetIndex + (placeAfter ? 1 : 0);
          if (sourceIndex < toIndex) toIndex -= 1;
        }

        const previousState = _createAppStateSnapshot();
        if (!moveArrayItem(tasks, sourceIndex, toIndex)) return false;
        if (!(await _commitStateSave(previousState))) return false;
        render();
        return true;
      }

      async function reorderSubtasks(parentId, sourceSubId, targetSubId = null, placeAfter = false) {
        if (isStateSaveOperationPending()) return false;
        const parent = getTask(parentId);
        if (!parent) return false;

        const sourceIndex = parent.subtasks.findIndex(sub => sub.id === sourceSubId);
        if (sourceIndex < 0) return false;

        let toIndex = parent.subtasks.length - 1;
        if (targetSubId != null) {
          const targetIndex = parent.subtasks.findIndex(sub => sub.id === targetSubId);
          if (targetIndex < 0) return false;
          toIndex = targetIndex + (placeAfter ? 1 : 0);
          if (sourceIndex < toIndex) toIndex -= 1;
        }

        const previousState = _createAppStateSnapshot();
        if (!moveArrayItem(parent.subtasks, sourceIndex, toIndex)) return false;
        if (!(await _commitStateSave(previousState))) return false;
        render();
        return true;
      }

      function getEditorReorderContext(kind) {
        const parentId = kind === 'parent' ? modalState.parentId : modalState.subtaskParentId;
        const list = kind === 'parent' ? tasks : getTask(parentId)?.subtasks || [];
        const id = kind === 'parent' ? parentId : modalState.subtaskId;
        return { parentId, list, id, index: list.findIndex(item => item.id === id) };
      }

      function syncEditorReorderControls() {
        for (const kind of ['parent', 'subtask']) {
          const { list, index } = getEditorReorderContext(kind);
          qsa(`[data-reorder-kind="${kind}"]`).forEach(button => {
            const offset = Number(button.dataset.reorderOffset);
            button.disabled = isStateSaveOperationPending() || index < 0 || index + offset < 0 || index + offset >= list.length;
          });
          qs(`#${kind}Position`).textContent = index < 0 ? '' : `${index + 1} / ${list.length}番目`;
        }
      }

      async function moveEditorTask(kind, offset) {
        if (isStateSaveOperationPending() || !['parent', 'subtask'].includes(kind)
          || ![-1, 1].includes(offset)) return false;
        const { parentId, list, id, index } = getEditorReorderContext(kind);
        const target = index >= 0 ? list[index + offset] : null;
        if (!target) return false;
        const saved = kind === 'parent'
          ? await reorderParentTasks(id, target.id, offset > 0)
          : await reorderSubtasks(parentId, id, target.id, offset > 0);
        syncEditorReorderControls();
        if (saved) {
          const overlay = kind === 'parent' ? parentModalOverlay : subtaskModalOverlay;
          const buttons = qsa(`[data-reorder-kind="${kind}"]`, overlay);
          const nextButton = buttons.find(button => Number(button.dataset.reorderOffset) === offset && !button.disabled)
            || buttons.find(button => !button.disabled);
          if (_getActiveModalOverlay() === overlay) nextButton?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
        }
        return saved;
      }

      function _restoreFocusToTaskRow(type, parentId, subId = null) {
        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
          if (getRouteFromHash() !== 'tasks' || _getActiveModalOverlay() || isStateSaveOperationPending()) return;
          if (type === 'parent') {
            const $parentRow = qs(`.task-item[data-id="${parentId}"]`);
            if (!$parentRow) return;
            const $focusTarget = qs(`.parent-drag-handle[data-id="${parentId}"]`, $parentRow) || qs('button', $parentRow);
            $focusTarget?.focus();
            return;
          }
          if (type !== 'subtask') return;
          const $subtaskRow = qs(`.subtask-item[data-parent-id="${parentId}"][data-sub-id="${subId}"]`);
          if (!$subtaskRow) return;
          const $focusTarget = qs(`.subtask-drag-handle[data-parent-id="${parentId}"][data-sub-id="${subId}"]`, $subtaskRow) || qs('button', $subtaskRow);
          $focusTarget?.focus();
        });
      }

      async function _moveFocusedTaskRowByOffset(offset) {
        if (isStateSaveOperationPending()) return false;
        if (!Number.isInteger(offset) || offset === 0) return false;
        const $activeElement = document.activeElement;
        if (!($activeElement instanceof HTMLElement)) return false;

        const modalRow = $activeElement.closest('.modal-subtask-row');
        if (modalRow && modalSubtaskList.contains(modalRow)) {
          const { parentId, subId } = modalRow.dataset;
          const parent = getTask(parentId);
          if (!parent) return false;
          const targetId = getVisibleMoveTargetId(parent.subtasks.map(sub => sub.id), subId, offset);
          if (!targetId) return false;
          return reorderSubtasks(parentId, subId, targetId, offset > 0);
        }

        const $subtaskRow = $activeElement.closest('.subtask-item');
        if ($subtaskRow && taskList.contains($subtaskRow)) {
          const parentId = $subtaskRow.dataset.parentId;
          const subId = $subtaskRow.dataset.subId;
          if (!parentId || !subId) return false;
          const parent = getTask(parentId);
          if (!parent || !Array.isArray(parent.subtasks)) return false;
          const targetSubId = getVisibleMoveTargetId(getVisibleSubtaskIds(parent), subId, offset);
          if (!targetSubId) return false;
          if (!(await reorderSubtasks(parentId, subId, targetSubId, offset > 0))) return false;
          _restoreFocusToTaskRow('subtask', parentId, subId);
          return true;
        }

        const $parentRow = $activeElement.closest('.task-item');
        if (!$parentRow || !taskList.contains($parentRow)) return false;
        const parentId = $parentRow.dataset.id;
        if (!parentId) return false;
        const targetParentId = getVisibleMoveTargetId(getVisibleParentTaskIds(), parentId, offset);
        if (!targetParentId) return false;
        if (!(await reorderParentTasks(parentId, targetParentId, offset > 0))) return false;
        _restoreFocusToTaskRow('parent', parentId);
        return true;
      }

      function isPointNearRect(clientX, clientY, rect, padding = 24) {
        if (!Number.isFinite(clientX) || !Number.isFinite(clientY) || !rect) return false;
        return (
          clientX >= rect.left - padding
          && clientX <= rect.right + padding
          && clientY >= rect.top - padding
          && clientY <= rect.bottom + padding
        );
      }

      function resolveDropIntentByClientY(rows, sourceId, clientY, getId) {
        const candidates = rows.filter((row) => getId(row) !== sourceId);
        if (candidates.length === 0) return null;

        if (!Number.isFinite(clientY)) {
          const fallback = candidates[candidates.length - 1];
          return {
            targetEl: fallback,
            targetId: getId(fallback),
            placeAfter: true
          };
        }

        // 差し込み線が広げた分を座標から除き、線の出現で移動先が揺れないようにする。
        const preview = qs(':scope > .drag-insertion-slot', rows[0]?.parentElement);
        const previewRect = preview?.getBoundingClientRect();
        let previewSpace = 0;
        if (previewRect) {
          if (clientY >= previewRect.top && clientY <= previewRect.bottom
            && candidates.includes(preview._dropIntent?.targetEl)) return preview._dropIntent;
          const gap = Number.parseFloat(getComputedStyle(preview.parentElement).rowGap) || 0;
          previewSpace = previewRect.height + gap;
          if (clientY > previewRect.bottom) clientY -= previewSpace;
        }

        // All three callers pass rows from a vertical, DOM-ordered list.
        // Read current geometry on every event so scrolling/resizing needs no cache invalidation.
        let low = 0;
        let high = candidates.length;
        while (low < high) {
          const middle = Math.floor((low + high) / 2);
          const rect = candidates[middle].getBoundingClientRect();
          const top = rect.top - (previewRect && rect.top >= previewRect.bottom ? previewSpace : 0);
          if (clientY < top + rect.height / 2) high = middle;
          else low = middle + 1;
        }
        const row = candidates[Math.min(low, candidates.length - 1)];
        return { targetEl: row, targetId: getId(row), placeAfter: low === candidates.length };
      }

      function startDragFromHandle(handleEl, event) {
        if (
          isStateSaveOperationPending()
          || isFocusOperationPending()
          || isEditOperationPending('parent')
          || isEditOperationPending('subtask')
          || isMessageOperationPending()
          || isAddOperationPending('task')
          || isAddOperationPending('subtask')
          || isAddOperationPending('message')
          || focusOverlay.classList.contains('show')
          || confirmModalOverlay.classList.contains('show')
          || parentModalOverlay.classList.contains('show')
          || subtaskModalOverlay.classList.contains('show')
        ) {
          event.preventDefault();
          return;
        }

        if (handleEl.classList.contains('parent-drag-handle')) {
          const parentId = handleEl.dataset.id;
          if (!parentId) {
            event.preventDefault();
            return;
          }
          dragState.type = 'parent';
          dragState.parentId = parentId;
          dragState.subtaskId = null;
          dragState.intentTargetId = null;
          dragState.intentPlaceAfter = false;
          const itemEl = handleEl.closest('.task-item');
          itemEl?.classList.add('dragging');
        } else if (handleEl.classList.contains('subtask-drag-handle')) {
          const parentId = handleEl.dataset.parentId;
          const subtaskId = handleEl.dataset.subId;
          if (!parentId || !subtaskId) {
            event.preventDefault();
            return;
          }
          dragState.type = 'subtask';
          dragState.parentId = parentId;
          dragState.subtaskId = subtaskId;
          dragState.intentTargetId = null;
          dragState.intentPlaceAfter = false;
          const itemEl = handleEl.closest('.subtask-item');
          itemEl?.classList.add('dragging');
        } else {
          event.preventDefault();
          return;
        }

        clearDragDropIndicators();
        event.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = 'move';
        event.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain', `${dragState.type}:${dragState.parentId}:${dragState.subtaskId || ''}`);
      }

      function clearModalSubtaskDragIndicators() {
        qsa('.drag-insertion-slot', modalSubtaskList).forEach(slot => slot.remove());
      }

      function resetModalSubtaskDragState() {
        modalDragState.parentId = null;
        modalDragState.subtaskId = null;
        modalDragState.intentTargetId = null;
        modalDragState.intentPlaceAfter = false;
        clearModalSubtaskDragIndicators();
        qsa('.modal-subtask-row.dragging', modalSubtaskList).forEach((el) => {
          el.classList.remove('dragging');
        });
      }

      function startModalSubtaskDrag(handleEl, event) {
        if (isStateSaveOperationPending() || isAddOperationPending('subtask') || isEditOperationPending('parent')) {
          event.preventDefault();
          return;
        }
        const parentId = handleEl.dataset.parentId;
        const subtaskId = handleEl.dataset.subId;
        if (!parentId || !subtaskId) {
          event.preventDefault();
          return;
        }

        modalDragState.parentId = parentId;
        modalDragState.subtaskId = subtaskId;
        modalDragState.intentTargetId = null;
        modalDragState.intentPlaceAfter = false;
        clearModalSubtaskDragIndicators();
        handleEl.closest('.modal-subtask-row')?.classList.add('dragging');
        event.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = 'move';
        event.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain', `modal-subtask:${parentId}:${subtaskId}`);
      }

      /* ============================================
         画面描画
      ============================================ */
      function render() {
        syncAllParents();
        applyColorMode();
        applyThemeColor();
        const currentRoute = getRouteFromHash();

        const currentAllDone = isAllDone();

        // 保存データの確定・集計は全画面で維持し、一覧DOMは表示時に最新化する。
        renderRoute.tasksDirty = true;
        renderRoute(currentRoute);
        syncEditorReorderControls();
        updateDocumentTaskIndicators();
        handleTooltipViewportChange();

        if (modalState.parentId) {
          const parent = getTask(modalState.parentId);
          if (parent) {
            renderParentModalSubtasks(parent);
          }
        }

        if (focusOverlay.classList.contains('show')) {
          const target = getActiveFocusTarget();
          if (target) {
            focusTaskTitle.textContent = target.text;
            syncFocusPauseButton();
            updateFocusTimer();
          }
        }

        if (currentAllDone !== previousAllDoneState) {
          render.allDoneVersion = (render.allDoneVersion || 0) + 1;
        }
        if (currentAllDone && !previousAllDoneState) {
          const allDoneVersion = render.allDoneVersion;
          requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            if (allDoneVersion !== render.allDoneVersion || !isAllDone()) return;
            if (settings.celebration) {
              showCelebration();
              launchConfetti(window.innerWidth / 2, window.innerHeight * 0.32, 140);
            }
            playAllClearSound();
          });
        }

        previousAllDoneState = currentAllDone;
      }

      function getFocusIconForMeta(meta, done) {
        if (done) return 'task_alt';
        if (meta?.focusState === 'running') return 'pause_circle';
        return 'play_circle';
      }

      function getTaskRowRenderKey(task, visibleSubtasks) {
        const fields = item => [item.id, item.text, item.done, item.focus?.focusState,
          item.done || item.focus?.focusState === 'paused' ? item.focus?.elapsedMs : 0];
        return JSON.stringify([fields(task), hasSubtasks(task), visibleSubtasks.map(fields)]);
      }

      function createSubtaskRowMarkup(parentId, sub) {
        return `
                    <li class="subtask-item ${sub.done ? 'done' : ''}" data-parent-id="${parentId}" data-sub-id="${sub.id}">
                      <div class="task-leading-controls">
                        <button
                          class="mini-btn drag-handle subtask-drag-handle gm-btn"
                          data-parent-id="${parentId}"
                          data-sub-id="${sub.id}"
                          draggable="true"
                          type="button"
                          aria-label="子タスクをドラッグで並び替え"
                          aria-keyshortcuts="Alt+ArrowUp Alt+ArrowDown"
                        >
                          <span aria-hidden="true" class="material-symbols-outlined">drag_indicator</span>
                        </button>

                        ${sub.done
                          ? `
                          <button
                            class="focus-btn done action-btn undo-subtask-btn gm-btn"
                            data-parent-id="${parentId}"
                            data-sub-id="${sub.id}"
                            type="button"
                            aria-label="完了を取り消す"
                          >
                            <span aria-hidden="true" class="material-symbols-outlined">undo</span>
                            <span>取り消し</span>
                          </button>
                        `
                          : `
                          <button
                            class="focus-btn playable action-btn open-focus-subtask-btn gm-btn"
                            data-parent-id="${parentId}"
                            data-sub-id="${sub.id}"
                            type="button"
                            aria-label="${sub.focus?.focusState === 'paused' ? '再開' : '開始'}"
                          >
                            <span aria-hidden="true" class="material-symbols-outlined">${getFocusIconForMeta(sub.focus, false)}</span>
                            <span>${sub.focus?.focusState === 'paused' ? '再開' : '開始'}</span>
                          </button>
                          `
                        }
                      </div>

                      <div class="subtask-text-wrap">
                        ${sub.done || sub.focus?.focusState === 'paused'
                          ? `
                          <div class="achievement-time subtask-achievement">
                            <span aria-hidden="true" class="material-symbols-outlined">timer</span>
                            <span>${formatAchievementElapsed(sub.focus?.elapsedMs || 0)}</span>
                          </div>
                        `
                          : ''
                        }
                        <div class="text">${escapeHtml(sub.text)}</div>
                      </div>

                      <div class="subtask-actions">
                        <button class="mini-btn action-btn edit-subtask-btn gm-btn" data-parent-id="${parentId}" data-sub-id="${sub.id}" type="button" aria-label="編集">
                          <span aria-hidden="true" class="material-symbols-outlined">edit</span>
                          <span>編集</span>
                        </button>
                        <button class="mini-btn danger action-btn delete-subtask-btn gm-btn" data-parent-id="${parentId}" data-sub-id="${sub.id}" type="button" aria-label="削除">
                          <span aria-hidden="true" class="material-symbols-outlined">delete</span>
                          <span>削除</span>
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </li>
        `;
      }

      function reconcileTaskRows(rows) {
        const activeElement = document.activeElement;
        const focusEntry = taskList.contains(activeElement)
          ? { returnFocusEl: activeElement, returnFocusTarget: _captureModalReturnFocus(activeElement) } : null;
        reconcileChildren(taskList, rows);
        if (focusEntry && document.activeElement === document.body) {
          _restoreFocusAfterPending(focusEntry);
          if (document.activeElement === document.body && !isStateSaveOperationPending()
            && !_getActiveModalOverlay() && _isFocusableElement(taskInput)) {
            taskInput.focus({ preventScroll: true });
          }
        }
      }

      function renderTasks() {
        const nextRowCache = new Map();
        const rows = [];

        const progress = getProgressStats();
        const hasAnyTask = tasks.length > 0;
        const activeFilter = taskViewState.filter;
        const isSearching = isTaskSearchActive();
        clearTaskSearchBtn.hidden = !isSearching;
        let visibleTaskCount = 0;
        let visibleWorkCount = 0;
        taskViewStatus.hidden = !hasAnyTask && !isSearching;
        taskOverview.hidden = !hasAnyTask;
        taskProgressText.textContent = `${progress.completed} / ${progress.total} 完了`;
        taskProgressBar.value = progress.pct;
        taskProgressBar.setAttribute('aria-valuetext', `${progress.total}件中${progress.completed}件完了`);
        taskHeaderActions.hidden = !hasAnyTask;
        syncTaskFilterButtons();
        const clearCompletedCounts = getClearCompletedDeleteCounts(activeFilter);
        const hasCompletedItems = clearCompletedCounts.totalCount > 0 && !isSearching;
        const clearCompletedTitle = isSearching ? '一括削除するには検索を解除してください' : hasCompletedItems
          ? `${getClearCompletedScopeText(activeFilter)}完了済みを削除`
          : '削除できる完了済みタスクはありません';
        clearCompletedBtn.disabled = !hasCompletedItems;
        clearCompletedBtn.setAttribute('aria-disabled', String(!hasCompletedItems));
        clearCompletedBtn.setAttribute('aria-label', clearCompletedTitle);
        const clearAllTitle = isSearching ? '一括削除するには検索を解除してください'
          : hasAnyTask ? 'すべて削除' : '削除できるタスクはありません';
        clearAllBtn.disabled = !hasAnyTask || isSearching;
        clearAllBtn.setAttribute('aria-disabled', String(!hasAnyTask || isSearching));
        clearAllBtn.setAttribute('aria-label', clearAllTitle);

        tasks.forEach(task => {
          const visibleSubtasks = getFilteredSubtasks(task, activeFilter);
          const shouldRenderTask = hasSubtasks(task) ? visibleSubtasks.length > 0
            : matchesTaskFilter(task.done, activeFilter) && matchesTaskSearch(task.text);
          if (!shouldRenderTask) return;

          visibleTaskCount += 1;
          visibleWorkCount += hasSubtasks(task) ? visibleSubtasks.length : 1;
          const key = getTaskRowRenderKey(task, visibleSubtasks);
          const cached = taskRowCache.get(task.id);
          if (cached?.key === key) {
            rows.push(cached.element);
            nextRowCache.set(task.id, cached);
            return;
          }
          const li = document.createElement('li');
          li.className = `task-item ${task.done ? 'done' : ''}`;
          li.dataset.id = task.id;

          const runnableParent = isRunnableParent(task);
          const parentAchievement = (task.done || task.focus?.focusState === 'paused') && runnableParent
            ? `
              <div class="achievement-time task-achievement">
                <span aria-hidden="true" class="material-symbols-outlined">timer</span>
                <span>${formatAchievementElapsed(task.focus?.elapsedMs || 0)}</span>
              </div>
            `
            : '';

          const parentFocusDisabled = !runnableParent;
          const parentFocusTitle = parentFocusDisabled ? '子タスクがあるため開始できません' : task.focus?.focusState === 'paused' ? '再開' : '開始';
          const parentStartControl = parentFocusDisabled
            ? '' : `
              <button
                class="focus-btn playable action-btn open-focus-parent-btn gm-btn"
                data-id="${task.id}"
                type="button"
                aria-label="${parentFocusTitle}"
              >
                <span aria-hidden="true" class="material-symbols-outlined">${getFocusIconForMeta(task.focus, false)}</span>
                <span>${parentFocusTitle}</span>
              </button>
            `;
          const leftControl = task.done && runnableParent
            ? `
              <button
                class="focus-btn done action-btn undo-parent-btn gm-btn"
                data-id="${task.id}"
                type="button"
                aria-label="完了を取り消す"
              >
                <span aria-hidden="true" class="material-symbols-outlined">undo</span>
                <span>取り消し</span>
              </button>
            `
            : parentStartControl;

          const parentDragHandle = `
            <button
              class="mini-btn drag-handle parent-drag-handle gm-btn"
              data-id="${task.id}"
              draggable="true"
              type="button"
              aria-label="親タスクをドラッグで並び替え"
              aria-keyshortcuts="Alt+ArrowUp Alt+ArrowDown"
            >
              <span aria-hidden="true" class="material-symbols-outlined">drag_indicator</span>
            </button>
          `;

          li.style.setProperty('--task-estimated-size', `${4 + visibleSubtasks.length * 3.25}rem`);
          li.innerHTML = `
            <div class="task-main">
              <div class="task-leading-controls">
                ${parentDragHandle}
                ${leftControl ? `<div class="task-focus-wrap">
                  ${leftControl}
                </div>` : ''}
              </div>

              <div class="task-meta">
                ${parentAchievement}
                <div class="task-title">${escapeHtml(task.text)}</div>
              </div>

              <div class="task-tools">
                <button class="mini-btn action-btn edit-parent-btn gm-btn" data-id="${task.id}" type="button" aria-label="編集">
                  <span aria-hidden="true" class="material-symbols-outlined">edit_note</span>
                  <span>編集</span>
                </button>
                <button class="mini-btn danger action-btn delete-parent-btn gm-btn" data-id="${task.id}" type="button" aria-label="削除">
                  <span aria-hidden="true" class="material-symbols-outlined">delete</span>
                  <span>削除</span>
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            ${visibleSubtasks.length > 0 ? `
              <div class="subtask-wrap" id="children-${task.id}">
                <ul class="subtask-list" data-parent-id="${task.id}">
                  ${visibleSubtasks.map(sub => createSubtaskRowMarkup(task.id, sub)).join('')}
                </ul>
              </div>
            ` : ''}
          `;

          // 新しい行だけを変換し、再利用する行のSVGは走査し直さない。
          hydrateMaterialIcons(li);
          rows.push(li);
          nextRowCache.set(task.id, { key, element: li });
        });

        const viewStatus = `${visibleWorkCount}件を表示中${tasks.some(hasSubtasks) ? '（子タスクのある親は件数に含みません）' : ''}${isSearching ? '。検索中は一括削除できません。' : ''}`;
        if (taskViewStatus.textContent !== viewStatus) taskViewStatus.textContent = viewStatus;

        emptyState.hidden = !shouldShowEmptyState;

          emptyStateTitle.textContent = '未完了タスクはありません';

          return;
        }
        if (activeFilter === 'completed') {
          emptyStateTitle.textContent = '完了タスクはありません';
          emptyStateDescription.textContent = '完了するとここに表示されます。';
          return;
        }
        emptyStateTitle.textContent = '表示できるタスクがありません';
        emptyStateDescription.textContent = 'フィルタを切り替えて確認してください。';
      }

        if (isStateSaveOperationPending()) return false;
        if (
          !_pomodoroSettingsControlsSynced
          || !pomodoroToggle
          || !pomodoroFocusMinutesInput
          || !pomodoroBreakMinutesInput

        const currentPomodoro = normalizePomodoroSettings(settings.pomodoro);

        const hasChanged = currentPomodoro.enabled !== nextPomodoro.enabled
          || currentPomodoro.focusMinutes !== nextPomodoro.focusMinutes
          || currentPomodoro.breakMinutes !== nextPomodoro.breakMinutes;

        if (!hasChanged) {
          settings.pomodoro = currentPomodoro;
          syncPomodoroSettingsControls(currentPomodoro);

        const previousState = _createAppStateSnapshot();
        settings.pomodoro = nextPomodoro;

      ============================================ */
      function _createParentDeleteUndoPayload(parentId) {
        const parentIndex = tasks.findIndex(task => task.id === parentId);
        if (parentIndex < 0) return null;
        return {
          removedParents: [{
            index: parentIndex,
            task: _copyTaskSnapshot(tasks[parentIndex])
          }],
          removedSubtasks: []
        };
      }

      function _createSubtaskDeleteUndoPayload(parentId, subId) {
        const parent = getTask(parentId);
        if (!parent) return null;
        const subtaskIndex = parent.subtasks.findIndex(sub => sub.id === subId);
        if (subtaskIndex < 0) return null;
        return {
          removedParents: [],
          removedSubtasks: [{
            parentId,
            index: subtaskIndex,
            subtask: _copyTaskSnapshot(parent.subtasks[subtaskIndex])
          }]
        };
      }

      function _createClearCompletedUndoPayload(filterId = taskViewState.filter) {
        const payload = {
          removedParents: [],
          removedSubtasks: []
        };

        tasks.forEach((task, parentIndex) => {
          if (hasSubtasks(task)) {
            const completedSubtasks = [];
            task.subtasks.forEach((sub, subtaskIndex) => {
              if (!shouldClearCompletedItem(sub.done, filterId)) return;
              completedSubtasks.push({
                parentId: task.id,
                index: subtaskIndex,
                subtask: _copyTaskSnapshot(sub)
              });
            });
            if (completedSubtasks.length === 0) return;
            if (completedSubtasks.length === task.subtasks.length) {
              payload.removedParents.push({
                index: parentIndex,
                task: _copyTaskSnapshot(task)
              });
              return;
            }
            payload.removedSubtasks.push(...completedSubtasks);
            return;
          }

          if (!shouldClearCompletedItem(task.done, filterId)) return;
          payload.removedParents.push({
            index: parentIndex,
            task: _copyTaskSnapshot(task)
          });
        });

        return _isValidDeleteUndoPayload(payload) ? payload : null;
      }

      function _createClearAllUndoPayload() {
        if (tasks.length <= 0) return null;
        return {
          removedParents: tasks.map((task, index) => ({
            index,
            task: _copyTaskSnapshot(task)
          })),
          removedSubtasks: []
        };
      }

      async function performDeleteParent(parentId) {
        if (isStateSaveOperationPending()) return false;
        const undoPayload = _createParentDeleteUndoPayload(parentId);
        if (!_isValidDeleteUndoPayload(undoPayload)) return;
        const previousState = _createAppStateSnapshot();
        const previousTaskCount = tasks.length;
        tasks = tasks.filter(task => task.id !== parentId);
        if (tasks.length === previousTaskCount) return;
        if (!(await _commitStateSave(previousState))) return;
        playDeleteSound();
        render();
        _registerDeleteUndoToast('タスクを削除しました', undoPayload);
      }

      async function performDeleteSubtask(parentId, subId) {
        if (isStateSaveOperationPending()) return false;
        const undoPayload = _createSubtaskDeleteUndoPayload(parentId, subId);
        if (!_isValidDeleteUndoPayload(undoPayload)) return;
        const previousState = _createAppStateSnapshot();
        const parent = getTask(parentId);
        if (!parent) return;
        const previousSubtaskCount = parent.subtasks.length;
        parent.subtasks = parent.subtasks.filter(sub => sub.id !== subId);
        if (parent.subtasks.length === previousSubtaskCount) return;
        if (parent.subtasks.length === 0) {
          parent.done = false;
          parent.focus = createFocusMeta();
        } else {
          syncParentStatus(parent);
        }
        if (!(await _commitStateSave(previousState))) return;
        playDeleteSound();
        render();
        _registerDeleteUndoToast('子タスクを削除しました', undoPayload);

        if (modalState.parentId === parentId) {
          renderParentModalSubtasks(parent);
        }
      }

      async function performClearCompleted(filterId = taskViewState.filter) {
        if (isStateSaveOperationPending()) return false;
        if (isTaskSearchActive()) {
          showErrorToast('一括削除するには検索を解除してください');
          return false;
        }
        const deleteCounts = getClearCompletedDeleteCounts(filterId);
        if (deleteCounts.totalCount <= 0) return;
        const undoPayload = _createClearCompletedUndoPayload(filterId);
        if (!_isValidDeleteUndoPayload(undoPayload)) return;
        const previousState = _createAppStateSnapshot();
        const nextTasks = [];

        tasks.forEach(task => {
          if (hasSubtasks(task)) {
            const remainingSubtasks = task.subtasks.filter(sub => !shouldClearCompletedItem(sub.done, filterId));
            if (remainingSubtasks.length > 0) {
              nextTasks.push({
                ...task,
                subtasks: remainingSubtasks,
                done: false
              });
            }
          } else if (!shouldClearCompletedItem(task.done, filterId)) {
            nextTasks.push(task);
          }
        });

        tasks = nextTasks;
        if (!(await _commitStateSave(previousState))) return;
        playDeleteSound();
        render();
        _registerDeleteUndoToast(`${getClearCompletedScopeText(filterId)}完了済み${formatBulkDeleteCountText(deleteCounts)}を削除しました`, undoPayload);
      }

      async function performClearAll() {
        if (isStateSaveOperationPending()) return false;
        if (isTaskSearchActive()) {
          showErrorToast('一括削除するには検索を解除してください');
          return false;
        }
        if (tasks.length === 0) return;
        const undoPayload = _createClearAllUndoPayload();
        if (!_isValidDeleteUndoPayload(undoPayload)) return;
        const previousState = _createAppStateSnapshot();
        tasks = [];
        if (!(await _commitStateSave(previousState))) return;
        playDeleteSound();
        render();
        _registerDeleteUndoToast('すべてのタスクを削除しました', undoPayload);
      }

      /* ============================================

      async function addTask() {
        if (isStateSaveOperationPending() || isAddOperationPending('task')) return;
        if (taskInput.value.trim().length > MAX_TASK_TEXT_LENGTH) {
          showErrorToast(`最大${MAX_TASK_TEXT_LENGTH}文字までです。入力を短くしてください`);
          taskInput.focus();

        const text = normalizeInputText(taskInput.value, MAX_TASK_TEXT_LENGTH);
        if (!text) {
          showErrorToast('タスク名を入力してください');
          taskInput.focus();
          return;

        if (tasks.length >= MAX_PARENT_TASK_COUNT) {
          showErrorToast(`親タスクは最大${MAX_PARENT_TASK_COUNT}件までです`);
          taskInput.focus();
          return;
        }

        const previousState = _createAppStateSnapshot();
        let saveOk = false;
        setAddOperationPending('task', true);
        try {
          if (taskViewState.filter === 'completed') taskViewState.filter = 'all';
          tasks.unshift({
            id: uid(),
            text,
            done: false,
            focus: createFocusMeta(),
            subtasks: []
          });

          saveOk = await _commitStateSave(previousState);
        } finally {
          setAddOperationPending('task', false);
        }
        if (!saveOk) return;
        taskInput.value = '';
        taskInput.dispatchEvent?.(new Event('input'));
        resetTaskSearch();
        taskInput.focus();
        playAddSound();
        render();
      }

      function isTypingTarget(target) {
        if (!(target instanceof HTMLElement)) return false;
        if (target.isContentEditable) return true;

        const nearestEditable = target.closest('[contenteditable="true"]');
        if (nearestEditable) return true;

        const tagName = target.tagName;
        if (tagName === 'TEXTAREA' || tagName === 'SELECT') return true;
        if (tagName !== 'INPUT') return false;

        const type = (target.getAttribute('type') || 'text').toLowerCase();
        return !['checkbox', 'radio', 'button', 'submit', 'reset', 'range', 'color', 'file', 'image'].includes(type);
      }

        saveParentEditBtn.setAttribute('aria-keyshortcuts', 'Meta+S Ctrl+S Meta+Enter Ctrl+Enter');
        saveSubtaskEditBtn.setAttribute('aria-keyshortcuts', 'Meta+S Ctrl+S Meta+Enter Ctrl+Enter');

      function handleDocumentShortcuts(e) {
        if (e.defaultPrevented || e.isComposing || e.keyCode === 229) return;

        const key = e.key;
        const lowerKey = key.toLowerCase();
        const isWithMeta = e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey;
        // Enterを押したまま編集を閉じると、ボタンへフォーカスが戻る場合がある。
        if (e.repeat && (key === 'Enter' || key === ' ' || e.code === 'Space')
          && e.target instanceof HTMLElement && e.target.closest('button, a[href], [role="button"]')) {
          e.preventDefault();
          return;
        }
        const $activeModalOverlay = _getActiveModalOverlay();

        if (key === 'Tab' && $activeModalOverlay) {
          _trapFocusInOverlay(e, $activeModalOverlay);
          return;
        }

        if ($activeModalOverlay === confirmModalOverlay) {
          if (key === 'Escape') {
            closeConfirmModal();
            return;
          }
          if (key === 'Enter') {
            if (e.repeat || e.altKey || isWithMeta || e.shiftKey) {
              e.preventDefault();
              return;
            }
            const $eventTarget = e.target instanceof HTMLElement ? e.target : null;
            const $button = $eventTarget?.closest('button');
            if ($button === closeConfirmModalBtn || $button?.id === 'cancelConfirmBtn') return;
            e.preventDefault();
            void executeConfirmedAction();
          }
          return;
        }

        if ($activeModalOverlay === subtaskModalOverlay) {
          if (key === 'Escape') {
            closeSubtaskModal();
            return;
          }
          if (isWithMeta && !e.altKey && (lowerKey === 's' || key === 'Enter')) {
            e.preventDefault();
            void saveSubtaskEdit();
          }
          return;
        }

        if ($activeModalOverlay === parentModalOverlay) {
          if ((key === 'ArrowUp' || key === 'ArrowDown') && e.altKey && !isWithMeta
            && !e.shiftKey && !isTypingTarget(e.target)) {
            e.preventDefault();
            void _moveFocusedTaskRowByOffset(key === 'ArrowDown' ? 1 : -1);
            return;
          }
          if (key === 'Escape') {
            closeParentModal();
            return;
          }
          if (isWithMeta && !e.altKey && (lowerKey === 's' || key === 'Enter')) {
            e.preventDefault();
            void saveParentEdit();
          }
          return;
        }

        if ($activeModalOverlay === focusOverlay) {
          if (key === 'Escape') {
            e.preventDefault();
            return;
          }
          const $eventTarget = e.target instanceof HTMLElement ? e.target : null;
          const isActivationKey = key === 'Enter' || key === ' ' || e.code === 'Space';
          // フォーカス中のボタンは Enter / Space による標準操作を優先する。
          if (isActivationKey && $eventTarget?.closest('button, a[href], input, select, textarea, [role="button"]')) {
            if (e.repeat) e.preventDefault();
            return;
          }
          if (isTypingTarget(e.target)) return;
          if ((key === ' ' || e.code === 'Space') && !e.altKey && !isWithMeta) {
            e.preventDefault();
            if (!e.repeat) void pauseOrResumeFocus();
            return;
          }
          if (key === 'Enter' && !e.altKey && !isWithMeta) {
            e.preventDefault();
            if (!e.repeat) void completeFocus();
            return;
          }
          if (lowerKey === 'x' && !e.altKey && !isWithMeta && !e.shiftKey) {
            e.preventDefault();
            if (!e.repeat) abortFocus();
            return;
          }
          return;
        }

        if (
          key === 'ArrowUp' || key === 'ArrowDown'
        ) {
          if (e.altKey && !isWithMeta && !e.shiftKey && !isTypingTarget(e.target)) {
            e.preventDefault();
            void _moveFocusedTaskRowByOffset(key === 'ArrowDown' ? 1 : -1);
          }
          return;
        }

        if (!e.altKey || isWithMeta) return;

        switch (lowerKey) {
          case '1':
            if (e.shiftKey) return;
            e.preventDefault();
            navigate('tasks');
            return;
          case '2':
            if (e.shiftKey) return;
            e.preventDefault();
            focusMemoInputWithRoute();
            return;
          case '3':
            if (e.shiftKey) return;
            e.preventDefault();
            navigate('settings');
            return;
          case 'n':
            if (e.shiftKey) return;
            e.preventDefault();
            focusTaskInputWithRoute();
            return;
          case 'm':
            if (e.shiftKey) return;
            e.preventDefault();
            focusMessageInputWithRoute();
            return;
          case 's':
            if (e.shiftKey) return;
            e.preventDefault();
            void toggleSidebar();
            return;
          case 'l':
            if (e.shiftKey) return;
            e.preventDefault();
            void toggleColorModeWithShortcut();
            return;
          case 'c':
            if (!e.shiftKey) return;
            e.preventDefault();
            navigate('tasks');
            openClearCompletedConfirm();
            return;
          case 'a':
            if (!e.shiftKey) return;
            e.preventDefault();
            navigate('tasks');
            openClearAllConfirm();
            return;
          default:
            return;
        }
      }

      /* ============================================
         イベント処理
      ============================================ */
      updateBackupImportLimitText();
      initializeOrganizeMemoInput();
      // フォーカス離脱時の保存で、クリックが届く前に押下中のボタンをinertにしない。
      document.addEventListener('pointerdown', event => { activePointerIds.add(event.pointerId); }, true);
      document.addEventListener('pointerup', event => { activePointerIds.delete(event.pointerId); }, true);
      document.addEventListener('pointercancel', event => { activePointerIds.delete(event.pointerId); }, true);
      window.addEventListener('blur', () => { activePointerIds.clear(); });
      // 別の入力欄へ移動した後も、メモの保存が待機中の場合がある。
      document.addEventListener('compositionstart', event => { activeCompositionTarget = event.target; });
      document.addEventListener('compositionend', event => {
        if (activeCompositionTarget === event.target) activeCompositionTarget = null;
      });
      document.addEventListener('focusout', event => {
        if (activeCompositionTarget === event.target) activeCompositionTarget = null;
      });
      window.addEventListener('pagehide', persistRuntimeStateForUnload);
      document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
        if (document.visibilityState === 'hidden') {

      try {
        await _initializePersistentStorageState();

      applyAriaKeyShortcuts();
      exportBackupBtn?.addEventListener('click', exportBackup);
