      function closeBulkActions({ restoreFocus = false } = {}) {
        if (!bulkActions.open) return;
        const focusWasInside = bulkActions.contains(document.activeElement);
        bulkActions.open = false;
        if (restoreFocus && focusWasInside) bulkActionsSummary.focus({ preventScroll: true });
      }

      bulkActions.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
        if (event.key !== 'Escape' || event.isComposing || event.keyCode === 229) return;
        event.preventDefault();
        closeBulkActions({ restoreFocus: true });
      });
      document.addEventListener('pointerdown', event => {
        if (!bulkActions.contains(event.target)) closeBulkActions();
      }, { capture: true });
      bulkActions.addEventListener('focusout', event => {
        if (event.relatedTarget && !bulkActions.contains(event.relatedTarget)) closeBulkActions();
      });
      bulkActions.addEventListener('click', event => {
        if (event.target.closest('.bulk-actions-menu button')) closeBulkActions({ restoreFocus: true });
      }, { capture: true });
      qs('#skipToContent').addEventListener('click', event => {
        event.preventDefault();
        const main = qs('#mainContent');
        main.focus({ preventScroll: true });
        main.scrollIntoView({ block: 'start', behavior: 'instant' });
      });
      for (const overlay of [parentModalOverlay, subtaskModalOverlay]) {
        overlay.addEventListener('click', event => {
          const button = event.target.closest('[data-reorder-kind]');
          if (button) void moveEditorTask(button.dataset.reorderKind, Number(button.dataset.reorderOffset));
        });
      }

      addBtn.addEventListener('click', addTask);

      taskFilterGroup?.addEventListener('click', handleTaskFilterClick);
      taskSearchInput.addEventListener('input', handleTaskSearchInput);
      taskSearchInput.addEventListener('compositionend', handleTaskSearchInput);
      taskSearchInput.addEventListener('search', handleTaskSearchInput);
      taskSearchInput.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
        if (event.key !== 'Escape' || event.isComposing || event.keyCode === 229
          || isStateSaveOperationPending()) return;
        event.preventDefault();
        resetTaskSearch();
        render();
      });
      clearTaskSearchBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        if (isStateSaveOperationPending()) return;
        resetTaskSearch();
        render();
        taskSearchInput.focus();
      });

      [
        [organizeMemoInput, MAX_ORGANIZE_MEMO_LENGTH]
      ].forEach(([inputEl, maxLength]) => {
        if (!inputEl) return;
        inputEl.maxLength = maxLength;
      });

      bindInputEnter(taskInput, addTask);

      sidebarCollapseBtn.addEventListener('click', toggleSidebar);

      // 完了メッセージ管理
      messageSaveBtn.addEventListener('click', saveMessage);
      bindInputEnter(messageInput, saveMessage);

      messageList.addEventListener('input', (event) => {
        const input = event.target.closest('.message-edit-input');
        if (input && Number(input.dataset.index) === messageEditorState.editIndex) {
          messageEditorState.draft = input.value;
        }
      });
      messageList.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        const saveBtn = e.target.closest('.save-message-edit-btn');
        if (saveBtn) {
          void saveEditedMessage(Number(saveBtn.dataset.index));
          return;
        }

        const editBtn = e.target.closest('.edit-message-btn');
        if (editBtn) {
          editMessage(Number(editBtn.dataset.index));
          return;
        }

        const deleteBtn = e.target.closest('.delete-message-btn');
        if (deleteBtn) {
          void deleteMessage(Number(deleteBtn.dataset.index));
        }
      });

      messageList.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
        if (e.isComposing || e.keyCode === 229) return;
        const $input = e.target.closest('.message-edit-input');
        if (!$input) return;
        if (e.key === 'Enter') {
          e.preventDefault();
          if (e.repeat) return;
          void saveEditedMessage(Number($input.dataset.index));
          return;
        }
        if (e.key === 'Escape') {
          e.preventDefault();
          messageEditorState.editIndex = null;
          messageEditorState.draft = null;
          renderMessages();
        }
      });

      // 親タスクのモーダル
      closeParentModalBtn.addEventListener('click', closeParentModal);
      saveParentEditBtn.addEventListener('click', saveParentEdit);
      modalAddSubtaskBtn.addEventListener('click', addSubtaskFromModal);

      bindInputEnter(parentEditInput, saveParentEdit, { allowShift: false });

      // 親タスクの保存は、ダイアログのCtrl/Meta+Enterショートカットに任せる。
      bindInputEnter(modalSubtaskInput, addSubtaskFromModal, { allowCommand: false });

      parentModalOverlay.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        if (e.target === parentModalOverlay) closeParentModal();
      });

      modalSubtaskList.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        if (isStateSaveOperationPending() || isAddOperationPending('subtask') || isEditOperationPending('parent')) return;
        const editBtn = e.target.closest('.modal-edit-subtask-btn');
        if (editBtn) {
          openSubtaskModal(editBtn.dataset.parentId, editBtn.dataset.subId);
          return;
        }

        const deleteBtn = e.target.closest('.modal-delete-subtask-btn');
        if (deleteBtn) {
          openConfirmModal(buildDeleteSubtaskConfirmMessage(deleteBtn.dataset.parentId, deleteBtn.dataset.subId), 'delete-subtask-modal', {
            parentId: deleteBtn.dataset.parentId,
            subId: deleteBtn.dataset.subId
          });
        }
      });

      modalSubtaskList.addEventListener('dragstart', (e) => {
        if (isStateSaveOperationPending() || isAddOperationPending('subtask') || isEditOperationPending('parent')) {
          e.preventDefault();
          return;
        }
        const handleEl = e.target.closest('.modal-subtask-drag-handle');
        if (!handleEl) return;
        startModalSubtaskDrag(handleEl, e);
      });

      modalSubtaskList.addEventListener('dragover', (e) => {
        if (isStateSaveOperationPending()) return;
        if (!modalDragState.subtaskId) return;

        const listRect = modalSubtaskList.getBoundingClientRect();
        if (!isPointNearRect(e.clientX, e.clientY, listRect)) {
          clearModalSubtaskDragIndicators();
          modalDragState.intentTargetId = null;
          modalDragState.intentPlaceAfter = false;
          return;
        }

        const intent = resolveDropIntentByClientY(
          qsa('.modal-subtask-row', modalSubtaskList),
          modalDragState.subtaskId,
          e.clientY,
          (row) => row.dataset.subId
        );

        e.preventDefault();
        showDragInsertionPreview(modalSubtaskList, intent);
        if (intent?.targetEl) {
          modalDragState.intentTargetId = intent.targetId;
          modalDragState.intentPlaceAfter = intent.placeAfter;
        } else {
          modalDragState.intentTargetId = null;
          modalDragState.intentPlaceAfter = false;
        }
      });

      modalSubtaskList.addEventListener('dragleave', (e) => {
        if (isPointNearRect(e.clientX, e.clientY, modalSubtaskList.getBoundingClientRect(), 0)) return;
        clearModalSubtaskDragIndicators();
        modalDragState.intentTargetId = null;
        modalDragState.intentPlaceAfter = false;
      });

      modalSubtaskList.addEventListener('drop', (e) => {
        if (isStateSaveOperationPending()) {
          resetModalSubtaskDragState();
          return;
        }
        if (!modalDragState.subtaskId) return;

        const listRect = modalSubtaskList.getBoundingClientRect();
        if (!isPointNearRect(e.clientX, e.clientY, listRect)) {
          resetModalSubtaskDragState();
          return;
        }

        let intent = resolveDropIntentByClientY(
          qsa('.modal-subtask-row', modalSubtaskList),
          modalDragState.subtaskId,
          e.clientY,
          (row) => row.dataset.subId
        );
        if (!intent && modalDragState.intentTargetId) {
          intent = {
            targetId: modalDragState.intentTargetId,
            placeAfter: modalDragState.intentPlaceAfter
          };
        }
        if (!intent || !intent.targetId) {
          resetModalSubtaskDragState();
          return;
        }

        e.preventDefault();
        void reorderSubtasks(
          modalDragState.parentId,
          modalDragState.subtaskId,
          intent.targetId,
          intent.placeAfter
        );
        resetModalSubtaskDragState();
      });

      modalSubtaskList.addEventListener('dragend', resetModalSubtaskDragState);

      // 子タスクのモーダル
      closeSubtaskModalBtn.addEventListener('click', closeSubtaskModal);
      saveSubtaskEditBtn.addEventListener('click', saveSubtaskEdit);

      bindInputEnter(subtaskEditInput, saveSubtaskEdit);

      subtaskModalOverlay.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        if (e.target === subtaskModalOverlay) closeSubtaskModal();
      });

      // 確認モーダル
      closeConfirmModalBtn.addEventListener('click', closeConfirmModal);
      qs('#cancelConfirmBtn').addEventListener('click', closeConfirmModal);
      confirmDeleteBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        void executeConfirmedAction();
      });

      confirmModalOverlay.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        if (e.target === confirmModalOverlay) closeConfirmModal();
      });

      // 集中モードのモーダル
      focusCompleteBtn.addEventListener('click', completeFocus);
      focusPauseBtn.addEventListener('click', pauseOrResumeFocus);
      focusAbortBtn.addEventListener('click', abortFocus);

      // メインリストのクリック操作
      taskList.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        if (isStateSaveOperationPending() || focusOverlay.classList.contains('show') || isFocusOperationPending()) return;

        const undoParentBtn = e.target.closest('.undo-parent-btn');
        if (undoParentBtn) {
          openConfirmModal('完了状態を取り消してもよろしいですか？', 'undo-parent', {
            parentId: undoParentBtn.dataset.id
          });
          return;
        }

        const undoSubtaskBtn = e.target.closest('.undo-subtask-btn');
        if (undoSubtaskBtn) {
          openConfirmModal('完了状態を取り消してもよろしいですか？', 'undo-subtask', {
            parentId: undoSubtaskBtn.dataset.parentId,
            subId: undoSubtaskBtn.dataset.subId
          });
          return;
        }

        const openFocusParentBtn = e.target.closest('.open-focus-parent-btn');
        if (openFocusParentBtn) {
          void openFocusModal('parent', openFocusParentBtn.dataset.id);
          return;
        }

        const openFocusSubtaskBtn = e.target.closest('.open-focus-subtask-btn');
        if (openFocusSubtaskBtn) {
          void openFocusModal('subtask', openFocusSubtaskBtn.dataset.parentId, openFocusSubtaskBtn.dataset.subId);
          return;
        }

        const editParentBtn = e.target.closest('.edit-parent-btn');
        if (editParentBtn) {
          openParentModal(editParentBtn.dataset.id);
          return;
        }

        const delParentBtn = e.target.closest('.delete-parent-btn');
        if (delParentBtn) {
          openConfirmModal(buildDeleteParentConfirmMessage(delParentBtn.dataset.id), 'delete-parent', {
            parentId: delParentBtn.dataset.id,
            buttonEl: delParentBtn
          });
          return;
        }

        const editSubBtn = e.target.closest('.edit-subtask-btn');
        if (editSubBtn) {
          openSubtaskModal(editSubBtn.dataset.parentId, editSubBtn.dataset.subId);
          return;
        }

        const delSubBtn = e.target.closest('.delete-subtask-btn');
        if (delSubBtn) {
          openConfirmModal(buildDeleteSubtaskConfirmMessage(delSubBtn.dataset.parentId, delSubBtn.dataset.subId), 'delete-subtask', {
            parentId: delSubBtn.dataset.parentId,
            subId: delSubBtn.dataset.subId,
            buttonEl: delSubBtn
          });
        }
      });

      taskList.addEventListener('dragstart', (e) => {
        const handleEl = e.target.closest('.drag-handle');
        if (!handleEl) return;
        startDragFromHandle(handleEl, e);
      });

      taskList.addEventListener('dragover', (e) => {
        if (isStateSaveOperationPending()) return;
        if (!dragState.type) return;

        if (dragState.type === 'parent') {
          const listRect = taskList.getBoundingClientRect();
          if (!isPointNearRect(e.clientX, e.clientY, listRect)) {
            clearDragDropIndicators();
            dragState.intentTargetId = null;
            dragState.intentPlaceAfter = false;
            return;
          }

          const intent = resolveDropIntentByClientY(
            qsa('.task-item', taskList),
            dragState.parentId,
            e.clientY,
            (row) => row.dataset.id
          );

          e.preventDefault();
          showDragInsertionPreview(taskList, intent);
          if (intent?.targetEl) {
            dragState.intentTargetId = intent.targetId;
            dragState.intentPlaceAfter = intent.placeAfter;
          } else {
            dragState.intentTargetId = null;
            dragState.intentPlaceAfter = false;
          }
          return;
        }

        const targetList = qs(`.subtask-list[data-parent-id="${dragState.parentId}"]`, taskList);
        if (!targetList) return;

        const listRect = targetList.getBoundingClientRect();
        if (!isPointNearRect(e.clientX, e.clientY, listRect)) {
          clearDragDropIndicators();
          dragState.intentTargetId = null;
          dragState.intentPlaceAfter = false;
          return;
        }

        const intent = resolveDropIntentByClientY(
          qsa('.subtask-item', targetList),
          dragState.subtaskId,
          e.clientY,
          (row) => row.dataset.subId
        );

        e.preventDefault();
        showDragInsertionPreview(taskList, intent);
        if (intent?.targetEl) {
          dragState.intentTargetId = intent.targetId;
          dragState.intentPlaceAfter = intent.placeAfter;
        } else {
          dragState.intentTargetId = null;
          dragState.intentPlaceAfter = false;
        }
      });

      taskList.addEventListener('dragleave', (e) => {
        if (isPointNearRect(e.clientX, e.clientY, taskList.getBoundingClientRect(), 0)) return;
        clearDragDropIndicators();
        dragState.intentTargetId = null;
        dragState.intentPlaceAfter = false;
      });

      taskList.addEventListener('drop', (e) => {
        if (isStateSaveOperationPending()) {
          resetDragState();
          return;
        }
        if (!dragState.type) return;

        if (dragState.type === 'parent') {
          const listRect = taskList.getBoundingClientRect();
          if (!isPointNearRect(e.clientX, e.clientY, listRect)) {
            resetDragState();
            return;
          }

          let intent = resolveDropIntentByClientY(
            qsa('.task-item', taskList),
            dragState.parentId,
            e.clientY,
            (row) => row.dataset.id
          );
          if (!intent && dragState.intentTargetId) {
            intent = {
              targetId: dragState.intentTargetId,
              placeAfter: dragState.intentPlaceAfter
            };
          }
          if (!intent || !intent.targetId) {
            resetDragState();
            return;
          }

          e.preventDefault();
          void reorderParentTasks(
            dragState.parentId,
            intent.targetId,
            intent.placeAfter
          );
          resetDragState();
          return;
        }

        const targetList = qs(`.subtask-list[data-parent-id="${dragState.parentId}"]`, taskList);
        if (!targetList) {
          resetDragState();
          return;
        }

        const listRect = targetList.getBoundingClientRect();
        if (!isPointNearRect(e.clientX, e.clientY, listRect)) {
          resetDragState();
          return;
        }

        let intent = resolveDropIntentByClientY(
          qsa('.subtask-item', targetList),
          dragState.subtaskId,
          e.clientY,
          (row) => row.dataset.subId
        );
        if (!intent && dragState.intentTargetId) {
          intent = {
            targetId: dragState.intentTargetId,
            placeAfter: dragState.intentPlaceAfter
          };
        }
        if (!intent || !intent.targetId) {
          resetDragState();
          return;
        }

        e.preventDefault();
        void reorderSubtasks(
          dragState.parentId,
          dragState.subtaskId,
          intent.targetId,
          intent.placeAfter
        );
        resetDragState();
      });

      taskList.addEventListener('dragend', resetDragState);

      clearCompletedBtn.addEventListener('click', openClearCompletedConfirm);
      clearAllBtn.addEventListener('click', openClearAllConfirm);

      lightModeToggle.addEventListener('change', async () => {
        if (isStateSaveOperationPending()) {
          renderSettings();
          return;
        }
        const previousState = _createAppStateSnapshot();
        settings.colorMode = lightModeToggle.checked ? 'light' : 'dark';
        applyColorMode();
        await _commitStateSave(previousState);
      });

      themeColorGrid?.addEventListener('click', async (e) => {
        const themeBtn = e.target.closest('.theme-btn');
        if (!themeBtn) return;

        const nextTheme = themeBtn.dataset.themeColor;
        if (!nextTheme) return;
        await setThemeColor(nextTheme);
      });

      themeColorGrid?.addEventListener('keydown', async (e) => {
        if (e.isComposing || e.keyCode === 229) return;
        const themeBtn = e.target.closest('.theme-btn');
        if (!themeBtn || !themeColorGrid.contains(themeBtn)) return;
        const key = e.key;
        const isSelectKey = key === 'Enter' || key === ' ' || e.code === 'Space';
        const isPrevKey = key === 'ArrowLeft' || key === 'ArrowUp';
        const isNextKey = key === 'ArrowRight' || key === 'ArrowDown';
        const isHomeEndKey = key === 'Home' || key === 'End';
        if (!isSelectKey && !isPrevKey && !isNextKey && !isHomeEndKey) return;

        const themeButtons = qsa('.theme-btn', themeColorGrid);
        if (themeButtons.length <= 0) return;
        const focusedIndex = themeButtons.indexOf(themeBtn);
        if (focusedIndex < 0) return;

        if (isSelectKey) {
          e.preventDefault();
          const activeTheme = themeBtn.dataset.themeColor;
          if (!activeTheme) return;
          const hasChanged = await setThemeColor(activeTheme);
          if (!hasChanged) themeBtn.focus();
          return;
        }

        let nextIndex = focusedIndex;
        if (isPrevKey) {
          nextIndex = (focusedIndex - 1 + themeButtons.length) % themeButtons.length;
        } else if (isNextKey) {
          nextIndex = (focusedIndex + 1) % themeButtons.length;
        } else if (key === 'Home') {
          nextIndex = 0;
        } else if (key === 'End') {
          nextIndex = themeButtons.length - 1;
        }

        const nextBtn = themeButtons[nextIndex];
        if (!nextBtn) return;
        const nextTheme = nextBtn.dataset.themeColor;
        if (!nextTheme) return;

        e.preventDefault();
        const hasChanged = await setThemeColor(nextTheme);
        if (hasChanged) {
          requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            const $selectedBtn = qs(`.theme-btn[data-theme-color="${nextTheme}"]`, themeColorGrid);
            $selectedBtn?.focus();
          });
          return;
        }
        nextBtn.focus();
      });

      for (const [control, setting] of [
        [soundToggle, 'sound'],
        [celebrationToggle, 'celebration']
      ]) {
        control.addEventListener('change', async () => {
          if (isStateSaveOperationPending()) {
            renderSettings();
            return;
          }
          const previousState = _createAppStateSnapshot();
          settings[setting] = control.checked;
          await _commitStateSave(previousState);
        });
      }

      pomodoroToggle?.addEventListener('change', async () => {
        if (isStateSaveOperationPending()) {
          renderPomodoroSettings();
          return;
        }
        const previousState = _createAppStateSnapshot();
        settings.pomodoro = normalizePomodoroSettings(settings.pomodoro);
        settings.pomodoro.enabled = !!pomodoroToggle.checked;
        renderPomodoroSettings();
        await _commitStateSave(previousState);
      });

      function bindPomodoroMinutesInput(input, phase) {
        if (!input) return;
        input.addEventListener('change', () => {
          void commitPomodoroMinutesFromInput(phase);
        });
        bindInputEnter(input, () => {
          void commitPomodoroMinutesFromInput(phase);
          input.blur();
        });
      }

      bindPomodoroMinutesInput(pomodoroFocusMinutesInput, 'focus');
      bindPomodoroMinutesInput(pomodoroBreakMinutesInput, 'break');

      document.addEventListener('keydown', handleTooltipKeyDown);
      document.addEventListener('pointerover', handleTooltipPointerOver);
      document.addEventListener('pointerout', handleTooltipPointerOut);
      taskList.addEventListener('focusin', (event) => {
        const target = event.target;
        // Rendering a skipped long row can change its height after native focus scrolling.
        requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => {
          if (document.activeElement !== target || !target.isConnected) return;
          const rect = target.getBoundingClientRect();
          if (rect.top < 0 || rect.bottom > window.innerHeight) {
            target.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest', inline: 'nearest' });
          }
        }));
      });

      document.addEventListener('focusin', handleTooltipFocusIn);
      document.addEventListener('focusout', handleTooltipFocusOut);
      document.addEventListener('pointerdown', _hideQuickTooltip, {
        capture: true,
        passive: true
      });
      window.addEventListener('scroll', handleTooltipViewportChange, {
        capture: true,
        passive: true
      });
      window.addEventListener('resize', handleTooltipViewportChange);

      document.addEventListener('keydown', handleDocumentShortcuts);
      compactSidebarQuery.addEventListener('change', applySidebarState);

      function bindTextLengthHint(input, limit) {
        const hint = document.createElement('p');
        hint.className = 'field-helper gm-help text-length-hint';
        hint.id = `${input.id}-length`;
        hint.hidden = true;
        input.parentElement.insertAdjacentElement('afterend', hint);
        input.setAttribute('aria-describedby', [input.getAttribute('aria-describedby'), hint.id].filter(Boolean).join(' '));
        const update = () => {
          const length = input.value.trim().length;
          const exceeded = length > limit;
          hint.hidden = length === 0;
          hint.textContent = `${length} / ${limit}文字${exceeded ? ' — 上限を超えています。入力を短くしてください。' : ''}`;
          input.setAttribute('aria-invalid', String(exceeded));
          hint.classList.toggle('is-error', exceeded);
        };
        input.addEventListener('input', update);
        input.addEventListener('focus', update);
        input.addEventListener('blur', update);
      }

      for (const [input, limit] of [[taskInput, MAX_TASK_TEXT_LENGTH], [parentEditInput, MAX_TASK_TEXT_LENGTH], [modalSubtaskInput, MAX_SUBTASK_TEXT_LENGTH], [subtaskEditInput, MAX_SUBTASK_TEXT_LENGTH], [messageInput, MAX_MESSAGE_TEXT_LENGTH]]) {
        bindTextLengthHint(input, limit);
      }

      /* ============================================
         初期化
      ============================================ */
      syncAllParents();
      previousAllDoneState = isAllDone();
      applySidebarState();
      // 静的なアイコンは初回のみ。動的な一覧・ダイアログは生成箇所で変換する。
      hydrateMaterialIcons();
      render();

      navigate(getRouteFromHash());
    })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>
